     tm_subpattern_agree a  ( (a_App p (Role R) (a_Var_f x)) )

Lemma lc_id_open : forall u k y, lc_tm_at 0 0 u -> open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) u = u.
Proof. intros u k y H. apply (lc_open_tm_at u k 0 y). apply (lc_mono_tm u 0 0 k 0 H); lia. Qed.
Definition Ct1 (a:tm) := forall k x y u, lc_tm_at 0 0 u -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm u -> x <> y ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (tm_subst_tm_tm u x a)
  = tm_subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) a).
Definition Cc1 (g:co) := forall k x y u, lc_tm_at 0 0 u -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm u -> x <> y ->
  open_co_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (tm_subst_tm_co u x g)
  = tm_subst_tm_co u x (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) g).
Definition Cb1 (b:brs) := forall k x y u, lc_tm_at 0 0 u -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm u -> x <> y ->
  open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (tm_subst_tm_brs u x b)
  = tm_subst_tm_brs u x (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) b).
Definition Ck1 (phi:constraint) := forall k x y u, lc_tm_at 0 0 u -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm u -> x <> y ->
  open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (tm_subst_tm_constraint u x phi)

Lemma open_subst_bvar : forall k x y u n, x <> y ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (tm_subst_tm_tm u x (a_Var_b n))
  = tm_subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (a_Var_b n)).
Proof.
  intros. cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec tm_subst_tm_tm].
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[hz1|hz2]|hz3].
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. reflexivity.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. destruct (eq_var y x) as [e|ne]; [exfalso; apply H; symmetry; auto|reflexivity].
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. reflexivity.
Qed.

  unfold Ct1, Cc1, Cb1, Ck1 in *; intros;
  match goal with
  | |- open_tm_wrt_tm_rec ?k (a_Var_f ?y) (tm_subst_tm_tm ?u ?x (a_Var_b ?n)) = _ =>

  | _ =>
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_co_wrt_tm_rec open_brs_wrt_tm_rec open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec
           tm_subst_tm_tm tm_subst_tm_co tm_subst_tm_brs tm_subst_tm_constraint];
      match goal with
      | |- open_tm_wrt_tm_rec ?k (a_Var_f ?y)
             (if eq_var ?z ?x then ?u else a_Var_f ?z) = _ =>
          destruct (eq_var z x) as [e|n];
          [ apply lc_id_open; assumption | reflexivity ]
      | _ => simpl in *; repeat f_equal; try solve [eauto]
      end
  end.

Lemma in_add_iff : forall (x y:atom) (s:atoms), x `in` AtomSetImpl.add y s <-> x = y \/ x `in` s.
Proof. intros. fsetdec. Qed.
Lemma dom_binds : forall (A:Type) (W:list (atom*A)) x,
  x `in` dom W <-> exists a, binds x a W.
Proof.
  intros A W. induction W as [| [y b] E IH]; intros x.
  - simpl. split.
    + intro H; fsetdec.
    + intros [a Hb]. unfold binds in Hb. simpl in Hb. destruct Hb.
  - simpl. rewrite in_add_iff. split.
    + intros [Heq|Hin].
      * subst x. exists b. unfold binds. simpl. left. auto.
      * apply IH in Hin. destruct Hin as [a Ha]. exists a. unfold binds. simpl. right. auto.
    + intros [a Ha]. unfold binds in Ha. simpl in Ha. destruct Ha as [Hhead|Htail].
      * inversion Hhead. subst. left. auto.
      * right. apply IH. exists a. auto.
Qed.
Lemma dom_in_map : forall (A:Type) (E:list (atom*A)) x,
  x `in` dom E <-> In x (List.map (fun p : atom*A => fst p) E).
Proof.
  intros A E x. rewrite dom_binds. split.
  - intros [a Ha]. apply in_map_iff. exists (x,a). split; auto.
  - intro H. apply in_map_iff in H. destruct H as [[y a] [Hf Hi]]. simpl in Hf. subst y.
    exists a. auto.
Qed.
Lemma uniq_NoDup : forall (A:Type) (W:list (atom*A)), uniq W <-> NoDup (List.map (fun p : atom*A => fst p) W).
Lemma dom_perm : forall (A:Type) (W W':list (atom*A)), Permutation W W' ->
  forall x, x `in` dom W <-> x `in` dom W'.
Proof.
  intros A W W' Hp x. split; intro Hx.
  - apply dom_binds in Hx. destruct Hx as [a Ha]. apply dom_binds. exists a.
    eapply binds_perm; eauto.
  - apply dom_binds in Hx. destruct Hx as [a Ha]. apply dom_binds. exists a.
    eapply binds_perm; [exact Ha | apply Permutation_sym; auto].
Qed.

  forall x, x `in` AtomSetImpl.union A C <-> x `in` AtomSetImpl.union B C.

  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; auto.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. apply Heq; auto.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; auto.

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev.

(* Instantiate free de Bruijn variables of terms and covariables with
   lists of free atoms, at given binder depths.  This is the standard
   "opening with k fresh names" operation, respecting local binders. *)

Fixpoint it_cs (tns:list tmvar) (cns:list covar) (td cd:nat) (phi:constraint) : constraint :=
  match phi with
  | Eq a b A R => Eq (it tns cns td cd a) (it tns cns td cd b) (it tns cns td cd A) R
  end
with it_co (tns:list tmvar) (cns:list covar) (td cd:nat) (g:co) : co :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => g_Triv
  | g_Var_b n => if lt_dec n cd then g_Var_b n
                 else match nth_error cns (n - cd) with Some c => g_Var_f c | None => g_Var_b n end
  | g_Var_f c => g_Var_f c
  | g_Beta a b => g_Beta (it tns cns td cd a) (it tns cns td cd b)
  | g_Refl a => g_Refl (it tns cns td cd a)
  | g_Refl2 a b g' => g_Refl2 (it tns cns td cd a) (it tns cns td cd b) (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_Sym g' => g_Sym (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => g_Trans (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_Sub g' => g_Sub (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_PiCong rho R g1 g2 => g_PiCong rho R (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns (S td) cd g2)
  | g_AbsCong rho R g1 g2 => g_AbsCong rho R (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns (S td) cd g2)
  | g_AppCong g1 rho R g2 => g_AppCong (it_co tns cns td cd g1) rho R (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_PiFst g' => g_PiFst (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_CPiFst g' => g_CPiFst (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_IsoSnd g' => g_IsoSnd (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => g_PiSnd (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => g_CPiCong (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns td (S cd) g3)
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => g_CAbsCong (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns td (S cd) g3) (it_co tns cns td cd g4)
  | g_CAppCong g g1 g2 => g_CAppCong (it_co tns cns td cd g) (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_CPiSnd g g1 g2 => g_CPiSnd (it_co tns cns td cd g) (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_Cast g1 R g2 => g_Cast (it_co tns cns td cd g1) R (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => g_EqCong (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it tns cns td cd A) (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 g' => g_IsoConv (it_cs tns cns td cd phi1) (it_cs tns cns td cd phi2) (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_Eta a => g_Eta (it tns cns td cd a)
  | g_Left g g' => g_Left (it_co tns cns td cd g) (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_Right g g' => g_Right (it_co tns cns td cd g) (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  end
with it_brs (tns:list tmvar) (cns:list covar) (td cd:nat) (b:brs) : brs :=
  match b with
  | br_None => br_None
  | br_One K a brs5 => br_One K (it tns cns td cd a) (it_brs tns cns td cd brs5)
  end
with it (tns:list tmvar) (cns:list covar) (td cd:nat) (a:tm) : tm :=
  match a with
  | a_Star => a_Star
  | a_Var_b n => if lt_dec n td then a_Var_b n
                 else match nth_error tns (n - td) with Some x => a_Var_f x | None => a_Var_b n end
  | a_Var_f x => a_Var_f x
  | a_Abs rho A b => a_Abs rho (it tns cns td cd A) (it tns cns (S td) cd b)
  | a_UAbs rho b => a_UAbs rho (it tns cns (S td) cd b)
  | a_App a nu b => a_App (it tns cns td cd a) nu (it tns cns td cd b)
  | a_Pi rho A B => a_Pi rho (it tns cns td cd A) (it tns cns (S td) cd B)
  | a_CAbs phi b => a_CAbs (it_cs tns cns td cd phi) (it tns cns td (S cd) b)
  | a_UCAbs b => a_UCAbs (it tns cns td (S cd) b)
  | a_CApp a g => a_CApp (it tns cns td cd a) (it_co tns cns td cd g)
  | a_CPi phi B => a_CPi (it_cs tns cns td cd phi) (it tns cns td (S cd) B)
  | a_Conv a R g => a_Conv (it tns cns td cd a) R (it_co tns cns td cd g)
  | a_Fam F => a_Fam F
  | a_Bullet => a_Bullet
  | a_Pattern R a F Apps5 b1 b2 => a_Pattern R (it tns cns td cd a) F Apps5 (it tns cns td cd b1) (it tns cns td cd b2)
  | a_DataCon K => a_DataCon K
  | a_Case a brs5 => a_Case (it tns cns td cd a) (it_brs tns cns td cd brs5)
  | a_Sub R a => a_Sub R (it tns cns td cd a)
  | a_Coerce => a_Coerce
  | a_SrcApp a b => a_SrcApp (it tns cns td cd a) (it tns cns td cd b)
  end.

with it_co_mut := Induction for it_co Sort Prop
with it_brs_mut := Induction for it_brs Sort Prop
with it_mut := Induction for it Sort Prop.
EOF

     ApplyArgs (a_Fam F) b b
 | ApplyArgs_AppRole : forall (a:tm) (R:role) (a' b b':tm),
     lc_tm a' ->
     ApplyArgs a b b' ->
     ApplyArgs  ( (a_App a (Role R) a') )  b  ( (a_App b' (Rho Rel) a') )
 | ApplyArgs_AppRho : forall (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (a' b b':tm),
     lc_tm a' ->
     ApplyArgs a b b' ->
     ApplyArgs  ( (a_App a (Rho rho) a') )  b  ( (a_App b' (Rho rho) a') )
 | ApplyArgs_CApp : forall (a b b':tm),
     ApplyArgs a b b' ->
     ApplyArgs (a_CApp a g_Triv) b (a_CApp b' g_Triv).

(* defns JValue *)
Inductive Value : role -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn Value *)
 | Value_Star : forall (R:role),
     Value R a_Star
 | Value_Pi : forall (R:role) (rho:relflag) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->

 | Value_CPi : forall (R:role) (phi:constraint) (B:tm),

     lc_tm (a_UAbs Rel a) ->
     Value R (a_UAbs Rel a)
 | Value_UAbsIrrel : forall (L:vars) (R:role) (a:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Value R  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Value R (a_UAbs Irrel a)
 | Value_CAbs : forall (R:role) (phi:constraint) (a:tm),

 | Value_Path : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const),

(* defns JValueType *)
Inductive roleing : role_context -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn roleing *)
 | role_a_Bullet : forall (W:role_context) (R:role),
      uniq  W  ->
     roleing W a_Bullet R
 | role_a_Star : forall (W:role_context) (R:role),
      uniq  W  ->
     roleing W a_Star R
 | role_a_Var : forall (W:role_context) (x:tmvar) (R1 R:role),
      uniq  W  ->
      binds  x   R   W  ->
     SubRole R R1 ->
     roleing W (a_Var_f x) R1
 | role_a_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (rho:relflag) (a:tm) (R:role),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> roleing  (( x  ~  Nom ) ++  W )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_UAbs rho a) )  R
 | role_a_App : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     roleing W b Nom ->
     roleing W  ( (a_App a (Rho rho) b) )  R
 | role_a_TApp : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (R1:role) (b:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     roleing W b  (param R1   R )  ->
     roleing W (a_App a (Role R1) b) R
 | role_a_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (rho:relflag) (A B:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W A R ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> roleing  (( x  ~  Nom ) ++  W )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_Pi rho A B) )  R
 | role_a_CPi : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (a b A:tm) (R1:role) (B:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R1 ->
     roleing W b R1 ->
     roleing W A Rep ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> roleing W  ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_CPi (Eq a b A R1) B) )  R
 | role_a_CAbs : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (b:tm) (R:role),
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> roleing W  ( open_tm_wrt_co b (g_Var_f c) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_UCAbs b) )  R
 | role_a_CApp : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     roleing W  ( (a_CApp a g_Triv) )  R
 | role_a_Const : forall (W:role_context) (F:const) (R:role) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
      uniq  W  ->
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     roleing W (a_Fam F) R
 | role_a_Fam : forall (W:role_context) (F:const) (R1:role) (p a A:tm) (R:role) (Rs:roles),
      uniq  W  ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a A R Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     roleing W (a_Fam F) R1
 | role_a_Pattern : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2:tm) (R1:role),
     roleing W a Nom ->
     roleing W b1 R1 ->
     roleing W b2 R1 ->
     roleing W (a_Pattern Nom a F Apps5 b1 b2) R1.

(* defns JChk *)

(* defns Jpar *)
Inductive Par : role_context -> tm -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn Par *)
 | Par_Refl : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     Par W a a R
 | Par_Beta : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b a' b':tm) (R:role),
     Par W a  ( (a_UAbs rho a') )  R ->
     Par W b b' Nom ->
     Par W (a_App a (Rho rho) b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )  R
 | Par_App : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (nu:appflag) (b a' b':tm) (R:role),
     Par W a a' R ->
     Par W b b'  (  app_role  nu   R  )  ->
     Par W (a_App a nu b) (a_App a' nu b') R
 | Par_CBeta : forall (W:role_context) (a a':tm) (R:role),
     Par W a  ( (a_UCAbs a') )  R ->
     Par W (a_CApp a g_Triv)  (open_tm_wrt_co  a'   g_Triv )  R
 | Par_CApp : forall (W:role_context) (a a':tm) (R:role),
     Par W a a' R ->
     Par W (a_CApp a g_Triv) (a_CApp a' g_Triv) R
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (rho:relflag) (a a':tm) (R:role),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (( x  ~  Nom ) ++  W )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     Par W (a_UAbs rho a) (a_UAbs rho a') R
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (rho:relflag) (A B A' B':tm) (R:role),
     Par W A A' R ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (( x  ~  Nom ) ++  W )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     Par W (a_Pi rho A B) (a_Pi rho A' B') R
 | Par_CAbs : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (a a':tm) (R:role),
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> Par W  ( open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f c) )   ( open_tm_wrt_co a' (g_Var_f c) )  R )  ->
     Par W (a_UCAbs a) (a_UCAbs a') R
 | Par_CPi : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (a b A:tm) (R1:role) (B a' b' A' B':tm) (R:role),
     Par W A A' Rep ->
     Par W a a' R1 ->
     Par W b b' R1 ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> Par W  ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )   ( open_tm_wrt_co B' (g_Var_f c) )  R )  ->
     Par W (a_CPi (Eq a b A R1) B) (a_CPi (Eq a' b' A' R1) B') R
 | Par_AxiomBase : forall (W:role_context) (F:const) (b:tm) (R:role) (A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Ax (a_Fam F) b A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     SubRole R1 R ->
      uniq  W  ->
     Par W (a_Fam F) b R
 | Par_AxiomApp : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (nu:appflag) (a1 a2:tm) (R:role) (F:const) (p b A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles) (a' a1' p' b':tm) (D':available_props),
      binds  F  ( (Ax p b A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      tm_subpattern_agree a p  /\   not (  ( tm_pattern_agree a p )  )   ->
     Par W a a' R ->
     Par W a1 a1'  (  app_role  nu   R  )  ->
     Rename p b p' b'  (  (  (dom  W )   `union`   (fv_tm_tm_tm  p )  )  )  D' ->
     MatchSubst  ( (a_App a' nu a1') )  p' b' a2 ->
     SubRole R1 R ->
     Par W (a_App a nu a1) a2 R
 | Par_AxiomCApp : forall (W:role_context) (a a2:tm) (R:role) (F:const) (p b A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles) (a' p' b':tm) (D':available_props),
      binds  F  ( (Ax p b A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      tm_subpattern_agree a p  /\   not (  ( tm_pattern_agree a p )  )   ->
     Par W a a' R ->
     Rename p b p' b'  (  (  (dom  W )   `union`   (fv_tm_tm_tm  p )  )  )  D' ->
     MatchSubst  ( (a_CApp a' g_Triv) )  p' b' a2 ->
     SubRole R1 R ->
     Par W (a_CApp a g_Triv) a2 R
 | Par_Pattern : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm) (R0:role),
     Par W a a' Nom ->
     Par W b1 b1' R0 ->
     Par W b2 b2' R0 ->
     Par W  ( (a_Pattern Nom a F Apps5 b1 b2) )   ( (a_Pattern Nom a' F Apps5 b1' b2') )  R0
 | Par_PatternTrue : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2 b:tm) (R0:role) (a' b1' b2':tm) (Apps':Apps),
     Par W a a' Nom ->
     Par W b1 b1' R0 ->
     Par W b2 b2' R0 ->
     AppsPath Nom a' F Apps5 ->
     ApplyArgs a' b1' b ->
      ( SatApp F Apps' )  ->
     Par W  ( (a_Pattern Nom a F Apps5 b1 b2) )  (a_CApp b g_Triv) R0
 | Par_PatternFalse : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2 b2':tm) (R0:role) (a' b1':tm),
     Par W a a' Nom ->
     Par W b1 b1' R0 ->
     Par W b2 b2' R0 ->
     Value Nom a' ->
      not (  ( AppsPath Nom a' F Apps5 )  )  ->
     Par W  ( (a_Pattern Nom a F Apps5 b1 b2) )  b2' R0
with MultiPar : role_context -> tm -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn MultiPar *)
Inductive CasePath : role -> tm -> const -> Prop :=    (* defn CasePath *)
 | CasePath_AbsConst : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
     ValuePath a F ->
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     CasePath R a F
 | CasePath_Const : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (p b A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
     ValuePath a F ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p b A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      not (  ( SubRole R1 R )  )  ->
     CasePath R a F
 | CasePath_UnMatch : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (p b A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
     ValuePath a F ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p b A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      not (  ( subtm_pattern_agree a p )  )  ->
     CasePath R a F.

(* analogous: locally closed terms are invariant under covariable opening *)
Definition CAtm (a:tm) := forall k j (g:co), lc_tm_at k j a -> open_tm_wrt_co_rec j g a = a.
Definition Cco (g:co) := forall k j (h:co), lc_co_at k j g -> open_co_wrt_co_rec j h g = g.
Definition Cbrs (q:brs) := forall k j (g:co), lc_brs_at k j q -> open_brs_wrt_co_rec j g q = q.
Definition Ccs (p:constraint) := forall k j (g:co), lc_cs_at k j p -> open_constraint_wrt_co_rec j g p = p.
Ltac solve_CAtm :=
  unfold CAtm, Cco, Cbrs, Ccs in *; intros; simpl in *;
  repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
  try (cbn [open_tm_wrt_co_rec open_co_wrt_co_rec open_brs_wrt_co_rec open_constraint_wrt_co_rec]);
  try (match goal with
       | Hn : ?n < ?j |- context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?n ?j] =>
           destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n j) as [[h1|h2]|h3]; [reflexivity|lia|lia] end);
  try (repeat f_equal; eauto 8).
Lemma CAtm_tm : forall a, CAtm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 Ccs CAtm Cbrs Cco). all: solve [solve_CAtm]. Qed.
Lemma CAtm_co : forall g, Cco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 Ccs CAtm Cbrs Cco). all: solve [solve_CAtm]. Qed.
Lemma CAtm_brs : forall q, Cbrs q.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 Ccs CAtm Cbrs Cco). all: solve [solve_CAtm]. Qed.
Lemma CAtm_cs : forall p, Ccs p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 Ccs CAtm Cbrs Cco). all: solve [solve_CAtm]. Qed.

Definition COAtm (a:tm) := forall k j j' (g:co), lc_tm_at k j a -> j <= j' ->
  open_tm_wrt_co_rec j' g a = a.
Definition COco (g:co) := forall k j j' (h:co), lc_co_at k j g -> j <= j' ->
  open_co_wrt_co_rec j' h g = g.
Definition CObrs (q:brs) := forall k j j' (g:co), lc_brs_at k j q -> j <= j' ->
  open_brs_wrt_co_rec j' g q = q.
Definition COcs (p:constraint) := forall k j j' (g:co), lc_cs_at k j p -> j <= j' ->
  open_constraint_wrt_co_rec j' g p = p.
Lemma COAtm_tm : forall a, COAtm a.
Proof. intros a k j j' g H Hle. apply (CAtm_tm a k j' g).
  apply (lc_mono_tm a k j k j' H); lia. Qed.
Lemma COAtm_co : forall g, COco g.
Proof. intros g k j j' h H Hle. apply (CAtm_co g k j' h).
  apply (lc_mono_co g k j k j' H); lia. Qed.
Lemma COAtm_brs : forall q, CObrs q.
Proof. intros q k j j' g H Hle. apply (CAtm_brs q k j' g).
  apply (lc_mono_brs q k j k j' H); lia. Qed.
Lemma COAtm_cs : forall p, COcs p.
Proof. intros p k j j' g H Hle. apply (CAtm_cs p k j' g).
  apply (lc_mono_cs p k j k j' H); lia. Qed.
EOF

Lemma Par_weaken : forall W a b R, Par W a b R ->
  forall (x:atom) (Rw:role), x `notin` dom W -> Par ((x ~ Rw) ++ W) a b R.

  intros W a b R H. induction H; intros x Rw Hx.
  - apply Par_Refl. apply roleing_weaken; auto.
  - apply Par_Beta. apply IHPar1; auto. apply IHPar2; auto.
  - apply Par_App. apply IHPar1; auto. apply IHPar2; auto.
  - apply Par_CBeta. apply IHPar; auto.
  - apply Par_CApp. apply IHPar; auto.
  - apply Par_Abs with (L := L `union` {{x}} `union` dom W); intros y Hy.
    assert (HyL : y `notin` L) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hyx : y <> x) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hxdom : x `notin` dom ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) by (simpl; fsetdec).
    apply (Par_perm ((x ~ Rw) ++ ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) _ _ R).
    + apply (H0 y HyL x Rw Hxdom).
    + simpl; apply perm_swap.

      assert (HyL : y `notin` L) by fsetdec.

      assert (Hxdom : x `notin` dom ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) by (simpl; fsetdec).
      apply (Par_perm ((x ~ Rw) ++ ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) _ _ R).
      * apply (H1 y HyL x Rw Hxdom).
      * simpl; apply perm_swap.
  - apply Par_CAbs with (L := L); intros c Hc. apply (H0 c Hc x Rw Hx).
  - apply Par_CPi with (L := L).
    + apply IHPar1; auto. + apply IHPar2; auto. + apply IHPar3; auto.
    + intros c Hc. apply (H3 c Hc x Rw Hx).
  - eapply Par_AxiomBase; eauto.
  - (* AxiomApp *)
    pose proof H as Hbinds.
    apply binds_toplevel_inv in H. destruct H as [HF Hs]; subst F. inversion Hs; subst.
    assert (HinD : AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 (union (dom W) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat))).

    destruct (Rename_FixPat_exists (union (dom ((x ~ Rw) ++ W)) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat)))

                     (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef))
      by (apply MatchSubst_Const; auto).
    assert (Hms2 : MatchSubst (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a2)
                     (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet)
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef)

Lemma subst_fixdef_open : forall (y:tmvar), y <> FixVar2 ->
  tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef
  = a_App (a_Var_f y) (Rho Rel)
      (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) (a_Var_f y)).
Proof.
  intros y Hy. unfold FixDef. simpl.
  rewrite (eq_dec_refl FixVar2). simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma lc_fixdef_renamed : forall (y:tmvar), y <> FixVar2 ->
  lc_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef).
Proof. intros y H. rewrite (subst_fixdef_open y H). repeat constructor. Qed.
Lemma fixdef_rename_indep : forall (y0 y1:tmvar) (a:tm), y0 <> FixVar2 -> y1 <> FixVar2 ->
  tm_subst_tm_tm a y0 (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y0) FixVar2 FixDef)
  = tm_subst_tm_tm a y1 (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef).
Proof.
  intros y0 y1 a H0 H1.
  rewrite (subst_fixdef_open y0 H0). rewrite (subst_fixdef_open y1 H1). simpl.
  repeat rewrite (eq_dec_refl y0). repeat rewrite (eq_dec_refl y1). simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma Rename_FixPat_def : forall p' b' (D D':available_props),
  AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 D ->
  Rename FixPat FixDef p' b' D D' ->
  exists y, p' = a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Role Nom) (a_Var_f y)
         /\ b' = tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef /\ y <> FixVar2 /\ y `notin` D.
Proof.
  intros p' b' D D' HD H. unfold FixPat in H.
  inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  inversion H8; subst; try discriminate.
  inversion H1; subst; try discriminate.
  assert (Hy : y <> FixVar2) by fsetdec.
  assert (HyD : y `notin` D) by fsetdec.
  eexists; split; [reflexivity|split; [reflexivity|split; [exact Hy|exact HyD]]].
Qed.
Lemma Rename_FixPat_exists : forall (D:available_props),
  exists y p' b' D', y `notin` D /\ y <> FixVar2 /\
    p' = a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Role Nom) (a_Var_f y) /\
    b' = tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef /\
    Rename FixPat FixDef p' b' D D'.
Proof.
  intros D. destruct (atom_fresh (D `union` {{FixVar2}})) as [y Hy].
  assert (HyD : y `notin` D) by fsetdec.
  assert (Hyne : y <> FixVar2) by fsetdec.
  assert (Hlc : lc_tm FixDef) by (unfold FixDef; repeat constructor).
  exists y, (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Role Nom) (a_Var_f y)),
         (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef), (singleton y `union` empty).
  split; [exact HyD | split; [exact Hyne | split; [reflexivity | split; [reflexivity |]]]].
  apply (Rename_AppRel (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) Nom FixVar2 FixDef
                       (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) y FixDef D empty).
  - apply Rename_AppIrrel. apply Rename_Base. exact Hlc.
  - intro Hc; apply HyD. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc. destruct Hc as [Hc|Hc]; auto; fsetdec.
Qed.

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev.
Require Import LC.

(* covariable substitution preserves local closure at a level *)
Definition CUtm (a:tm) := forall k j (c:covar) (h:co),
  lc_co_at 0 0 h -> lc_tm_at k j a -> lc_tm_at k j (csubst_tm h c a).
Definition CUco (g:co) := forall k j (c:covar) (h:co),
  lc_co_at 0 0 h -> lc_co_at k j g -> lc_co_at k j (csubst_co h c g).
Definition CUbrs (b:brs) := forall k j (c:covar) (h:co),
  lc_co_at 0 0 h -> lc_brs_at k j b -> lc_brs_at k j (csubst_brs h c b).
Definition CUcs (p:constraint) := forall k j (c:covar) (h:co),
  lc_co_at 0 0 h -> lc_cs_at k j p -> lc_cs_at k j (csubst_constraint h c p).
Ltac solve_CU :=
  unfold CUtm, CUco, CUbrs, CUcs in *; intros; simpl in *;
  repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
  try (match goal with
       | |- lc_co_at ?k ?j (if eq_var ?d ?c then ?h else g_Var_f d) =>

           [ apply (lc_mono_co h 0 0 k j); [exact Hh|lia|lia] | trivial ]
       end);
  try (repeat split; eauto 8);
  try trivial.
Lemma CU_tm : forall a, CUtm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 CUcs CUtm CUbrs CUco). all: solve [solve_CU]. Qed.
Lemma CU_co : forall g, CUco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 CUcs CUtm CUbrs CUco). all: solve [solve_CU]. Qed.
Lemma CU_brs : forall b, CUbrs b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 CUcs CUtm CUbrs CUco). all: solve [solve_CU]. Qed.
Lemma CU_cs : forall p, CUcs p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 CUcs CUtm CUbrs CUco). all: solve [solve_CU]. Qed.
EOF

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev.
Require Import LC.
Require Import SO.
Require Import CS.

Lemma csubst_open_bvar_tm : forall k (b:tm) (c:covar) (h:co) n,
  csubst_tm h c (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k b (a_Var_b n))
  = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (csubst_tm h c b) (csubst_tm h c (a_Var_b n)).
Proof.
  intros. cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec csubst_tm].
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h1|h2]|h3]; cbn [csubst_tm]; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* locally closed objects are invariant under term opening at a high level *)
Definition OCtm (a:tm) := forall n j k (b:tm), lc_tm_at n j a -> n <= k ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k b a = a.
Definition OCco (g:co) := forall n j k (b:tm), lc_co_at n j g -> n <= k ->
  open_co_wrt_tm_rec k b g = g.
Definition OCbrs (q:brs) := forall n j k (b:tm), lc_brs_at n j q -> n <= k ->
  open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k b q = q.
Definition OCcs (p:constraint) := forall n j k (b:tm), lc_cs_at n j p -> n <= k ->
  open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k b p = p.
Ltac solve_OC :=
  intros; unfold OCtm, OCco, OCbrs, OCcs in *; try repeat intro; simpl in *;
  repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
  try (cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_co_wrt_tm_rec open_brs_wrt_tm_rec open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec]);
  try (match goal with |- context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?n ?k] =>
         destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h1|h2]|h3]; [reflexivity|lia|lia] end);
  try (match goal with
       | IH : forall n j k b, lc_tm_at n j ?a -> n <= k -> open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k b ?a = ?a
         |- open_tm_wrt_tm_rec ?K ?B ?a = ?a =>
           eapply IH; [eassumption | lia] end);
  try (match goal with
       | IH : forall n j k b, lc_co_at n j ?g -> n <= k -> open_co_wrt_tm_rec k b ?g = ?g
         |- open_co_wrt_tm_rec ?K ?B ?g = ?g =>
           eapply IH; [eassumption | lia] end);
  try (match goal with
       | IH : forall n j k b, lc_brs_at n j ?q -> n <= k -> open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k b ?q = ?q
         |- open_brs_wrt_tm_rec ?K ?B ?q = ?q =>
           eapply IH; [eassumption | lia] end);
  try (match goal with
       | IH : forall n j k b, lc_cs_at n j ?p -> n <= k -> open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k b ?p = ?p
         |- open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec ?K ?B ?p = ?p =>
           eapply IH; [eassumption | lia] end);
  try (repeat f_equal; eauto 8).
Lemma OC_tm : forall a, OCtm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 OCcs OCtm OCbrs OCco). all: solve [solve_OC]. Qed.
Lemma OC_co : forall g, OCco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 OCcs OCtm OCbrs OCco). all: solve [solve_OC]. Qed.
Lemma OC_brs : forall q, OCbrs q.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 OCcs OCtm OCbrs OCco). all: solve [solve_OC]. Qed.
Lemma OC_cs : forall p, OCcs p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 OCcs OCtm OCbrs OCco). all: solve [solve_OC]. Qed.
EOF

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev.
Require Import LC.
Require Import SO.
Require Import CS.

Lemma csubst_open_bvar_tm : forall k (b:tm) (c:covar) (h:co) n,
  csubst_tm h c (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k b (a_Var_b n))
  = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (csubst_tm h c b) (csubst_tm h c (a_Var_b n)).
Proof.
  intros. cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec csubst_tm].
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h1|h2]|h3]; cbn [csubst_tm]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition OCtm (a:tm) := forall n j k (b:tm), lc_tm_at n j a -> n <= k ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k b a = a.
Definition OCco (g:co) := forall n j k (b:tm), lc_co_at n j g -> n <= k ->
  open_co_wrt_tm_rec k b g = g.
Definition OCbrs (q:brs) := forall n j k (b:tm), lc_brs_at n j q -> n <= k ->
  open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k b q = q.
Definition OCcs (p:constraint) := forall n j k (b:tm), lc_cs_at n j p -> n <= k ->
  open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k b p = p.
Ltac solve_OC :=
  intros; unfold OCtm, OCco, OCbrs, OCcs in *; try repeat intro; simpl in *;
  repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
  cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_co_wrt_tm_rec open_brs_wrt_tm_rec open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec];
  try reflexivity;
  try (f_equal);
  try (match goal with |- context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?n ?k] =>
         destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h1|h2]|h3]; [reflexivity|lia|lia] end);
  try (match goal with
       | IH : OCtm ?a |- open_tm_wrt_tm_rec ?K ?B ?a = ?a =>
           eapply IH; [eassumption | lia] end);
  try (match goal with
       | IH : OCco ?g |- open_co_wrt_tm_rec ?K ?B ?g = ?g =>
           eapply IH; [eassumption | lia] end);
  try (match goal with
       | IH : OCbrs ?q |- open_brs_wrt_tm_rec ?K ?B ?q = ?q =>
           eapply IH; [eassumption | lia] end);
  try (match goal with
       | IH : OCcs ?p |- open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec ?K ?B ?p = ?p =>
           eapply IH; [eassumption | lia] end);
  try reflexivity;
  try (repeat f_equal; eauto 8).
Lemma OC_tm : forall a, OCtm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 OCcs OCtm OCbrs OCco). all: solve [solve_OC]. Qed.
Lemma OC_co : forall g, OCco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 OCcs OCtm OCbrs OCco). all: solve [solve_OC]. Qed.
Lemma OC_brs : forall q, OCbrs q.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 OCcs OCtm OCbrs OCco). all: solve [solve_OC]. Qed.
Lemma OC_cs : forall p, OCcs p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 OCcs OCtm OCbrs OCco). all: solve [solve_OC]. Qed.

cd /workspace; cat > PC.v <<'EOF'
Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev.
Require Import LC.
Require Import CS.
Require Import CS2.

(* csubst is the identity away from the substituted covariable *)
Definition CFtm (a:tm) := forall (c:covar) (h:co), c `notin` fcv_tm_tm_tm a -> csubst_tm h c a = a.
Definition CFco (g:co) := forall (c:covar) (h:co), c `notin` fcv_tm_tm_co g -> csubst_co h c g = g.
Definition CFbrs (q:brs) := forall (c:covar) (h:co), c `notin` fcv_tm_tm_brs q -> csubst_brs h c q = q.
Definition CFcs (p:constraint) := forall (c:covar) (h:co), c `notin` fcv_tm_tm_constraint p -> csubst_constraint h c p = p.
Ltac solve_CF :=
  intros; unfold CFtm, CFco, CFbrs, CFcs in *; try repeat intro; simpl in *;
  repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
  try (match goal with
       | H : ?c `notin` singleton ?d |- csubst_co ?h ?c (g_Var_f ?d) = g_Var_f ?d =>
           cbn [csubst_co]; destruct (eq_var c d) as [e|e];
           [exfalso; apply H; subst; fsetdec | reflexivity] end);
  try reflexivity;
  try (repeat f_equal; eauto 8).
Lemma CF_tm : forall a, CFtm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 CFcs CFtm CFbrs CFco). all: solve [solve_CF]. Qed.
Lemma CF_co : forall g, CFco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 CFcs CFtm CFbrs CFco). all: solve [solve_CF]. Qed.
Lemma CF_brs : forall q, CFbrs q.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 CFcs CFtm CFbrs CFco). all: solve [solve_CF]. Qed.
Lemma CF_cs : forall p, CFcs p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 CFcs CFtm CFbrs CFco). all: solve [solve_CF]. Qed.
EOF

(* csubst commutes with term substitution when the substituted covariable
   term does not capture the term variable *)
Lemma csubst_subst_varf : forall (u:tm) (x:tmvar) (c:covar) (h:co) (y:tmvar),
  csubst_tm h c (tm_subst_tm_tm u x (a_Var_f y))
  = tm_subst_tm_tm (csubst_tm h c u) x (csubst_tm h c (a_Var_f y)).
Proof.
  intros. cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm csubst_tm].
  destruct (eq_var y x) as [e|e]; cbn [csubst_tm]; reflexivity.
Qed.
Definition TCtm (a:tm) := forall (u:tm) (x:tmvar) (c:covar) (h:co),
  lc_co_at 0 0 h -> x `notin` fv_tm_tm_co h ->
  csubst_tm h c (tm_subst_tm_tm u x a)
  = tm_subst_tm_tm (csubst_tm h c u) x (csubst_tm h c a).
Definition TCco (g:co) := forall (u:tm) (x:tmvar) (c:covar) (h:co),
  lc_co_at 0 0 h -> x `notin` fv_tm_tm_co h ->
  csubst_co h c (tm_subst_tm_co u x g)
  = tm_subst_tm_co (csubst_tm h c u) x (csubst_co h c g).
Definition TCbrs (q:brs) := forall (u:tm) (x:tmvar) (c:covar) (h:co),
  lc_co_at 0 0 h -> x `notin` fv_tm_tm_co h ->
  csubst_brs h c (tm_subst_tm_brs u x q)
  = tm_subst_tm_brs (csubst_tm h c u) x (csubst_brs h c q).
Definition TCconstraint (p:constraint) := forall (u:tm) (x:tmvar) (c:covar) (h:co),
  lc_co_at 0 0 h -> x `notin` fv_tm_tm_co h ->
  csubst_constraint h c (tm_subst_tm_constraint u x p)
  = tm_subst_tm_constraint (csubst_tm h c u) x (csubst_constraint h c p).
Ltac solve_TC_comp :=
  first [ reflexivity
        | match goal with
          | IH : TCtm ?a |- csubst_tm ?h ?c (tm_subst_tm_tm ?U ?X ?a)
                          = tm_subst_tm_tm (csubst_tm ?h ?c ?U) ?X (csubst_tm ?h ?c ?a) =>
              eapply IH; eassumption end
        | match goal with
          | IH : TCco ?g |- csubst_co ?h ?c (tm_subst_tm_co ?U ?X ?g)
                          = tm_subst_tm_co (csubst_tm ?h ?c ?U) ?X (csubst_co ?h ?c ?g) =>
              eapply IH; eassumption end
        | match goal with
          | IH : TCbrs ?q |- csubst_brs ?h ?c (tm_subst_tm_brs ?U ?X ?q)
                          = tm_subst_tm_brs (csubst_tm ?h ?c ?U) ?X (csubst_brs ?h ?c ?q) =>
              eapply IH; eassumption end
        | match goal with
          | IH : TCconstraint ?p |- csubst_constraint ?h ?c (tm_subst_tm_constraint ?U ?X ?p)
                          = tm_subst_tm_constraint (csubst_tm ?h ?c ?U) ?X (csubst_constraint ?h ?c ?p) =>
              eapply IH; eassumption end
        | repeat f_equal; eauto 6 ].
Ltac solve_TC :=
  intros; unfold TCtm, TCco, TCbrs, TCconstraint in *; try repeat intro; simpl in *;
  try (apply csubst_subst_varf);
  try (match goal with
       | Hfx : ?x `notin` fv_tm_tm_co ?h
         |- csubst_co ?h ?c (tm_subst_tm_co ?u ?x (g_Var_f ?c0)) = _ =>
           cbn [csubst_co tm_subst_tm_co];
           destruct (eq_var c c0) as [e|e];
           [ symmetry; apply (subst_fresh_co h u x Hfx) | reflexivity ] end);
  cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm tm_subst_tm_co tm_subst_tm_brs tm_subst_tm_constraint
       csubst_tm csubst_co csubst_brs csubst_constraint];
  try reflexivity;
  try solve_TC_comp;
  try (f_equal; solve_TC_comp).
Lemma TC_tm : forall a, TCtm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 TCconstraint TCtm TCbrs TCco). all: solve [solve_TC]. Qed.
Lemma TC_co : forall g, TCco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 TCconstraint TCtm TCbrs TCco). all: solve [solve_TC]. Qed.
Lemma TC_brs : forall q, TCbrs q.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 TCconstraint TCtm TCbrs TCco). all: solve [solve_TC]. Qed.
Lemma TC_cs : forall p, TCconstraint p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 TCconstraint TCtm TCbrs TCco). all: solve [solve_TC]. Qed.
EOF

  lc_co_at 0 0 h -> lc_co_at k j (csubst_co h c g) -> lc_co_at k j g.
Definition RUbrs_c (q:brs) := forall k j (c:covar) (h:co),

Definition RUcs_c (p:constraint) := forall k j (c:covar) (h:co),

  intros; unfold RUtm_c, RUco_c, RUbrs_c, RUcs_c in *; try repeat intro; simpl in *;

Lemma RUc_cs : forall p, RUcs_c p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 RUcs_c RUtm_c RUbrs_c RUco_c). all: solve [solve_RU_c]. Qed.

Inductive Value : role -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn Value *)
 | Value_Star : forall (R:role),
     Value R a_Star
 | Value_Pi : forall (R:role) (rho:relflag) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi rho A B) ->
     Value R (a_Pi rho A B)
 | Value_CPi : forall (R:role) (phi:constraint) (B:tm),
     lc_constraint phi ->
     lc_tm (a_CPi phi B) ->
     Value R (a_CPi phi B)
 | Value_AbsRel : forall (R:role) (A a:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs Rel A a) ->
     Value R (a_Abs Rel A a)
 | Value_UAbsRel : forall (R:role) (a:tm),
     lc_tm (a_UAbs Rel a) ->
     Value R (a_UAbs Rel a)
 | Value_UAbsIrrel : forall (L:vars) (R:role) (a:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Value R  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Value R (a_UAbs Irrel a)
 | Value_CAbs : forall (R:role) (phi:constraint) (a:tm),
     lc_constraint phi ->
     lc_tm (a_CAbs phi a) ->
     Value R (a_CAbs phi a)
 | Value_UCAbs : forall (R:role) (a:tm),
     lc_tm (a_UCAbs a) ->
     Value R (a_UCAbs a)
 | Value_Path : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const),
     CasePath R a F ->
     Value R a.

(* defns JValueType *)
Inductive roleing : role_context -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn roleing *)
 | role_a_Bullet : forall (W:role_context) (R:role),
      uniq  W  ->
     roleing W a_Bullet R
 | role_a_Star : forall (W:role_context) (R:role),
      uniq  W  ->
     roleing W a_Star R
 | role_a_Var : forall (W:role_context) (x:tmvar) (R1 R:role),
      uniq  W  ->
      binds  x   R   W  ->
     SubRole R R1 ->
     roleing W (a_Var_f x) R1
 | role_a_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (rho:relflag) (a:tm) (R:role),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> roleing  (( x  ~  Nom ) ++  W )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_UAbs rho a) )  R
 | role_a_App : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     roleing W b Nom ->
     roleing W  ( (a_App a (Rho rho) b) )  R
 | role_a_TApp : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (R1:role) (b:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     roleing W b  (param R1   R )  ->
     roleing W (a_App a (Role R1) b) R
 | role_a_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (rho:relflag) (A B:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W A R ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> roleing  (( x  ~  Nom ) ++  W )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_Pi rho A B) )  R
 | role_a_CPi : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (a b A:tm) (R1:role) (B:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R1 ->
     roleing W b R1 ->
     roleing W A Rep ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> roleing W  ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_CPi (Eq a b A R1) B) )  R
 | role_a_CAbs : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (b:tm) (R:role),
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> roleing W  ( open_tm_wrt_co b (g_Var_f c) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_UCAbs b) )  R
 | role_a_CApp : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     roleing W  ( (a_CApp a g_Triv) )  R
 | role_a_Const : forall (W:role_context) (F:const) (R:role) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
      uniq  W  ->
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     roleing W (a_Fam F) R
 | role_a_Fam : forall (W:role_context) (F:const) (R1:role) (p a A:tm) (R:role) (Rs:roles),
      uniq  W  ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a A R Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     roleing W (a_Fam F) R1
 | role_a_Pattern : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2:tm) (R1:role),
     roleing W a Nom ->
     roleing W b1 R1 ->
     roleing W b2 R1 ->
     roleing W (a_Pattern Nom a F Apps5 b1 b2) R1.

(* defns JChk *)
Inductive RhoCheck : relflag -> tmvar -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn RhoCheck *)
 | Rho_Rel : forall (x:tmvar) (A:tm),
      True  ->
     RhoCheck Rel x A
 | Rho_IrrRel : forall (x:tmvar) (A:tm),
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x    (fv_tm_tm_tm  A )   ->
     RhoCheck Irrel x A.

(* defns Jpar *)
Inductive Par : role_context -> tm -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn Par *)
Inductive BranchTyping : context -> Apps -> role -> tm -> tm -> tm -> pattern_args -> tm -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn BranchTyping *)
 | BranchTyping_Base : forall (G:context) (a A b:tm) (pattern_args5:pattern_args) (C1 C2:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
     lc_tm A ->
      uniq  G  ->
      (  (open_tm_wrt_co  C1   g_Triv )   =  C2 )  ->
     BranchTyping G A_nil Nom a A b pattern_args5 A (a_CPi  ( (Eq a  (apply_pattern_args  b   pattern_args5 )  A Nom) )  C1) C2
 | BranchTyping_PiRole : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (R:role) (Apps5:Apps) (a A1 b:tm) (pattern_args5:pattern_args) (A B C C':tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> BranchTyping  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )  Apps5 Nom a A1 b  ( pattern_args5  ++ [  (p_Tm (Role R) (a_Var_f x))  ])   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_Var_f x) )  C' )  ->
     BranchTyping G  ( (A_cons (A_Tm (Role R)) Apps5) )  Nom a A1 b pattern_args5 (a_Pi Rel A B) (a_Pi Rel A C) C'
 | BranchTyping_PiRel : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (Apps5:Apps) (a A1 b:tm) (pattern_args5:pattern_args) (A B C C':tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> BranchTyping  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )  Apps5 Nom a A1 b  ( pattern_args5  ++ [  (p_Tm (Rho Rel) (a_Var_f x))  ])   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_Var_f x) )  C' )  ->
     BranchTyping G  ( (A_cons (A_Tm (Rho Rel)) Apps5) )  Nom a A1 b pattern_args5 (a_Pi Rel A B) (a_Pi Rel A C) C'
 | BranchTyping_PiIrrel : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (Apps5:Apps) (a A1 b:tm) (pattern_args5:pattern_args) (A B C C':tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> BranchTyping  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )  Apps5 Nom a A1 b  ( pattern_args5  ++ [  (p_Tm (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet)  ])   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_Var_f x) )  C' )  ->
     BranchTyping G  ( (A_cons (A_Tm (Rho Irrel)) Apps5) )  Nom a A1 b pattern_args5 (a_Pi Irrel A B) (a_Pi Irrel A C) C'
 | BranchTyping_CPi : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (Apps5:Apps) (a A b:tm) (pattern_args5:pattern_args) (phi:constraint) (B C C':tm),
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> BranchTyping  (( c ~ Co  phi ) ++  G )  Apps5 Nom a A b  ( pattern_args5  ++ [  (p_Co g_Triv)  ])   ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )   ( open_tm_wrt_co C (g_Var_f c) )  C' )  ->
     BranchTyping G  ( (A_cons A_Co Apps5) )  Nom a A b pattern_args5 (a_CPi phi B) (a_CPi phi C) C'.

(* defns Jett *)
Inductive PropWff : context -> constraint -> Prop :=    (* defn PropWff *)

# 190 — System DR: role-indexed type safety

## Task

Prove confluence of role-indexed parallel reduction, show that a reduction step preserves typing and establishes definitional equality at its reduction role, and prove progress under the stated irrelevance condition.

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `confluence`
- `reduction_preservation`
- `progress`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: Metalib.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.

- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.
# A dependency directory is named after its Rocq library (for example, Metalib).

Makefile.coq: _CoqProject Makefile

Lemma Par_subst : forall Wc a b R, Par Wc a b R ->
  forall W1 W2 (xx:tmvar) (rr:role) (uu vv:tm),
  Wc = W1 ++ (xx,rr) :: W2 -> Par (W1 ++ W2) uu vv rr ->
  Par (W1 ++ W2) (tm_subst_tm_tm uu xx a) (tm_subst_tm_tm vv xx b) R.

  - apply (roleing_par_subst (W1 ++ (xx,rr) :: W2) a R H W1 W2 xx rr uu vv eq_refl Hpair).

  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm].

(* ---- open/subst identity: substituting into an opened term ---- *)
Lemma open_subst_bvar_id : forall k (x:tmvar) (u:tm) n,
  tm_subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_b n)) = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u (a_Var_b n).
Proof.
  intros. cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec]. destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h1|h2]|h3]; cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (eq_var x x) as [e|ne]; [reflexivity | exfalso; apply ne; reflexivity].
  - reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma open_subst_varf_id : forall k (x y:tmvar) (u:tm), x <> y ->
  tm_subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f y)) = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u (a_Var_f y).
Proof. intros. cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec tm_subst_tm_tm]. destruct (eq_var y x) as [e|ne]; [exfalso; apply H; auto|reflexivity]. Qed.
Definition Utm (a:tm) := forall (k:nat) (x:tmvar) (u:tm), x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a ->
  tm_subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a) = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u a.
Definition Uco (g:co) := forall (k:nat) (x:tmvar) (u:tm), x `notin` fv_tm_tm_co g ->
  tm_subst_tm_co u x (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) g) = open_co_wrt_tm_rec k u g.
Definition Ubrs (b:brs) := forall (k:nat) (x:tmvar) (u:tm), x `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs b ->
  tm_subst_tm_brs u x (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b) = open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k u b.
Definition Ucs (phi:constraint) := forall (k:nat) (x:tmvar) (u:tm), x `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint phi ->
  tm_subst_tm_constraint u x (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) phi) = open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k u phi.
Ltac solve_openid :=
  unfold Utm, Uco, Ubrs, Ucs in *; intros;
  first [ apply open_subst_bvar_id
        | match goal with
          | |- tm_subst_tm_tm ?u ?x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec ?k (a_Var_f ?x) (a_Var_f ?y)) = _ =>
              apply open_subst_varf_id; simpl in *; fsetdec
          end
        | simpl in *; repeat f_equal; eauto ].
Lemma open_subst_id_tm : forall a, Utm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 Ucs Utm Ubrs Uco). all: solve [solve_openid]. Qed.
Lemma open_subst_id_co : forall g, Uco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 Ucs Utm Ubrs Uco). all: solve [solve_openid]. Qed.
Lemma open_subst_id_brs : forall b, Ubrs b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 Ucs Utm Ubrs Uco). all: solve [solve_openid]. Qed.
Lemma open_subst_id_cs : forall phi, Ucs phi.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 Ucs Utm Ubrs Uco). all: solve [solve_openid]. Qed.
Lemma open_subst_tm_id : forall a (x:tmvar) (u:tm), x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a ->
  tm_subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) a) = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 u a.
Proof. intros a x u H. apply (open_subst_id_tm a 0 x u H). Qed.
Lemma open_csubst_bvar_id : forall k (c:covar) (h:co) n,
  csubst_co h c (open_co_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f c) (g_Var_b n)) = open_co_wrt_co_rec k h (g_Var_b n).
Proof.
  intros. cbn [open_co_wrt_co_rec]. destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h1|h2]|h3]; cbn [csubst_co].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (eq_var c c) as [e|ne]; [reflexivity | exfalso; apply ne; reflexivity].
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

The semicolon `try (inversion ...; ...; fail)` applies to all goals generated by induction? `induction H1; intros zz Hp2; try (...)`—the `try` tactic is applied to each of the 15 goals generated by induction, but `intros zz Hp2` before `try` applied to all? Coq's `;` sequencing: `induction; intros; try(...)` applies to all 15 goals. Within try, `inversion Hp2; subst; try discriminate; try match; fail "stop"`—the `inversion; subst; try discriminate` may generate many subgoals, and then the `try match ...; fail` sequence applies only to the *first* goal? In Ltac, `t1; t2` applies t2 to all subgoals of t1, and `try match...; fail` is itself a compound? Parsing `try (A; B; C; D; E)` where C=`try discriminate`, D=`try match`, E=`fail`: the whole parenthesized compound is applied to each goal entering try. Does `try` apply the compound to all goals? The compound's first tactic inversion transforms the goal into many; then remaining tactics in the compound are applied to all resulting goals. But `fail` at end would fail for every goal, causing the try to fail globally. Yet we saw one print per H1, not per subgoal. Maybe `match ... |- ?G => idtac` only printed for one because `try match` without semicolon applies to first goal only, then fail first goal, and try backtracks whole compound leaving all original inversion subgoals? Let's instead use `all:` properly. In Ltac, to apply to all goals use `all: <tactic>` command. Write:

induction H1; intros zz Hp2.
all: try (inversion Hp2; subst; try discriminate).
all: try (match goal with |- ?G => idtac "LEFT:" G end).
Abort.
```
But `all: try match` applies match to every goal; `match` prints each. Note no inline fail. Let's do.

PatternTrue/False premise names likely H1_, H1_0, H1_1 plus path etc. We'll handle later.

Let's now write a real proof skeleton with H1 Refl handled and H1 AxiomBase dead, then per case inversion H2 and use a combination of automated easy tactics + hand.

First, handle H1 Refl:
```
- (* Refl *) exists zz; split; [exact Hp2 | apply Par_Refl; exact (proj2 (Par_roleing _ _ _ _ Hp2))].
```
Need Hp2 names but in Refl case it's Hp2, zz.

H1 Beta case: premises names H1_ (Par a UAbs), H1_0 (Par b b'), IHs IHPar1/IHPar2, target open a' b'. Do:
```
- inversion Hp2; subst; try discriminate.
  + (* H2 Refl *) exists (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b'); split.
    * apply Par_Refl. exact (proj2 (Par_roleing _ _ _ _ ??? H1 reconstruction)).
```
We need reconstruct H1 as Par W (App a (Rho rho) b) (open a' b') R. We can do `assert (Hbeta : Par W (a_App a (Rho rho) b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b') R) by (eapply Par_Beta; eauto).` Then use it. But after `inversion Hp2; subst`, some variables may be renamed/substituted; premises H1_ remain. We can reconstruct before inversion:
`assert (Hpar1 : Par W (a_App a (Rho rho) b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b') R) by (eapply Par_Beta; eauto).`
Similarly H1 target known.

Actually after inversion Hp2, the Refl case goal has `exists b, Par W (open a' b') b R /\ Par W (a_App a (Rho rho) b) b R` (goal15). Choose open a' b'. Split: Par open open via Par_Refl roleing target from Hpar1; Par App open = Hpar1. Good.

Beta/Beta case goal16 (index after Refl bullet from H2 inversion: H2 Refl first then Beta etc.). After inversion Hp2 with subst, variables like a0' etc. Let's see by compiling and printing one case; but we can reason:
H2 Beta premises: `Par W a (a_UAbs rho a0') R` and `Par W b b0' Nom`, target open a0' b0'. Inversion substitutes source equalities: a=a, rho=rho, b=b; H2 premises available as new Hyps (let's call them H??; auto names from inversion, likely H5/H6). Goal: exists c, Par W (open a' b') c R /\ Par W (open a0' b0') c R.
IHPar1 applied to H2 fun premise gives J1: exists c, Par W (UAbs rho a') c R /\ Par W (UAbs rho a0') c R.
IHPar2 applied to H2 arg premise gives J2: exists c, Par W b' c Nom /\ Par W b0' c Nom.
Then destruct J1 as [u [U1 U2]], destruct J2 as [v [V1 V2]].
Par_UAbs_body on U1 (Par (UAbs rho a')(? u) R) gives u = UAbs rho a'' and body Par1 for a'/a''; similarly U2 for a0'/a''.
Par_UAbs_inst W rho a' a'' b' v R U1 V1? Wait U1 is Par (UAbs rho a') u R; after destruct body, U1 can be rewritten to Par (UAbs rho a') (UAbs rho a'') R. Need body Par from Par_UAbs_body U1. Then Par_UAbs_inst with Par a' a'' and Par b' v Nom yields Par (open a' b') (open a'' v) R. Similarly U2 with b0'/v yields Par (open a0' b0') (open a'' v) R. Choose b = open a'' v. Good.
Need extract a''. `destruct (Par_UAbs_body W rho a' u R U1) as [a'' [L [E Hb1]]]; inversion E; subst u.` Then U1 rewritten? inversion E substitutes u=a_UAbs; yes if E : u = UAbs..., subst. But U1 : Par ... u R becomes Par ... (UAbs...) after subst u. Then use.
For U2, `destruct (Par_UAbs_body ...) as [a3 [L2 [E2 Hb2]]]; inversion E2; subst;` but must prove a3=a''. Since both are UAbs targets of U2: E2? Par_UAbs_body U2 returns u = UAbs rho a3 where u is the same u. After u already substituted to UAbs rho a'', E2 : UAbs rho a'' = UAbs rho a3; inversion E2; subst a3. Then IHs.
Then:
`exists (open_tm_wrt_tm a'' v); split; [apply (Par_UAbs_inst W rho a' a'' b' v R U1 V1) | apply (Par_UAbs_inst W rho a0' a'' b0' v R U2 V2)]`.
Role for Par_UAbs_inst is R; V1 role Nom; fine.

Names of H2 premises after inversion: We can use `match goal with H2f : Par W a (a_UAbs rho ?a0') R, H2a : Par W b ?b0' Nom |- _ => ... end`. But `a` might be substituted? Use patterns. Let's write with match to bind. The IHPar1 expects Par W a ? ; match formula:
```
match goal with
| H2f : Par W a (a_UAbs rho ?a0') R, H2a : Par W b ?b0' Nom |- _ =>

with csubst_tm (h:co) (c:covar) (a:tm) : tm :=
  match a with
  | a_Star => a_Star
  | a_Var_b n => a_Var_b n
  | a_Var_f y => a_Var_f y
  | a_Abs rho A b => a_Abs rho (csubst_tm h c A) (csubst_tm h c b)
  | a_UAbs rho b => a_UAbs rho (csubst_tm h c b)
  | a_App a nu b => a_App (csubst_tm h c a) nu (csubst_tm h c b)
  | a_Pi rho A B => a_Pi rho (csubst_tm h c A) (csubst_tm h c B)
  | a_CAbs phi b => a_CAbs (csubst_constraint h c phi) (csubst_tm h c b)
  | a_UCAbs b => a_UCAbs (csubst_tm h c b)
  | a_CApp a g => a_CApp (csubst_tm h c a) (csubst_co h c g)
  | a_CPi phi B => a_CPi (csubst_constraint h c phi) (csubst_tm h c B)
  | a_Conv a R g => a_Conv (csubst_tm h c a) R (csubst_co h c g)
  | a_Fam F => a_Fam F
  | a_Bullet => a_Bullet
  | a_Pattern R a F Apps5 b1 b2 => a_Pattern R (csubst_tm h c a) F Apps5 (csubst_tm h c b1) (csubst_tm h c b2)
  | a_DataCon K => a_DataCon K
  | a_Case a brs5 => a_Case (csubst_tm h c a) (csubst_brs h c brs5)
  | a_Sub R a => a_Sub R (csubst_tm h c a)
  | a_Coerce => a_Coerce
  | a_SrcApp a b => a_SrcApp (csubst_tm h c a) (csubst_tm h c b)
  end.

Lemma open_co_csubst_var : forall k c d e,
  open_co_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f d)
    (if eq_var c e then g_Var_b k else g_Var_f e)
  = (if eq_var c e then g_Var_f d else g_Var_f e).
Proof. intros. destruct (eq_var c e) as [e1|n1]; cbn. - apply open_co_bvar_eq. - reflexivity. Qed.
Definition Stm_C (a:tm) := forall k c d,
  open_tm_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f d) (close_tm_wrt_co_rec k c a) = csubst_tm (g_Var_f d) c a.
Definition Sco_C (g:co) := forall k c d,
  open_co_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f d) (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g) = csubst_co (g_Var_f d) c g.
Definition Sbrs_C (b:brs) := forall k c d,
  open_brs_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f d) (close_brs_wrt_co_rec k c b) = csubst_brs (g_Var_f d) c b.
Definition Scs_C (phi:constraint) := forall k c d,
  open_constraint_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f d) (close_constraint_wrt_co_rec k c phi) = csubst_constraint (g_Var_f d) c phi.
Ltac solve_sC :=
  unfold Stm_C, Sco_C, Sbrs_C, Scs_C; intros; simpl;
  (try rewrite open_co_shift); (try rewrite open_co_csubst_var);
  try solve [repeat f_equal; eauto]; auto.
Lemma open_close_subst_tm_C : forall a, Stm_C a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 Scs_C Stm_C Sbrs_C Sco_C). all: solve [solve_sC]. Qed.
Lemma open_close_subst_co_C : forall g, Sco_C g.

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev.
Require Import LC.

(* the variable case of substitution composition *)
Lemma subst_subst_var_f : forall (s u:tm) (y x z:tmvar),
  x <> y -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm u ->
  tm_subst_tm_tm u x (tm_subst_tm_tm s y (a_Var_f z))
  = tm_subst_tm_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm u x s) y (tm_subst_tm_tm u x (a_Var_f z)).
Proof.
  intros s u y x z Hne Hy. cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm].
  destruct (eq_var z x) as [e2|e2].
  - subst z. destruct (eq_var x y) as [e1|e1]; [exfalso;apply Hne;exact e1|].
    cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. destruct (eq_var x x) as [ex|ex]; [|exfalso;apply ex;reflexivity].
    cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm].
    rewrite (subst_fresh_tm u (tm_subst_tm_tm u x s) y Hy). reflexivity.
  - destruct (eq_var z y) as [e1|e1].
    + subst z. cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm].
      destruct (eq_var y y) as [ey|ey]; [|exfalso;apply ey;reflexivity].
      cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. reflexivity.
    + cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm].
      destruct (eq_var z y) as [e1'|e1']; [exfalso;apply e1;exact e1'|].
      destruct (eq_var z x) as [e2'|e2']; [exfalso;apply e2;exact e2'|].
      cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. reflexivity.
Qed.

with tm_subst_tm_constraint (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (phi5:constraint) {struct phi5} : constraint :=
  match phi5 with
  | (Eq a b A R) => Eq (tm_subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (tm_subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b) (tm_subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) R
end.

Definition min (r1 : role) (r2 : role) : role :=
  match r1 , r2 with
  | Nom, _   => Nom
  | _  , Nom => Nom
  | Rep, Rep => Rep
  end.

Definition param (r1 : role) (r2 : role) := min r1 r2.

Definition app_role (rr : appflag) (r1 : role) : role :=
  match rr with
  | Rho _ => Nom
  | Role r => param r r1
  end.

Fixpoint apply_pattern_args (a : tm) (args : pattern_args) : tm :=
  match args with
  | nil => a
  | (p_Tm nu b :: rest) =>
    apply_pattern_args (a_App a nu b) rest
  | (p_Co g :: rest) =>
    apply_pattern_args (a_CApp a g) rest
  end.

Fixpoint A_snoc (xs : Apps) (x : App)  : Apps :=
  match xs with
  | A_nil => A_cons x A_nil
  | A_cons y ys => (A_cons y (A_snoc ys x))
  end.

Definition Star : atom := proj1_sig (atom_fresh empty).
Definition Fix : atom := proj1_sig (atom_fresh (singleton Star)).
Definition FixVar1 : atom := proj1_sig (atom_fresh (singleton Star \u singleton Fix)).
Definition FixVar2 : atom := proj1_sig (atom_fresh (singleton Star \u singleton Fix \u singleton FixVar1)).

Definition FixPat : tm := a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Role Nom) (a_Var_f FixVar2).

Definition FixDef : tm := a_App (a_Var_f FixVar2) (Rho Rel)
                              (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) (a_Var_f FixVar2)).

Definition FixTy : tm  := a_Pi Irrel a_Star
                             (a_Pi Rel (a_Pi Rel (a_Var_b 0) (a_Var_b 1)) (a_Var_b 1)).

Definition toplevel : sig := Fix ~ Ax FixPat FixDef FixTy Nom [Nom].

(** definitions *)

(* defns JSubRole *)
Inductive SubRole : role -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn SubRole *)
 | NomBot : forall (R:role),
     SubRole Nom R
 | RepTop : forall (R:role),
     SubRole R Rep
 | Refl : forall (R:role),
     SubRole R R
 | Trans : forall (R1 R3 R2:role),
     SubRole R1 R2 ->
     SubRole R2 R3 ->
     SubRole R1 R3.

(* defns JRolePath *)
Inductive RolePath : tm -> roles -> Prop :=    (* defn RolePath *)
 | RolePath_AbsConst : forall (F:const) (Rs:roles) (A:tm),
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     RolePath (a_Fam F) Rs
 | RolePath_Const : forall (F:const) (Rs:roles) (p a A:tm) (R1:role),
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     RolePath (a_Fam F) Rs
 | RolePath_TApp : forall (a:tm) (R1:role) (b:tm) (Rs:roles),
     lc_tm b ->
     RolePath a  ( R1 :: Rs )  ->
     RolePath (a_App a (Role R1) b) Rs
 | RolePath_App : forall (a b:tm) (Rs:roles),
     lc_tm b ->
     RolePath a  ( Nom :: Rs )  ->
     RolePath (a_App a (Rho Rel) b) Rs
 | RolePath_IApp : forall (a:tm) (Rs:roles),
     RolePath a Rs ->
     RolePath (a_App a (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) Rs
 | RolePath_CApp : forall (a:tm) (Rs:roles),
     RolePath a Rs ->
     RolePath (a_CApp a g_Triv) Rs.

(* defns JAppsPath *)
Inductive AppsPath : role -> tm -> const -> Apps -> Prop :=    (* defn AppsPath *)
 | AppsPath_AbsConst : forall (R:role) (F:const) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     AppsPath R (a_Fam F) F A_nil
 | AppsPath_Const : forall (R:role) (F:const) (p a A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      not (  ( SubRole R1 R )  )  ->
     AppsPath R (a_Fam F) F A_nil
 | AppsPath_App : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (R1:role) (b':tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps),
     lc_tm b' ->
     AppsPath R a F Apps5 ->
     AppsPath R  ( (a_App a (Role R1) b') )  F  (  (A_snoc  Apps5   (A_Tm (Role R1)) )  )
 | AppsPath_IApp : forall (R:role) (a b:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps),
     lc_tm b ->
     AppsPath R a F Apps5 ->
     AppsPath R  ( (a_App a (Rho Irrel) b) )  F  (  (A_snoc  Apps5   (A_Tm (Rho Irrel)) )  )
 | AppsPath_CApp : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps),
     AppsPath R a F Apps5 ->
     AppsPath R  ( (a_CApp a g_Triv) )  F  (  (A_snoc  Apps5   A_Co )  ) .

(* defns JSat *)
Inductive AppRoles : Apps -> roles -> Prop :=    (* defn AppRoles *)
 | AR_nil :
     AppRoles A_nil  nil
 | AR_consTApp : forall (R1:role) (Apps5:Apps) (Rs:roles),
     AppRoles Apps5 Rs ->
     AppRoles (A_cons (A_Tm (Role R1)) Apps5)  ( R1 :: Rs )
 | AR_consApp : forall (Apps5:Apps) (Rs:roles),
     AppRoles Apps5 Rs ->
     AppRoles (A_cons (A_Tm (Rho Rel)) Apps5)  ( Nom :: Rs )
 | AR_consIApp : forall (Apps5:Apps) (Rs:roles),
     AppRoles Apps5 Rs ->
     AppRoles (A_cons (A_Tm (Rho Irrel)) Apps5) Rs
 | AR_consCApp : forall (Apps5:Apps) (Rs:roles),
     AppRoles Apps5 Rs ->
     AppRoles (A_cons A_Co Apps5) Rs
with SatApp : const -> Apps -> Prop :=    (* defn SatApp *)
 | Sat_Const : forall (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     AppRoles Apps5 Rs ->
     SatApp F Apps5
 | Sat_Axiom : forall (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (p a0 A1:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a0 A1 R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      not (  ( SubRole R1 Nom )  )  ->
     AppRoles Apps5 Rs ->
     SatApp F Apps5.

(* defns JPatCtx *)
Inductive Rename : tm -> tm -> tm -> tm -> available_props -> available_props -> Prop :=    (* defn Rename *)
 | Rename_Base : forall (F:const) (a:tm) (D:available_props),
     lc_tm a ->
     Rename (a_Fam F) a (a_Fam F) a D  AtomSetImpl.empty
 | Rename_AppRel : forall (p1:tm) (R:role) (x:tmvar) (a1 p2:tm) (y:tmvar) (a2:tm) (D D':available_props),
     Rename p1 a1 p2 a2 D D' ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  y    (  ( D  `union`  D' )  )   ->
     Rename  ( (a_App p1 (Role R) (a_Var_f x)) )  a1  ( (a_App p2 (Role R) (a_Var_f y)) )   (  (tm_subst_tm_tm  (a_Var_f y)   x   a2 )  )  D  (  (singleton  y  \u  D' )  )
 | Rename_AppIrrel : forall (p1 a1 p2 a2:tm) (D D':available_props),
     Rename p1 a1 p2 a2 D D' ->
     Rename  ( (a_App p1 (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) )  a1  ( (a_App p2 (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) )  a2 D D'
 | Rename_CApp : forall (p1 a1 p2 a2:tm) (D D':available_props),
     Rename p1 a1 p2 a2 D D' ->
     Rename  ( (a_CApp p1 g_Triv) )  a1  ( (a_CApp p2 g_Triv) )  a2 D D'.

(* defns JMatchSubst *)
Inductive MatchSubst : tm -> tm -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn MatchSubst *)
 | MatchSubst_Const : forall (F:const) (b:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     MatchSubst (a_Fam F) (a_Fam F) b b
 | MatchSubst_AppRelR : forall (a1:tm) (R:role) (a p1:tm) (x:tmvar) (b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     MatchSubst a1 p1 b1 b2 ->
     MatchSubst  ( (a_App a1 (Role R) a) )   ( (a_App p1 (Role R) (a_Var_f x)) )  b1  (  (tm_subst_tm_tm  a   x   b2 )  )
 | MatchSubst_AppIrrel : forall (a1 a p1 b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     MatchSubst a1 p1 b1 b2 ->
     MatchSubst  ( (a_App a1 (Rho Irrel) a) )   ( (a_App p1 (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) )  b1 b2
 | MatchSubst_CApp : forall (a1 a2 b1 b2:tm),
     MatchSubst a1 a2 b1 b2 ->
     MatchSubst  ( (a_CApp a1 g_Triv) )   ( (a_CApp a2 g_Triv) )  b1 b2.

(* defns JIsPattern *)
Inductive tm_pattern_agree : tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn tm_pattern_agree *)
 | tm_pattern_agree_Const : forall (F:const),
     tm_pattern_agree (a_Fam F) (a_Fam F)
 | tm_pattern_agree_AppRelR : forall (a1:tm) (R:role) (a2 p1:tm) (x:tmvar),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     tm_pattern_agree a1 p1 ->
     tm_pattern_agree  ( (a_App a1 (Role R) a2) )   ( (a_App p1 (Role R) (a_Var_f x)) )
 | tm_pattern_agree_AppIrrel : forall (a1 a p1:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     tm_pattern_agree a1 p1 ->
     tm_pattern_agree  ( (a_App a1 (Rho Irrel) a) )   ( (a_App p1 (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) )
 | tm_pattern_agree_CApp : forall (a1 p1:tm),
     tm_pattern_agree a1 p1 ->
     tm_pattern_agree  ( (a_CApp a1 g_Triv) )   ( (a_CApp p1 g_Triv) ) .

(* defns JTmSubPatternAgree *)
Inductive tm_subpattern_agree : tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn tm_subpattern_agree *)
 | tm_subpattern_agree_Base : forall (a p:tm),
     tm_pattern_agree a p ->
     tm_subpattern_agree a p
 | tm_subpattern_agree_AppRelR : forall (a p:tm) (R:role) (x:tmvar),
     tm_subpattern_agree a p ->
     tm_subpattern_agree a  ( (a_App p (Role R) (a_Var_f x)) )
 | tm_subpattern_agree_AppIrrel : forall (a p:tm),
     tm_subpattern_agree a p ->
     tm_subpattern_agree a  ( (a_App p (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) )
 | tm_subpattern_agree_CAppp : forall (a p:tm),
     tm_subpattern_agree a p ->
     tm_subpattern_agree a  ( (a_CApp p g_Triv) ) .

(* defns JSubTmPatternAgree *)
Inductive subtm_pattern_agree : tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn subtm_pattern_agree *)
 | subtm_pattern_agree_Base : forall (a p:tm),
     tm_pattern_agree a p ->
     subtm_pattern_agree a p
 | subtm_pattern_agree_App : forall (a:tm) (nu:appflag) (a2 p:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     subtm_pattern_agree a p ->
     subtm_pattern_agree (a_App a nu a2) p
 | subtm_pattern_agree_CAppp : forall (a p:tm),
     subtm_pattern_agree a p ->
     subtm_pattern_agree (a_CApp a g_Triv) p.

(* defns JValuePath *)
Inductive ValuePath : tm -> const -> Prop :=    (* defn ValuePath *)
 | ValuePath_AbsConst : forall (F:const) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     ValuePath (a_Fam F) F
 | ValuePath_Const : forall (F:const) (p a A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     ValuePath (a_Fam F) F
 | ValuePath_App : forall (a:tm) (nu:appflag) (b':tm) (F:const),
     lc_tm b' ->
     ValuePath a F ->
     ValuePath  ( (a_App a nu b') )  F
 | ValuePath_CApp : forall (a:tm) (F:const),
     ValuePath a F ->
     ValuePath  ( (a_CApp a g_Triv) )  F.

(* defns JCasePath *)
Inductive CasePath : role -> tm -> const -> Prop :=    (* defn CasePath *)
 | CasePath_AbsConst : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
     ValuePath a F ->
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     CasePath R a F
 | CasePath_Const : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (p b A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
     ValuePath a F ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p b A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      not (  ( SubRole R1 R )  )  ->
     CasePath R a F
 | CasePath_UnMatch : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (p b A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
     ValuePath a F ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p b A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      not (  ( subtm_pattern_agree a p )  )  ->
     CasePath R a F.

(* defns JApplyArgs *)
Inductive ApplyArgs : tm -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn ApplyArgs *)
 | ApplyArgs_Const : forall (F:const) (b:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     ApplyArgs (a_Fam F) b b
 | ApplyArgs_AppRole : forall (a:tm) (R:role) (a' b b':tm),
     lc_tm a' ->
     ApplyArgs a b b' ->
     ApplyArgs  ( (a_App a (Role R) a') )  b  ( (a_App b' (Rho Rel) a') )
 | ApplyArgs_AppRho : forall (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (a' b b':tm),
     lc_tm a' ->
     ApplyArgs a b b' ->
     ApplyArgs  ( (a_App a (Rho rho) a') )  b  ( (a_App b' (Rho rho) a') )
 | ApplyArgs_CApp : forall (a b b':tm),
     ApplyArgs a b b' ->
     ApplyArgs (a_CApp a g_Triv) b (a_CApp b' g_Triv).

(* defns JValue *)
Inductive Value : role -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn Value *)
 | Value_Star : forall (R:role),
     Value R a_Star
 | Value_Pi : forall (R:role) (rho:relflag) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi rho A B) ->
     Value R (a_Pi rho A B)
 | Value_CPi : forall (R:role) (phi:constraint) (B:tm),
     lc_constraint phi ->
     lc_tm (a_CPi phi B) ->
     Value R (a_CPi phi B)
 | Value_AbsRel : forall (R:role) (A a:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs Rel A a) ->
     Value R (a_Abs Rel A a)
 | Value_UAbsRel : forall (R:role) (a:tm),
     lc_tm (a_UAbs Rel a) ->
     Value R (a_UAbs Rel a)
 | Value_UAbsIrrel : forall (L:vars) (R:role) (a:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Value R  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Value R (a_UAbs Irrel a)
 | Value_CAbs : forall (R:role) (phi:constraint) (a:tm),
     lc_constraint phi ->
     lc_tm (a_CAbs phi a) ->
     Value R (a_CAbs phi a)
 | Value_UCAbs : forall (R:role) (a:tm),
     lc_tm (a_UCAbs a) ->
     Value R (a_UCAbs a)
 | Value_Path : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const),
     CasePath R a F ->
     Value R a.

(* defns JValueType *)
Inductive roleing : role_context -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn roleing *)
 | role_a_Bullet : forall (W:role_context) (R:role),
      uniq  W  ->
     roleing W a_Bullet R
 | role_a_Star : forall (W:role_context) (R:role),
      uniq  W  ->
     roleing W a_Star R
 | role_a_Var : forall (W:role_context) (x:tmvar) (R1 R:role),
      uniq  W  ->
      binds  x   R   W  ->
     SubRole R R1 ->
     roleing W (a_Var_f x) R1
 | role_a_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (rho:relflag) (a:tm) (R:role),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> roleing  (( x  ~  Nom ) ++  W )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_UAbs rho a) )  R
 | role_a_App : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     roleing W b Nom ->
     roleing W  ( (a_App a (Rho rho) b) )  R
 | role_a_TApp : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (R1:role) (b:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     roleing W b  (param R1   R )  ->
     roleing W (a_App a (Role R1) b) R
 | role_a_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (rho:relflag) (A B:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W A R ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> roleing  (( x  ~  Nom ) ++  W )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_Pi rho A B) )  R
 | role_a_CPi : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (a b A:tm) (R1:role) (B:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R1 ->
     roleing W b R1 ->
     roleing W A Rep ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> roleing W  ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_CPi (Eq a b A R1) B) )  R
 | role_a_CAbs : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (b:tm) (R:role),
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> roleing W  ( open_tm_wrt_co b (g_Var_f c) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_UCAbs b) )  R
 | role_a_CApp : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     roleing W  ( (a_CApp a g_Triv) )  R
 | role_a_Const : forall (W:role_context) (F:const) (R:role) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
      uniq  W  ->
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     roleing W (a_Fam F) R
 | role_a_Fam : forall (W:role_context) (F:const) (R1:role) (p a A:tm) (R:role) (Rs:roles),
      uniq  W  ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a A R Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     roleing W (a_Fam F) R1
 | role_a_Pattern : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2:tm) (R1:role),
     roleing W a Nom ->
     roleing W b1 R1 ->
     roleing W b2 R1 ->
     roleing W (a_Pattern Nom a F Apps5 b1 b2) R1.

(* defns JChk *)
Inductive RhoCheck : relflag -> tmvar -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn RhoCheck *)
 | Rho_Rel : forall (x:tmvar) (A:tm),
      True  ->
     RhoCheck Rel x A
 | Rho_IrrRel : forall (x:tmvar) (A:tm),
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x    (fv_tm_tm_tm  A )   ->
     RhoCheck Irrel x A.

(* defns Jpar *)
Inductive Par : role_context -> tm -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn Par *)
 | Par_Refl : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     Par W a a R
 | Par_Beta : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b a' b':tm) (R:role),
     Par W a  ( (a_UAbs rho a') )  R ->
     Par W b b' Nom ->
     Par W (a_App a (Rho rho) b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )  R
 | Par_App : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (nu:appflag) (b a' b':tm) (R:role),
     Par W a a' R ->
     Par W b b'  (  app_role  nu   R  )  ->
     Par W (a_App a nu b) (a_App a' nu b') R
 | Par_CBeta : forall (W:role_context) (a a':tm) (R:role),
     Par W a  ( (a_UCAbs a') )  R ->
     Par W (a_CApp a g_Triv)  (open_tm_wrt_co  a'   g_Triv )  R
 | Par_CApp : forall (W:role_context) (a a':tm) (R:role),
     Par W a a' R ->
     Par W (a_CApp a g_Triv) (a_CApp a' g_Triv) R
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (rho:relflag) (a a':tm) (R:role),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (( x  ~  Nom ) ++  W )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     Par W (a_UAbs rho a) (a_UAbs rho a') R
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (rho:relflag) (A B A' B':tm) (R:role),
     Par W A A' R ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (( x  ~  Nom ) ++  W )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     Par W (a_Pi rho A B) (a_Pi rho A' B') R

     MatchSubst  ( (a_App a' nu a1') )  p' b' a2 ->

     Par W a a' R ->

     MatchSubst  ( (a_CApp a' g_Triv) )  p' b' a2 ->

 | Par_PatternTrue : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2 b:tm) (R0:role) (a' b1' b2':tm) (Apps':Apps),
     Par W a a' Nom ->

 | Par_PatternFalse : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2 b2':tm) (R0:role) (a' b1':tm),
     Par W a a' Nom ->

Require Import Language.
