Lemma roleing_UAbs_open : forall W (rho:relflag) (a:tm) R,
  roleing W (a_UAbs rho a) R ->
  exists L, forall x, x `notin` L -> roleing ((x ~ Nom) ++ W) (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) R.
Proof. intros W rho a R H. inversion H; subst. eexists; eauto. Qed.

Lemma Par_UAbs_body : forall W (rho:relflag) (a b:tm) R,
  Par W (a_UAbs rho a) b R ->
  exists (a':tm) L, b = a_UAbs rho a' /\
    (forall x, x `notin` L -> Par ((x ~ Nom) ++ W) (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x)) R).
Proof.
  intros W rho a b R H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - match goal with Hr : roleing W (a_UAbs rho a) R |- _ =>
      destruct (roleing_UAbs_open W rho a R Hr) as [L HL];
      eexists a, L; split; [reflexivity|]; intros x Hx; apply Par_Refl; apply (HL x Hx)
    end.
  - eauto.
Qed.

Lemma roleing_UCAbs_open : forall W (a:tm) R,
  roleing W (a_UCAbs a) R ->
  exists L, forall c, c `notin` L -> roleing W (open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f c)) R.
Proof. intros W a R H. inversion H; subst. eexists; eauto. Qed.

Lemma Par_UCAbs_body : forall W (a b:tm) R,
  Par W (a_UCAbs a) b R ->
  exists (a':tm) L, b = a_UCAbs a' /\
    (forall c, c `notin` L -> Par W (open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f c)) (open_tm_wrt_co a' (g_Var_f c)) R).
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - match goal with Hr : roleing W (a_UCAbs a) R |- _ =>
      destruct (roleing_UCAbs_open W a R Hr) as [L HL];
      eexists a, L; split; [reflexivity|]; intros c Hc; apply Par_Refl; apply (HL c Hc)
    end.
  - eauto.
Qed.

Lemma pattern_agree_not_UAbs : forall (a p:tm), tm_pattern_agree a p ->
  forall (rho:relflag) (b:tm), a <> a_UAbs rho b.
Proof.
  intros a p H. induction H; intros rho b Heq; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma subpattern_agree_UAbs_absurd : forall (rho:relflag) (a p:tm),
  tm_subpattern_agree (a_UAbs rho a) p -> False.
Proof.
  intros rho a p H. remember (a_UAbs rho a) as u eqn:Eu. revert a rho Eu.
  induction H as [u p0 Hpa | u p0 R x Hsub IH | u p0 Hsub IH | u p0 Hsub IH];
    intros a rho Eu.
  - subst u. exact (pattern_agree_not_UAbs (a_UAbs rho a) p0 Hpa rho a eq_refl).
  - exact (IH a rho Eu).
  - exact (IH a rho Eu).
  - exact (IH a rho Eu).
Qed.

Lemma pattern_agree_not_UCAbs : forall (a p:tm), tm_pattern_agree a p ->
  forall (b:tm), a <> a_UCAbs b.
Proof.
  intros a p H. induction H; intros b Heq; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma subpattern_agree_UCAbs_absurd : forall (a p:tm),
  tm_subpattern_agree (a_UCAbs a) p -> False.
Proof.
  intros a p H. remember (a_UCAbs a) as u eqn:Eu. revert a Eu.
  induction H as [u p0 Hpa | u p0 R x Hsub IH | u p0 Hsub IH | u p0 Hsub IH];
    intros a Eu.
  - subst u. exact (pattern_agree_not_UCAbs (a_UCAbs a) p0 Hpa a eq_refl).
  - exact (IH a Eu).
  - exact (IH a Eu).
  - exact (IH a Eu).
Qed.

Lemma roleing_fam_fix : forall W (R:role), uniq W -> roleing W (a_Fam Fix) R.
Proof.
  intros W R Hu. eapply role_a_Fam; [exact Hu|].
  unfold toplevel, binds. simpl. left. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Par_fixdef_inst : forall W (a a':tm), Par W a a' Nom ->
  Par W
    (a_App a (Rho Rel) (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) a))
    (a_App a' (Rho Rel) (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) a')) Nom.
Proof.
  intros W a a' Hp.
  pose proof (Par_roleing _ _ _ _ Hp) as [Hra _].
  pose proof (roleing_uniq _ _ _ Hra) as Hu.
  assert (Hfam : roleing W (a_Fam Fix) Nom) by (apply roleing_fam_fix; auto).
  assert (Hbul : roleing W a_Bullet Nom) by (apply role_a_Bullet; auto).
  assert (Hinner : roleing W (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) Nom)
    by (apply role_a_App; auto).
  eapply Par_App with (nu := Rho Rel) (R := Nom).
  - exact Hp.
  - change (Par W (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) a)
                 (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) a') Nom).
    eapply Par_App with (nu := Rho Rel) (R := Nom).
    + apply Par_Refl; auto.
    + exact Hp.
Qed.

Lemma roleing_fixdef_inst : forall (W:role_context) (y:tmvar),
  uniq W -> y `notin` dom W -> y <> FixVar2 ->
  roleing ((y ~ Nom) ++ W) (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef) Nom.
Proof.
  intros W y Hu Hy Hyne.
  rewrite (subst_fixdef_open y Hyne).
  assert (Huf : uniq ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) by (apply uniq_cons; auto).
  assert (Hvar : forall R1, roleing ((y ~ Nom) ++ W) (a_Var_f y) R1).
  { intro R1. eapply role_a_Var with (R:=Nom); [exact Huf| |apply NomBot].
    unfold binds. simpl. left. reflexivity. }
  assert (Hfam : roleing ((y ~ Nom) ++ W) (a_Fam Fix) Nom)
    by (apply roleing_fam_fix; auto).
  assert (Hbul : roleing ((y ~ Nom) ++ W) a_Bullet Nom)
    by (apply role_a_Bullet; auto).
  assert (Hin1 : roleing ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)
                   (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) Nom)
    by (apply role_a_App; auto).
  eapply role_a_App with (R:=Nom).
  - apply Hvar.
  - change (roleing ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)
       (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) (a_Var_f y)) Nom).
    eapply role_a_App with (R:=Nom).
    + exact Hin1.
    + apply Hvar.
Qed.

Lemma Par_fixdef_subst : forall (W:role_context) (y:tmvar),
  uniq W -> y `notin` dom W -> y <> FixVar2 ->
  forall (a a':tm), Par W a a' Nom ->
  Par W
    (tm_subst_tm_tm a y (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef))
    (tm_subst_tm_tm a' y (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef)) Nom.
Proof.
  intros W y Hu Hy Hyne a a' Hp.
  assert (Hbody : roleing ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)
      (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef) Nom)
    by (apply roleing_fixdef_inst; auto).
  assert (Hr : Par ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)
      (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef)
      (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef) Nom)
    by (apply Par_Refl; auto).
  exact (Par_subst ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)
           (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef)
           (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef) Nom Hr
           nil W y Nom a a' eq_refl Hp).
Qed.

Lemma Par_Bullet_inv : forall W (b:tm) R, Par W a_Bullet b R -> b = a_Bullet.
Proof.
  intros W b R H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Par_FamFix_inv : forall W (b:tm) R, Par W (a_Fam Fix) b R -> b = a_Fam Fix.
Proof.
  intros W b R H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply Par_AxiomBase_dead; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Par_inner_irrel_axes : forall W (aI b:tm) R,
  Par W (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) aI) b R ->
  exists aI', b = a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) aI'.
Proof.
  intros W aI b R H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - eexists; reflexivity.
  - match goal with Hf : Par W (a_Fam Fix) ?x _ |- _ =>
      exfalso; pose proof (Par_FamFix_inv W x _ Hf) as E; discriminate E end.
  - match goal with Hf : Par W (a_Fam Fix) ?af _ |- exists _,
        a_App ?af (Rho Irrel) ?bf = _ =>
      assert (af = a_Fam Fix) by (eapply Par_FamFix_inv; eauto);
      subst af; eexists; reflexivity end.
  - exfalso.
    match goal with Hb : binds ?F (Ax ?p ?bt ?A ?R1 ?Rs) toplevel |- _ =>
      pose proof Hb as Hbinds;
      apply binds_toplevel_inv in Hb; destruct Hb as [HF Hs]; subst F; inversion Hs; subst end.
    match goal with Hren : Rename FixPat FixDef ?pp ?bbt ?DD ?DDg |- _ =>
      assert (HinD : AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 DD)
        by (unfold FixPat in *; simpl in *; fsetdec);
      destruct (Rename_FixPat_def pp bbt DD DDg HinD Hren)
        as [y0 [Hpp [Hbb [Hyne0 HyD0]]]]; subst pp
    end.
    match goal with Hm : MatchSubst (a_App _ (Rho Irrel) _) _ _ _ |- _ =>
      inversion Hm; subst; try discriminate end.
Qed.

Lemma Par_fixhead_axes : forall W (b:tm) R,
  Par W (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) b R ->
  b = a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet.
Proof.
  intros W b R H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
  - match goal with Hf : Par W (a_Fam Fix) (a_UAbs _ _) _ |- _ =>
      exfalso; pose proof (Par_FamFix_inv W _ _ Hf); discriminate end.
  - match goal with
      Hf : Par W (a_Fam Fix) ?af _,
      Ha : Par W a_Bullet ?bf _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (Par_FamFix_inv W af _ Hf) as E1;
      pose proof (Par_Bullet_inv W bf _ Ha) as E2;
      subst af; subst bf; reflexivity end.
  - exfalso.
    match goal with Hb : binds ?F (Ax ?p ?bt ?A ?R1 ?Rs) toplevel |- _ =>
      pose proof Hb as Hbinds;
      apply binds_toplevel_inv in Hb; destruct Hb as [HF Hs]; subst F; inversion Hs; subst end.
    match goal with Hren : Rename FixPat FixDef ?pp ?bbt ?DD ?DDg |- _ =>
      assert (HinD : AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 DD)
        by (unfold FixPat in *; simpl in *; fsetdec);
      destruct (Rename_FixPat_def pp bbt DD DDg HinD Hren)
        as [y0 [Hpp [Hbb [Hyne0 HyD0]]]]; subst pp
    end.
    match goal with Hm : MatchSubst (a_App _ (Rho Irrel) _) _ _ _ |- _ =>
      inversion Hm; subst; try discriminate end.
Qed.

Lemma Par_UAbs_inst : forall W (rho:relflag) (a a' b b':tm) R,
  Par W (a_UAbs rho a) (a_UAbs rho a') R ->
  Par W b b' Nom ->
  Par W (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b') R.
Proof.
  intros W rho a a' b b' R Hbody Hb.
  destruct (Par_UAbs_body W rho a (a_UAbs rho a') R Hbody)
    as [aa [L [E HL]]]. inversion E; subst aa.

       fv_tm_tm_tm b' `union` fv_tm_tm_tm a `union` fv_tm_tm_tm a'))
      as [x Hx].
    exists x. repeat split; fsetdec. }
  destruct Hx as [x [HxL [HxW [Hxb [Hxb' [Hxa Hxa']]]]]].
  pose proof (HL x HxL) as Hpar.

      (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x)) R Hpar nil W x Nom b b' eq_refl Hb) as Hsub.

                (tm_subst_tm_tm b' x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) a')) R) in Hsub.

Lemma Par_UCAbs_inst : forall W (a a':tm) R (h:co),

  intros W a a' R h Hbody Hh.

  assert (Hx : exists c, c `notin` L /\ c `notin` fcv_tm_tm_tm a /\

  { destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` fcv_tm_tm_tm a `union` fcv_tm_tm_tm a'))
      as [c Hc]. exists c. repeat split; fsetdec. }
  destruct Hx as [c [HcL [Hca Hca']]].
  pose proof (HL c HcL) as Hpar.
  change (Par W (open_tm_wrt_co_rec 0 h a) (open_tm_wrt_co_rec 0 h a') R).
  pose proof (Par_cosubst W (open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f c))
     (open_tm_wrt_co a' (g_Var_f c)) R Hpar c h Hh) as Hsub.
  change (Par W (csubst_tm h c (open_tm_wrt_co_rec 0 (g_Var_f c) a))
                (csubst_tm h c (open_tm_wrt_co_rec 0 (g_Var_f c) a')) R) in Hsub.
  rewrite (open_csubst_tm_id a c h Hca) in Hsub.
  rewrite (open_csubst_tm_id a' c h Hca') in Hsub.
  exact Hsub.
Qed.

Lemma pattern_agree_subst_inv : forall (a:tm) F, ValuePath a F ->

Proof.

    apply tm_pattern_agree_Const.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm] in Hp. inversion Hp; subst; try discriminate.
    + apply tm_pattern_agree_AppRelR.
      * apply lc_tm_subst_inv with (u:=u) (x:=x); auto.
      * apply (IHValuePath _ u x Hu); assumption.
    + apply tm_pattern_agree_AppIrrel.
      * apply lc_tm_subst_inv with (u:=u) (x:=x); auto.
      * apply (IHValuePath _ u x Hu); assumption.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm] in Hp. inversion Hp; subst; try discriminate.
    apply tm_pattern_agree_CApp. apply (IHValuePath _ u x Hu); assumption.

Proof.

  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm] in Hs. inversion Hs; subst; try discriminate.
    + apply subtm_pattern_agree_Base.

    + apply subtm_pattern_agree_Base.
      eapply pattern_agree_subst_inv; [ eapply ValuePath_Const; eauto | exact Hu | eassumption ].
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm] in Hs. inversion Hs; subst; try discriminate.
    + apply subtm_pattern_agree_Base.

Lemma Par_rename_var : forall W u v R x y,
  y `notin` dom W -> y <> x ->
  Par ((x ~ Nom) ++ W) u v R ->
  Par ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)
      (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) x u)
      (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) x v) R.
Proof.
  intros W u v R x y HyW Hyx H.
  assert (HyxW : y `notin` dom ((x ~ Nom) ++ W)) by (simpl; fsetdec).
  pose proof (Par_weaken ((x ~ Nom) ++ W) u v R H y Nom HyxW) as H1.
  assert (Hperm : Permutation ((y ~ Nom) ++ (x ~ Nom) ++ W)
                              ((x ~ Nom) ++ (y ~ Nom) ++ W)).
  { simpl. apply perm_swap. }
  pose proof (Par_perm _ _ _ _ H1 _ Hperm) as H2.
  pose proof (Par_uniq _ _ _ _ H) as Hu.
  assert (HuniqW : uniq W) by (inversion Hu; subst; assumption).
  assert (HuniqY : uniq ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) by (apply uniq_cons; assumption).
  assert (Hrole : Par ((y ~ Nom) ++ W) (a_Var_f y) (a_Var_f y) Nom).
  { apply Par_Refl. eapply role_a_Var with (R := Nom);
      [ exact HuniqY | | apply Refl ].
    unfold binds. simpl. left. reflexivity. }
  exact (Par_subst ((x ~ Nom) ++ (y ~ Nom) ++ W) u v R H2
           nil ((y ~ Nom) ++ W) x Nom (a_Var_f y) (a_Var_f y)
           eq_refl Hrole).
Qed.

     Par ((x ~ Nom) ++ W) (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) a2 R ->
     exists b,
       Par ((x ~ Nom) ++ W) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x)) b R /\
       Par ((x ~ Nom) ++ W) a2 b R) ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L2 ->
     Par ((x ~ Nom) ++ W) (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x))
         (open_tm_wrt_tm a0' (a_Var_f x)) R) ->
  exists a'',
    Par W (a_UAbs rho a') (a_UAbs rho a'') R /\
    Par W (a_UAbs rho a0') (a_UAbs rho a'') R.
Proof.
  intros W rho a a' a0' R L1 L2 HIH Hbody.
  assert (Hx : exists x, x `notin` L1 /\ x `notin` L2 /\ x `notin` dom W /\
              x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a /\ x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a' /\
              x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a0').
  { destruct (atom_fresh (L1 `union` L2 `union` dom W `union` fv_tm_tm_tm a `union`
       fv_tm_tm_tm a' `union` fv_tm_tm_tm a0')) as [x Hx].
    exists x. repeat split; fsetdec. }
  destruct Hx as [x [HxL1 [HxL2 [HxW [Hxa [Hxa' Hxa0']]]]]].

    as [b [B1 B2]].
  assert (HA : Par W (a_UAbs rho a')
                 (a_UAbs rho (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x b)) R).
  { eapply Par_Abs with (L := singleton x \u dom W).
    intros y Hy. simpl in Hy.
    assert (Hyx : y <> x) by fsetdec.
    assert (HyW : y `notin` dom W) by fsetdec.
    pose proof (Par_rename_var W (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x)) b R x y
                  HyW Hyx B1) as HR.
    change (Par ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)
      (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f y) a')
      (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f y) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x b)) R).
    rewrite <- (open_subst_tm_id a' x (a_Var_f y) Hxa').
    rewrite (open_close_subst_tm_A b 0 x y).
    exact HR. }
  assert (HB : Par W (a_UAbs rho a0')
                 (a_UAbs rho (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x b)) R).

Require Import Language.

Fixpoint ctx_nom (G : context) := match G with
  | nil => nil
  | (x, Tm _) :: G' => (x, Nom) :: ctx_nom G'
  | (x, Co _) :: G' => ctx_nom G'
  end.

Definition Good (G : context) (D : available_props):=
  forall c1 A B1 T1 R,
    binds c1 (Co (Eq A B1 T1 R)) G
    -> c1 `in` D
    -> exists C, Par (ctx_nom G) A C R /\ Par (ctx_nom G) B1 C R.

Definition irrelevant G D (a : tm) :=
  (forall x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a) /\ Good G D.

Theorem confluence : forall W a a1 R,
  Par W a a1 R ->
  forall a2, Par W a a2 R -> exists b, Par W a1 b R /\ Par W a2 b R.

Theorem reduction_preservation : forall a a' R, reduction_in_one a a' R -> forall G A D,
      Typing G a A -> Typing G a' A /\ DefEq G D a a' A R.

Theorem progress : forall G a A R, Typing G a A ->
                          irrelevant G (dom G) a ->
                          Value R a \/ exists a', reduction_in_one a a' R.

(* ---- Par weakens the role context ---- *)
Lemma Par_weaken : forall W a b R, Par W a b R ->
  forall (x:atom) (Rw:role), x `notin` dom W -> Par ((x ~ Rw) ++ W) a b R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H; intros x Rw Hx.
  - apply Par_Refl. apply roleing_weaken; auto.
  - apply Par_Beta. apply IHPar1; auto. apply IHPar2; auto.
  - apply Par_App. apply IHPar1; auto. apply IHPar2; auto.
  - apply Par_CBeta. apply IHPar; auto.
  - apply Par_CApp. apply IHPar; auto.
  - apply Par_Abs with (L := L `union` {{x}} `union` dom W); intros y Hy.
    assert (HyL : y `notin` L) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hyx : y <> x) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hxdom : x `notin` dom ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) by (simpl; fsetdec).
    apply (Par_perm ((x ~ Rw) ++ ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) _ _ R).
    + apply (H0 y HyL x Rw Hxdom).
    + simpl; apply perm_swap.
  - apply Par_Pi with (L := L `union` {{x}} `union` dom W).
    + apply IHPar; auto.
    + intros y Hy.
      assert (HyL : y `notin` L) by fsetdec.
      assert (Hyx : y <> x) by fsetdec.
      assert (Hxdom : x `notin` dom ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) by (simpl; fsetdec).
      apply (Par_perm ((x ~ Rw) ++ ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) _ _ R).
      * apply (H1 y HyL x Rw Hxdom).
      * simpl; apply perm_swap.
  - apply Par_CAbs with (L := L); intros c Hc. apply (H0 c Hc x Rw Hx).
  - apply Par_CPi with (L := L).
    + apply IHPar1; auto. + apply IHPar2; auto. + apply IHPar3; auto.
    + intros c Hc. apply (H3 c Hc x Rw Hx).
  - eapply Par_AxiomBase; eauto.
  - (* AxiomApp *)
    pose proof H as Hbinds.
    apply binds_toplevel_inv in H. destruct H as [HF Hs]; subst F. inversion Hs; subst.
    assert (HinD : AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 (union (dom W) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat))).
    { unfold FixPat; simpl; fsetdec. }
    destruct (Rename_FixPat_def p' b' (union (dom W) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat)) D' HinD H3)
      as [y0 [Hp0 [Hb0 [Hyne0 HyD0]]]].
    subst p'.
    inversion H4; subst; try discriminate.
    inversion H14; subst; try discriminate.
    inversion H8; subst; try discriminate.
    destruct (Rename_FixPat_exists (union (dom ((x ~ Rw) ++ W)) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat)))
      as [y1 [p1 [b1 [D1 [Hy1D [Hyne1 [Hp1 [Hb1 Hren1]]]]]]]].
    subst p1. subst b1.
    assert (Hlc_b1 : lc_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef))
      by (apply lc_fixdef_renamed; auto).
    assert (Hms1 : MatchSubst (a_Fam Fix) (a_Fam Fix)
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef)
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef))
      by (apply MatchSubst_Const; auto).
    assert (Hms2 : MatchSubst (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a2)
                     (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet)
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef)
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef))
      by (apply MatchSubst_AppIrrel; auto).
    assert (Hms3 : MatchSubst (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a2) (Role Nom) a1')
                     (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Role Nom) (a_Var_f y1))
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef)
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm a1' y1 (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef)))
      by (apply MatchSubst_AppRelR; auto).
    rewrite (fixdef_rename_indep y0 y1 a1' Hyne0 Hyne1).
    eapply Par_AxiomApp.
    + exact Hbinds. + exact H0.
    + apply IHPar1; auto.
    + apply IHPar2; auto.
    + exact Hren1.
    + exact Hms3.
    + exact H5.
  - (* AxiomCApp : impossible *)
    exfalso.
    apply binds_toplevel_inv in H. destruct H as [HF Hs]; subst F. inversion Hs; subst.
    assert (HinD : AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 (union (dom W) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat))).
    { unfold FixPat; simpl; fsetdec. }
    destruct (Rename_FixPat_def p' b' (union (dom W) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat)) D' HinD H2)
      as [y0 [Hp0 [Hb0 [Hyne0 HyD0]]]].
    subst p'.
    inversion H3; subst; try discriminate.
  - apply Par_Pattern; [apply IHPar1|apply IHPar2|apply IHPar3]; auto.
  - eapply Par_PatternTrue; [apply IHPar1|apply IHPar2|apply IHPar3|exact H2|exact H3|exact H4]; auto.
  - eapply Par_PatternFalse; [apply IHPar1|apply IHPar2|apply IHPar3|exact H2|exact H3]; auto.
Qed.

        subst u;
        change (Par W b' v Nom) in V1;
        exists (open_tm_wrt_tm a'' v); split;
        [ eapply Par_Beta; [exact U1 | exact V1]
        | apply (Par_UAbs_inst W rho a0' a'' b0' v R U2 V2) ]

    + (* H2 App *)
      match goal with

501	  | (g_CPiCong g1 g3) => g_CPiCong (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g1) (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g3)
502	  | (g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4) => g_CAbsCong (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g1) (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g3) (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g4)
503	  | (g_CAppCong g g1 g2) => g_CAppCong (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g) (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g1) (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g2)
504	  | (g_CPiSnd g g1 g2) => g_CPiSnd (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g) (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g1) (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g2)

507	  | (g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 g) => g_IsoConv (tm_subst_tm_constraint a5 x5 phi1) (tm_subst_tm_constraint a5 x5 phi2) (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g)

509	  | (g_Left g g') => g_Left (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g) (tm_subst_tm_co a5 x5 g')

Compile with exactly:
  cd /workspace && rocq compile -R /workspace "" -R /workspace/.rocq-deps/Metalib Metalib Prog.v

* The hypothesis `irrelevant G (dom G) a` includes `Good G (dom G)` and that every term-variable bound in G is not free in a. A key step is showing a well-typed term has no free term variables other than those bound in G, so under irrelevant it is closed (or at least its free vars are irrelevant). * Then prove canonical forms: a closed/well-typed term of Pi type is either a UAbs/Abs/variable-path value etc.; use inversion of Typing and Value constructors. For neutral terms (E_Var impossible under irrelevance), use inversion.

E_Case/pattern terms: if the scrutinee is a value use Beta_PatternFalse (if no AppsPath; AppsPath is empty for the toplevel signature — prove AppsPath_empty) or Beta_PatternTrue is impossible because SatApp is impossible for the toplevel signature (prove SatApp_empty by binds_toplevel_inv); otherwise reduce inside by E_Pattern. * `Value` includes Value_Path via CasePath. For variables: E_Var requires binds x (Tm A) G, contradicting irrelevance because x is free in a_Var_f x.
* You may add arbitrary helper lemmas to Prog.v. Prove everything; no admits in the final file. Work iteratively and compile often.

(* ---- Par weakens the role context ---- *)
Lemma Par_weaken : forall W a b R, Par W a b R ->
  forall (x:atom) (Rw:role), x `notin` dom W -> Par ((x ~ Rw) ++ W) a b R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H; intros x Rw Hx.
  - apply Par_Refl. apply roleing_weaken; auto.
  - apply Par_Beta. apply IHPar1; auto. apply IHPar2; auto.
  - apply Par_App. apply IHPar1; auto. apply IHPar2; auto.
  - apply Par_CBeta. apply IHPar; auto.
  - apply Par_CApp. apply IHPar; auto.
  - apply Par_Abs with (L := L `union` {{x}} `union` dom W); intros y Hy.
    assert (HyL : y `notin` L) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hyx : y <> x) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hxdom : x `notin` dom ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) by (simpl; fsetdec).
    apply (Par_perm ((x ~ Rw) ++ ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) _ _ R).
    + apply (H0 y HyL x Rw Hxdom).
    + simpl; apply perm_swap.
  - apply Par_Pi with (L := L `union` {{x}} `union` dom W).
    + apply IHPar; auto.
    + intros y Hy.
      assert (HyL : y `notin` L) by fsetdec.
      assert (Hyx : y <> x) by fsetdec.
      assert (Hxdom : x `notin` dom ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) by (simpl; fsetdec).
      apply (Par_perm ((x ~ Rw) ++ ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) _ _ R).
      * apply (H1 y HyL x Rw Hxdom).
      * simpl; apply perm_swap.
  - apply Par_CAbs with (L := L); intros c Hc. apply (H0 c Hc x Rw Hx).
  - apply Par_CPi with (L := L).
    + apply IHPar1; auto. + apply IHPar2; auto. + apply IHPar3; auto.
    + intros c Hc. apply (H3 c Hc x Rw Hx).
  - eapply Par_AxiomBase; eauto.
  - (* AxiomApp *)
    pose proof H as Hbinds.
    apply binds_toplevel_inv in H. destruct H as [HF Hs]; subst F. inversion Hs; subst.
    assert (HinD : AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 (union (dom W) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat))).
    { unfold FixPat; simpl; fsetdec. }
    destruct (Rename_FixPat_def p' b' (union (dom W) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat)) D' HinD H3)
      as [y0 [Hp0 [Hb0 [Hyne0 HyD0]]]].
    subst p'.
    inversion H4; subst; try discriminate.
    inversion H14; subst; try discriminate.
    inversion H8; subst; try discriminate.
    destruct (Rename_FixPat_exists (union (dom ((x ~ Rw) ++ W)) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat)))
      as [y1 [p1 [b1 [D1 [Hy1D [Hyne1 [Hp1 [Hb1 Hren1]]]]]]]].
    subst p1. subst b1.
    assert (Hlc_b1 : lc_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef))
      by (apply lc_fixdef_renamed; auto).
    assert (Hms1 : MatchSubst (a_Fam Fix) (a_Fam Fix)
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef)
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef))
      by (apply MatchSubst_Const; auto).
    assert (Hms2 : MatchSubst (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a2)
                     (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet)
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef)
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef))
      by (apply MatchSubst_AppIrrel; auto).
    assert (Hms3 : MatchSubst (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a2) (Role Nom) a1')
                     (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Role Nom) (a_Var_f y1))
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef)
                     (tm_subst_tm_tm a1' y1 (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef)))
      by (apply MatchSubst_AppRelR; auto).
    rewrite (fixdef_rename_indep y0 y1 a1' Hyne0 Hyne1).
    eapply Par_AxiomApp.
    + exact Hbinds. + exact H0.
    + apply IHPar1; auto.
    + apply IHPar2; auto.
    + exact Hren1.
    + exact Hms3.
    + exact H5.

    exfalso.
    apply binds_toplevel_inv in H. destruct H as [HF Hs]; subst F. inversion Hs; subst.
    assert (HinD : AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 (union (dom W) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat))).

      as [y0 [Hp0 [Hb0 [Hyne0 HyD0]]]].

  - eapply Par_PatternTrue; [apply IHPar1|apply IHPar2|apply IHPar3|exact H2|exact H3|exact H4]; auto.
  - eapply Par_PatternFalse; [apply IHPar1|apply IHPar2|apply IHPar3|exact H2|exact H3]; auto.

Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.
(** syntax *)
Definition tmvar := var. (*r variables *)
Definition covar := var. (*r coercion variables *)
Definition datacon := atom.
Definition const := atom.
Inductive relflag : Set :=  (*r relevance flag *)
 | Rel : relflag
 | Irrel : relflag.

Inductive role : Set :=  (*r Role *)
 | Nom : role
 | Rep : role.

Inductive appflag : Set :=  (*r applicative flag *)
 | Role (R:role)
 | Rho (rho:relflag).

Inductive App : Set :=
 | A_Tm (nu:appflag)
 | A_Co : App.

Inductive Apps : Set :=
 | A_nil : Apps
 | A_cons (App5:App) (Apps5:Apps).

Inductive constraint : Set :=  (*r props *)
 | Eq (a:tm) (b:tm) (A:tm) (R:role)
with tm : Set :=  (*r types and kinds *)
 | a_Star : tm
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_Abs (rho:relflag) (A:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_UAbs (rho:relflag) (b:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (nu:appflag) (b:tm)
 | a_Pi (rho:relflag) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_CAbs (phi:constraint) (b:tm)
 | a_UCAbs (b:tm)
 | a_CApp (a:tm) (g:co)
 | a_CPi (phi:constraint) (B:tm)
 | a_Conv (a:tm) (R:role) (g:co)
 | a_Fam (F:const)
 | a_Bullet : tm
 | a_Pattern (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1:tm) (b2:tm)
 | a_DataCon (K:datacon)
 | a_Case (a:tm) (brs5:brs)
 | a_Sub (R:role) (a:tm)
 | a_Coerce : tm
 | a_SrcApp (a:tm) (b:tm)
with brs : Set :=  (*r case branches *)
 | br_None : brs
 | br_One (K:datacon) (a:tm) (brs5:brs)
with co : Set :=  (*r explicit coercions *)
 | g_Triv : co
 | g_Var_b (_:nat)
 | g_Var_f (c:covar)
 | g_Beta (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | g_Refl (a:tm)
 | g_Refl2 (a:tm) (b:tm) (g:co)
 | g_Sym (g:co)
 | g_Trans (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_Sub (g:co)
 | g_PiCong (rho:relflag) (R:role) (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_AbsCong (rho:relflag) (R:role) (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_AppCong (g1:co) (rho:relflag) (R:role) (g2:co)
 | g_PiFst (g:co)
 | g_CPiFst (g:co)
 | g_IsoSnd (g:co)
 | g_PiSnd (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_CPiCong (g1:co) (g3:co)
 | g_CAbsCong (g1:co) (g3:co) (g4:co)
 | g_CAppCong (g:co) (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_CPiSnd (g:co) (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_Cast (g1:co) (R:role) (g2:co)
 | g_EqCong (g1:co) (A:tm) (g2:co)
 | g_IsoConv (phi1:constraint) (phi2:constraint) (g:co)
 | g_Eta (a:tm)
 | g_Left (g:co) (g':co)
 | g_Right (g:co) (g':co).

Definition roles : Set := list role.

Inductive sort : Set :=  (*r binding classifier *)
 | Tm (A:tm)
 | Co (phi:constraint).

Inductive sig_sort : Set :=  (*r signature classifier *)
 | Cs (A:tm) (Rs:roles)
 | Ax (p:tm) (a:tm) (A:tm) (R:role) (Rs:roles).

Inductive pattern_arg : Set :=  (*r Pattern arguments *)
 | p_Tm (nu:appflag) (a:tm)
 | p_Co (g:co).

Definition role_context : Set := list ( atom * role ).

Definition context : Set := list ( atom * sort ).

Definition available_props : Type := atoms.

Definition pattern_args : Set := list pattern_arg.

Fixpoint open_constraint_wrt_co_rec (k:nat) (g5:co) (phi5:constraint) : constraint :=
  match phi5 with
  | (Eq a b A R) => Eq (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g5 a) (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g5 b) (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g5 A) R
end
with open_co_wrt_co_rec (k:nat) (g_5:co) (g__6:co) {struct g__6}: co :=
  match g__6 with
  | g_Triv => g_Triv
  | (g_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => g_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => g_5
        | inright _ => g_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (g_Var_f c) => g_Var_f c
  | (g_Beta a b) => g_Beta (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g_5 a) (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g_5 b)
  | (g_Refl a) => g_Refl (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g_5 a)
  | (g_Refl2 a b g) => g_Refl2 (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g_5 a) (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g_5 b) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g)
  | (g_Sym g) => g_Sym (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g)
  | (g_Trans g1 g2) => g_Trans (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g1) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g2)
  | (g_Sub g) => g_Sub (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g)
  | (g_PiCong rho R g1 g2) => g_PiCong rho R (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g1) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g2)
  | (g_AbsCong rho R g1 g2) => g_AbsCong rho R (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g1) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g2)
  | (g_AppCong g1 rho R g2) => g_AppCong (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g1) rho R (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g2)
  | (g_PiFst g) => g_PiFst (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g)
  | (g_CPiFst g) => g_CPiFst (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g)
  | (g_IsoSnd g) => g_IsoSnd (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g)
  | (g_PiSnd g1 g2) => g_PiSnd (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g1) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g2)
  | (g_CPiCong g1 g3) => g_CPiCong (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g1) (open_co_wrt_co_rec (S k) g_5 g3)
  | (g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4) => g_CAbsCong (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g1) (open_co_wrt_co_rec (S k) g_5 g3) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g4)
  | (g_CAppCong g g1 g2) => g_CAppCong (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g1) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g2)
  | (g_CPiSnd g g1 g2) => g_CPiSnd (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g1) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g2)
  | (g_Cast g1 R g2) => g_Cast (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g1) R (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g2)
  | (g_EqCong g1 A g2) => g_EqCong (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g1) (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g_5 A) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g2)
  | (g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 g) => g_IsoConv (open_constraint_wrt_co_rec k g_5 phi1) (open_constraint_wrt_co_rec k g_5 phi2) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g)
  | (g_Eta a) => g_Eta (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g_5 a)
  | (g_Left g g') => g_Left (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g')
  | (g_Right g g') => g_Right (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g) (open_co_wrt_co_rec k g_5 g')
end
with open_brs_wrt_co_rec (k:nat) (g5:co) (brs_6:brs) {struct brs_6}: brs :=

Definition toplevel : sig := Fix ~ Ax FixPat FixDef FixTy Nom [Nom].

(** definitions *)

(* defns JSubRole *)
Inductive SubRole : role -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn SubRole *)
 | NomBot : forall (R:role),
     SubRole Nom R
 | RepTop : forall (R:role),
     SubRole R Rep
 | Refl : forall (R:role),
     SubRole R R
 | Trans : forall (R1 R3 R2:role),
     SubRole R1 R2 ->
     SubRole R2 R3 ->
     SubRole R1 R3.

(* defns JRolePath *)
Inductive RolePath : tm -> roles -> Prop :=    (* defn RolePath *)
 | RolePath_AbsConst : forall (F:const) (Rs:roles) (A:tm),
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     RolePath (a_Fam F) Rs
 | RolePath_Const : forall (F:const) (Rs:roles) (p a A:tm) (R1:role),
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     RolePath (a_Fam F) Rs
 | RolePath_TApp : forall (a:tm) (R1:role) (b:tm) (Rs:roles),
     lc_tm b ->
     RolePath a  ( R1 :: Rs )  ->
     RolePath (a_App a (Role R1) b) Rs
 | RolePath_App : forall (a b:tm) (Rs:roles),
     lc_tm b ->
     RolePath a  ( Nom :: Rs )  ->
     RolePath (a_App a (Rho Rel) b) Rs
 | RolePath_IApp : forall (a:tm) (Rs:roles),
     RolePath a Rs ->
     RolePath (a_App a (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) Rs
 | RolePath_CApp : forall (a:tm) (Rs:roles),
     RolePath a Rs ->
     RolePath (a_CApp a g_Triv) Rs.

(* defns JAppsPath *)
Inductive AppsPath : role -> tm -> const -> Apps -> Prop :=    (* defn AppsPath *)
 | AppsPath_AbsConst : forall (R:role) (F:const) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     AppsPath R (a_Fam F) F A_nil
 | AppsPath_Const : forall (R:role) (F:const) (p a A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      not (  ( SubRole R1 R )  )  ->
     AppsPath R (a_Fam F) F A_nil
 | AppsPath_App : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (R1:role) (b':tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps),
     lc_tm b' ->
     AppsPath R a F Apps5 ->
     AppsPath R  ( (a_App a (Role R1) b') )  F  (  (A_snoc  Apps5   (A_Tm (Role R1)) )  )
 | AppsPath_IApp : forall (R:role) (a b:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps),
     lc_tm b ->
     AppsPath R a F Apps5 ->
     AppsPath R  ( (a_App a (Rho Irrel) b) )  F  (  (A_snoc  Apps5   (A_Tm (Rho Irrel)) )  )
 | AppsPath_CApp : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps),
     AppsPath R a F Apps5 ->
     AppsPath R  ( (a_CApp a g_Triv) )  F  (  (A_snoc  Apps5   A_Co )  ) .

(* defns JSat *)
Inductive AppRoles : Apps -> roles -> Prop :=    (* defn AppRoles *)
 | AR_nil :
     AppRoles A_nil  nil
 | AR_consTApp : forall (R1:role) (Apps5:Apps) (Rs:roles),
     AppRoles Apps5 Rs ->
     AppRoles (A_cons (A_Tm (Role R1)) Apps5)  ( R1 :: Rs )
 | AR_consApp : forall (Apps5:Apps) (Rs:roles),
     AppRoles Apps5 Rs ->
     AppRoles (A_cons (A_Tm (Rho Rel)) Apps5)  ( Nom :: Rs )
 | AR_consIApp : forall (Apps5:Apps) (Rs:roles),
     AppRoles Apps5 Rs ->
     AppRoles (A_cons (A_Tm (Rho Irrel)) Apps5) Rs
 | AR_consCApp : forall (Apps5:Apps) (Rs:roles),
     AppRoles Apps5 Rs ->
     AppRoles (A_cons A_Co Apps5) Rs
with SatApp : const -> Apps -> Prop :=    (* defn SatApp *)
 | Sat_Const : forall (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     AppRoles Apps5 Rs ->
     SatApp F Apps5
 | Sat_Axiom : forall (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (p a0 A1:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a0 A1 R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      not (  ( SubRole R1 Nom )  )  ->
     AppRoles Apps5 Rs ->
     SatApp F Apps5.

(* defns JPatCtx *)
Inductive Rename : tm -> tm -> tm -> tm -> available_props -> available_props -> Prop :=    (* defn Rename *)
 | Rename_Base : forall (F:const) (a:tm) (D:available_props),
     lc_tm a ->
     Rename (a_Fam F) a (a_Fam F) a D  AtomSetImpl.empty
 | Rename_AppRel : forall (p1:tm) (R:role) (x:tmvar) (a1 p2:tm) (y:tmvar) (a2:tm) (D D':available_props),
     Rename p1 a1 p2 a2 D D' ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  y    (  ( D  `union`  D' )  )   ->
     Rename  ( (a_App p1 (Role R) (a_Var_f x)) )  a1  ( (a_App p2 (Role R) (a_Var_f y)) )   (  (tm_subst_tm_tm  (a_Var_f y)   x   a2 )  )  D  (  (singleton  y  \u  D' )  )
 | Rename_AppIrrel : forall (p1 a1 p2 a2:tm) (D D':available_props),
     Rename p1 a1 p2 a2 D D' ->
     Rename  ( (a_App p1 (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) )  a1  ( (a_App p2 (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) )  a2 D D'
 | Rename_CApp : forall (p1 a1 p2 a2:tm) (D D':available_props),
     Rename p1 a1 p2 a2 D D' ->
     Rename  ( (a_CApp p1 g_Triv) )  a1  ( (a_CApp p2 g_Triv) )  a2 D D'.

(* defns JMatchSubst *)
Inductive MatchSubst : tm -> tm -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn MatchSubst *)
 | MatchSubst_Const : forall (F:const) (b:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     MatchSubst (a_Fam F) (a_Fam F) b b
 | MatchSubst_AppRelR : forall (a1:tm) (R:role) (a p1:tm) (x:tmvar) (b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     MatchSubst a1 p1 b1 b2 ->
     MatchSubst  ( (a_App a1 (Role R) a) )   ( (a_App p1 (Role R) (a_Var_f x)) )  b1  (  (tm_subst_tm_tm  a   x   b2 )  )
 | MatchSubst_AppIrrel : forall (a1 a p1 b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     MatchSubst a1 p1 b1 b2 ->
     MatchSubst  ( (a_App a1 (Rho Irrel) a) )   ( (a_App p1 (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) )  b1 b2
 | MatchSubst_CApp : forall (a1 a2 b1 b2:tm),
     MatchSubst a1 a2 b1 b2 ->
     MatchSubst  ( (a_CApp a1 g_Triv) )   ( (a_CApp a2 g_Triv) )  b1 b2.

(* defns JIsPattern *)
Inductive tm_pattern_agree : tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn tm_pattern_agree *)
 | tm_pattern_agree_Const : forall (F:const),
     tm_pattern_agree (a_Fam F) (a_Fam F)
 | tm_pattern_agree_AppRelR : forall (a1:tm) (R:role) (a2 p1:tm) (x:tmvar),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     tm_pattern_agree a1 p1 ->
     tm_pattern_agree  ( (a_App a1 (Role R) a2) )   ( (a_App p1 (Role R) (a_Var_f x)) )
 | tm_pattern_agree_AppIrrel : forall (a1 a p1:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     tm_pattern_agree a1 p1 ->
     tm_pattern_agree  ( (a_App a1 (Rho Irrel) a) )   ( (a_App p1 (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) )
 | tm_pattern_agree_CApp : forall (a1 p1:tm),
     tm_pattern_agree a1 p1 ->
     tm_pattern_agree  ( (a_CApp a1 g_Triv) )   ( (a_CApp p1 g_Triv) ) .

(* defns JTmSubPatternAgree *)
Inductive tm_subpattern_agree : tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn tm_subpattern_agree *)
 | tm_subpattern_agree_Base : forall (a p:tm),
     tm_pattern_agree a p ->
     tm_subpattern_agree a p
 | tm_subpattern_agree_AppRelR : forall (a p:tm) (R:role) (x:tmvar),
     tm_subpattern_agree a p ->
     tm_subpattern_agree a  ( (a_App p (Role R) (a_Var_f x)) )
 | tm_subpattern_agree_AppIrrel : forall (a p:tm),
     tm_subpattern_agree a p ->
     tm_subpattern_agree a  ( (a_App p (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) )
 | tm_subpattern_agree_CAppp : forall (a p:tm),
     tm_subpattern_agree a p ->
     tm_subpattern_agree a  ( (a_CApp p g_Triv) ) .

(* defns JSubTmPatternAgree *)
Inductive subtm_pattern_agree : tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn subtm_pattern_agree *)
 | subtm_pattern_agree_Base : forall (a p:tm),
     tm_pattern_agree a p ->
     subtm_pattern_agree a p
 | subtm_pattern_agree_App : forall (a:tm) (nu:appflag) (a2 p:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     subtm_pattern_agree a p ->
     subtm_pattern_agree (a_App a nu a2) p
 | subtm_pattern_agree_CAppp : forall (a p:tm),
     subtm_pattern_agree a p ->
     subtm_pattern_agree (a_CApp a g_Triv) p.

(* defns JValuePath *)
Inductive ValuePath : tm -> const -> Prop :=    (* defn ValuePath *)
 | ValuePath_AbsConst : forall (F:const) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     ValuePath (a_Fam F) F
 | ValuePath_Const : forall (F:const) (p a A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     ValuePath (a_Fam F) F
 | ValuePath_App : forall (a:tm) (nu:appflag) (b':tm) (F:const),
     lc_tm b' ->
     ValuePath a F ->
     ValuePath  ( (a_App a nu b') )  F
 | ValuePath_CApp : forall (a:tm) (F:const),
     ValuePath a F ->
     ValuePath  ( (a_CApp a g_Triv) )  F.

(* defns JCasePath *)
Inductive CasePath : role -> tm -> const -> Prop :=    (* defn CasePath *)
 | CasePath_AbsConst : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
     ValuePath a F ->
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     CasePath R a F
 | CasePath_Const : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (p b A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
     ValuePath a F ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p b A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      not (  ( SubRole R1 R )  )  ->
     CasePath R a F
 | CasePath_UnMatch : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (p b A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
     ValuePath a F ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p b A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      not (  ( subtm_pattern_agree a p )  )  ->
     CasePath R a F.

(* defns JApplyArgs *)
Inductive ApplyArgs : tm -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn ApplyArgs *)
 | ApplyArgs_Const : forall (F:const) (b:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     ApplyArgs (a_Fam F) b b
 | ApplyArgs_AppRole : forall (a:tm) (R:role) (a' b b':tm),
     lc_tm a' ->
     ApplyArgs a b b' ->
     ApplyArgs  ( (a_App a (Role R) a') )  b  ( (a_App b' (Rho Rel) a') )
 | ApplyArgs_AppRho : forall (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (a' b b':tm),
     lc_tm a' ->
     ApplyArgs a b b' ->
     ApplyArgs  ( (a_App a (Rho rho) a') )  b  ( (a_App b' (Rho rho) a') )
 | ApplyArgs_CApp : forall (a b b':tm),
     ApplyArgs a b b' ->
     ApplyArgs (a_CApp a g_Triv) b (a_CApp b' g_Triv).

(* defns JValue *)
Inductive Value : role -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn Value *)
 | Value_Star : forall (R:role),
     Value R a_Star
 | Value_Pi : forall (R:role) (rho:relflag) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi rho A B) ->
     Value R (a_Pi rho A B)
 | Value_CPi : forall (R:role) (phi:constraint) (B:tm),
     lc_constraint phi ->
     lc_tm (a_CPi phi B) ->
     Value R (a_CPi phi B)
 | Value_AbsRel : forall (R:role) (A a:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs Rel A a) ->
     Value R (a_Abs Rel A a)
 | Value_UAbsRel : forall (R:role) (a:tm),
     lc_tm (a_UAbs Rel a) ->
     Value R (a_UAbs Rel a)
 | Value_UAbsIrrel : forall (L:vars) (R:role) (a:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Value R  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Value R (a_UAbs Irrel a)
 | Value_CAbs : forall (R:role) (phi:constraint) (a:tm),
     lc_constraint phi ->
     lc_tm (a_CAbs phi a) ->
     Value R (a_CAbs phi a)
 | Value_UCAbs : forall (R:role) (a:tm),
     lc_tm (a_UCAbs a) ->
     Value R (a_UCAbs a)
 | Value_Path : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const),
     CasePath R a F ->
     Value R a.

(* defns JValueType *)
Inductive roleing : role_context -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn roleing *)
 | role_a_Bullet : forall (W:role_context) (R:role),
      uniq  W  ->
     roleing W a_Bullet R
 | role_a_Star : forall (W:role_context) (R:role),
      uniq  W  ->
     roleing W a_Star R
 | role_a_Var : forall (W:role_context) (x:tmvar) (R1 R:role),
      uniq  W  ->
      binds  x   R   W  ->
     SubRole R R1 ->
     roleing W (a_Var_f x) R1
 | role_a_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (rho:relflag) (a:tm) (R:role),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> roleing  (( x  ~  Nom ) ++  W )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_UAbs rho a) )  R
 | role_a_App : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     roleing W b Nom ->
     roleing W  ( (a_App a (Rho rho) b) )  R
 | role_a_TApp : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (R1:role) (b:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     roleing W b  (param R1   R )  ->
     roleing W (a_App a (Role R1) b) R
 | role_a_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (rho:relflag) (A B:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W A R ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> roleing  (( x  ~  Nom ) ++  W )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_Pi rho A B) )  R
 | role_a_CPi : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (a b A:tm) (R1:role) (B:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R1 ->
     roleing W b R1 ->
     roleing W A Rep ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> roleing W  ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_CPi (Eq a b A R1) B) )  R
 | role_a_CAbs : forall (L:vars) (W:role_context) (b:tm) (R:role),
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> roleing W  ( open_tm_wrt_co b (g_Var_f c) )  R )  ->
     roleing W  ( (a_UCAbs b) )  R
 | role_a_CApp : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (R:role),
     roleing W a R ->
     roleing W  ( (a_CApp a g_Triv) )  R
 | role_a_Const : forall (W:role_context) (F:const) (R:role) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
      uniq  W  ->
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     roleing W (a_Fam F) R
 | role_a_Fam : forall (W:role_context) (F:const) (R1:role) (p a A:tm) (R:role) (Rs:roles),
      uniq  W  ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a A R Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     roleing W (a_Fam F) R1
 | role_a_Pattern : forall (W:role_context) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2:tm) (R1:role),
     roleing W a Nom ->
     roleing W b1 R1 ->
     roleing W b2 R1 ->
     roleing W (a_Pattern Nom a F Apps5 b1 b2) R1.

(* defns JChk *)
Inductive RhoCheck : relflag -> tmvar -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn RhoCheck *)
 | Rho_Rel : forall (x:tmvar) (A:tm),
      True  ->
     RhoCheck Rel x A
 | Rho_IrrRel : forall (x:tmvar) (A:tm),
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x    (fv_tm_tm_tm  A )   ->
     RhoCheck Irrel x A.

(* defns Jpar *)
Inductive Par : role_context -> tm -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn Par *)

content.content:
Inductive Beta : tm -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn Beta *)
 | Beta_AppAbs : forall (rho:relflag) (v b:tm) (R:role),
     lc_tm b ->
     Value R  ( (a_UAbs rho v) )  ->
     Beta (a_App  ( (a_UAbs rho v) )  (Rho rho) b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  v   b )  R
 | Beta_CAppCAbs : forall (a':tm) (R:role),
     lc_tm (a_UCAbs a') ->
     Beta (a_CApp  ( (a_UCAbs a') )  g_Triv)  (open_tm_wrt_co  a'   g_Triv )  R
 | Beta_Axiom : forall (a b':tm) (R:role) (F:const) (p b A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles) (p1 b1:tm) (D':available_props),
      binds  F  ( (Ax p b A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     Rename p b p1 b1  (  (  (fv_tm_tm_tm  a )   `union`   (fv_tm_tm_tm  p )  )  )  D' ->
     MatchSubst a p1 b1 b' ->
     SubRole R1 R ->
     Beta a b' R
 | Beta_PatternTrue : forall (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2 b1':tm) (R:role) (Apps':Apps),
     lc_tm b2 ->
     AppsPath Nom a F Apps5 ->
     ApplyArgs a b1 b1' ->
      ( SatApp F Apps' )  ->
     Beta  ( (a_Pattern Nom a F Apps5 b1 b2) )  (a_CApp b1' g_Triv) R
 | Beta_PatternFalse : forall (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2:tm) (R:role),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     Value Nom a ->
      not (  ( AppsPath Nom a F Apps5 )  )  ->
     Beta  ( (a_Pattern Nom a F Apps5 b1 b2) )  b2 R
with reduction_in_one : tm -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn reduction_in_one *)
 | E_AbsTerm : forall (L:vars) (a a':tm) (R:role),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> reduction_in_one  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x) )  R )  ->
     reduction_in_one (a_UAbs Irrel a) (a_UAbs Irrel a') R
 | E_AppLeft : forall (a:tm) (nu:appflag) (b a':tm) (R:role),
     lc_tm b ->
     reduction_in_one a a' R ->
     reduction_in_one (a_App a nu b) (a_App a' nu b) R
 | E_CAppLeft : forall (a a':tm) (R:role),
     reduction_in_one a a' R ->
     reduction_in_one (a_CApp a g_Triv) (a_CApp a' g_Triv) R
 | E_Pattern : forall (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2 a':tm) (R:role),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     reduction_in_one a a' Nom ->
     reduction_in_one  ( (a_Pattern Nom a F Apps5 b1 b2) )   ( (a_Pattern Nom a' F Apps5 b1 b2) )  R
 | E_Prim : forall (a b:tm) (R:role),
     Beta a b R ->
     reduction_in_one a b R
with reduction : tm -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn reduction *)
 | Equal : forall (a:tm) (R:role),
     lc_tm a ->
     reduction a a R
 | Step : forall (a a':tm) (R:role) (b:tm),
     reduction_in_one a b R ->
     reduction b a' R ->
     reduction a a' R.

(* defns JBranchTyping *)
Inductive BranchTyping : context -> Apps -> role -> tm -> tm -> tm -> pattern_args -> tm -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn BranchTyping *)
 | BranchTyping_Base : forall (G:context) (a A b:tm) (pattern_args5:pattern_args) (C1 C2:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
     lc_tm A ->
      uniq  G  ->
      (  (open_tm_wrt_co  C1   g_Triv )   =  C2 )  ->
     BranchTyping G A_nil Nom a A b pattern_args5 A (a_CPi  ( (Eq a  (apply_pattern_args  b   pattern_args5 )  A Nom) )  C1) C2
 | BranchTyping_PiRole : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (R:role) (Apps5:Apps) (a A1 b:tm) (pattern_args5:pattern_args) (A B C C':tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> BranchTyping  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )  Apps5 Nom a A1 b  ( pattern_args5  ++ [  (p_Tm (Role R) (a_Var_f x))  ])   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_Var_f x) )  C' )  ->
     BranchTyping G  ( (A_cons (A_Tm (Role R)) Apps5) )  Nom a A1 b pattern_args5 (a_Pi Rel A B) (a_Pi Rel A C) C'
 | BranchTyping_PiRel : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (Apps5:Apps) (a A1 b:tm) (pattern_args5:pattern_args) (A B C C':tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> BranchTyping  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )  Apps5 Nom a A1 b  ( pattern_args5  ++ [  (p_Tm (Rho Rel) (a_Var_f x))  ])   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_Var_f x) )  C' )  ->
     BranchTyping G  ( (A_cons (A_Tm (Rho Rel)) Apps5) )  Nom a A1 b pattern_args5 (a_Pi Rel A B) (a_Pi Rel A C) C'
 | BranchTyping_PiIrrel : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (Apps5:Apps) (a A1 b:tm) (pattern_args5:pattern_args) (A B C C':tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> BranchTyping  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )  Apps5 Nom a A1 b  ( pattern_args5  ++ [  (p_Tm (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet)  ])   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_Var_f x) )  C' )  ->
     BranchTyping G  ( (A_cons (A_Tm (Rho Irrel)) Apps5) )  Nom a A1 b pattern_args5 (a_Pi Irrel A B) (a_Pi Irrel A C) C'
 | BranchTyping_CPi : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (Apps5:Apps) (a A b:tm) (pattern_args5:pattern_args) (phi:constraint) (B C C':tm),
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> BranchTyping  (( c ~ Co  phi ) ++  G )  Apps5 Nom a A b  ( pattern_args5  ++ [  (p_Co g_Triv)  ])   ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )   ( open_tm_wrt_co C (g_Var_f c) )  C' )  ->
     BranchTyping G  ( (A_cons A_Co Apps5) )  Nom a A b pattern_args5 (a_CPi phi B) (a_CPi phi C) C'.

(* defns Jett *)
Inductive PropWff : context -> constraint -> Prop :=    (* defn PropWff *)
 | E_Wff : forall (G:context) (a b A:tm) (R:role),
     Typing G a A ->
     Typing G b A ->
      ( Typing G A a_Star )  ->
     PropWff G (Eq a b A R)
with Typing : context -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn Typing *)
 | E_Star : forall (G:context),
     Ctx G ->
     Typing G a_Star a_Star
 | E_Var : forall (G:context) (x:tmvar) (A:tm),
     Ctx G ->
      binds  x  (Tm  A )  G  ->
     Typing G (a_Var_f x) A
 | E_Pi : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (rho:relflag) (A B:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  a_Star )  ->
     Typing G A a_Star ->
     Typing G (a_Pi rho A B) a_Star
 | E_Abs : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (rho:relflag) (a A B:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
      ( Typing G A a_Star )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> RhoCheck rho x  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing G (a_UAbs rho a)  ( (a_Pi rho A B) )
 | E_App : forall (G:context) (b a B A:tm),
     Typing G b (a_Pi Rel A B) ->
     Typing G a A ->
     Typing G (a_App b (Rho Rel) a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | E_TApp : forall (G:context) (b:tm) (R:role) (a B A:tm) (Rs:roles),
     Typing G b (a_Pi Rel A B) ->
     Typing G a A ->
     RolePath b  ( R :: Rs )  ->
     Typing G (a_App b (Role R) a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | E_IApp : forall (G:context) (b B a A:tm),
     Typing G b (a_Pi Irrel A B) ->
     Typing G a A ->
     Typing G (a_App b (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | E_Conv : forall (G:context) (a B A:tm),
     Typing G a A ->
     DefEq G  (dom  G )  A B a_Star Rep ->
      ( Typing G B a_Star )  ->
     Typing G a B
 | E_CPi : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (phi:constraint) (B:tm),
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> Typing  (( c ~ Co  phi ) ++  G )   ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )  a_Star )  ->
      ( PropWff G phi )  ->
     Typing G (a_CPi phi B) a_Star
 | E_CAbs : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (a:tm) (phi:constraint) (B:tm),
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> Typing  (( c ~ Co  phi ) ++  G )   ( open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f c) )   ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )  )  ->
      ( PropWff G phi )  ->
     Typing G (a_UCAbs a) (a_CPi phi B)
 | E_CApp : forall (G:context) (a1 B1 a b A:tm) (R:role),
     Typing G a1 (a_CPi  ( (Eq a b A R) )  B1) ->
     DefEq G  (dom  G )  a b A R ->
     Typing G (a_CApp a1 g_Triv)  (open_tm_wrt_co  B1   g_Triv )
 | E_Const : forall (G:context) (F:const) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
     Ctx G ->
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      ( Typing  nil  A a_Star )  ->
     Typing G (a_Fam F) A
 | E_Fam : forall (G:context) (F:const) (A p a:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
     Ctx G ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p a A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      ( Typing  nil  A a_Star )  ->
     Typing G (a_Fam F) A
 | E_Case : forall (G:context) (a:tm) (F:const) (Apps5:Apps) (b1 b2 C A B A1:tm),
     Typing G a A ->
     Typing G b1 B ->
     Typing G b2 C ->
     BranchTyping G Apps5 Nom a A (a_Fam F)  nil  A1 B C ->
     Typing G (a_Fam F) A1 ->
     SatApp F Apps5 ->
     Typing G (a_Pattern Nom a F Apps5 b1 b2) C
with Iso : context -> available_props -> constraint -> constraint -> Prop :=    (* defn Iso *)
 | E_PropCong : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (A1 B1 A:tm) (R:role) (A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq G D A1 A2 A R ->
     DefEq G D B1 B2 A R ->
     Iso G D (Eq A1 B1 A R) (Eq A2 B2 A R)
 | E_IsoConv : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (A1 A2 A:tm) (R:role) (B:tm) (R0:role),
     DefEq G D A B a_Star R0 ->
     PropWff G (Eq A1 A2 A R) ->
     PropWff G (Eq A1 A2 B R) ->
     Iso G D (Eq A1 A2 A R) (Eq A1 A2 B R)
 | E_CPiFst : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a1 a2 A:tm) (R1:role) (b1 b2 B:tm) (R2:role) (B1 B2:tm) (R':role),
     DefEq G D (a_CPi  ( (Eq a1 a2 A R1) )  B1) (a_CPi  ( (Eq b1 b2 B R2) )  B2) a_Star R' ->
     Iso G D (Eq a1 a2 A R1) (Eq b1 b2 B R2)
with DefEq : context -> available_props -> tm -> tm -> tm -> role -> Prop :=    (* defn DefEq *)
 | E_Assn : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a b A:tm) (R:role) (c:covar),
     Ctx G ->
      binds  c  (Co   ( (Eq a b A R) )  )  G  ->
      AtomSetImpl.In  c   D  ->
     DefEq G D a b A R
 | E_Refl : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a A:tm) (R:role),
     Typing G a A ->
     DefEq G D a a A R
 | E_Sym : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a b A:tm) (R:role),
     DefEq G D b a A R ->
     DefEq G D a b A R
 | E_Trans : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a b A:tm) (R:role) (a1:tm),
     DefEq G D a a1 A R ->
     DefEq G D a1 b A R ->
     DefEq G D a b A R
 | E_Sub : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a b A:tm) (R2 R1:role),
     DefEq G D a b A R1 ->
     SubRole R1 R2 ->
     DefEq G D a b A R2
 | E_Beta : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a1 a2 B:tm) (R:role),
     Typing G a1 B ->
      ( Typing G a2 B )  ->

Fixpoint fv_tm_tm_co (g_5:co) : vars :=
  match g_5 with
  | g_Triv => {}
  | (g_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (g_Var_f c) => {}

  | (g_Sym g) => (fv_tm_tm_co g)
  | (g_Trans g1 g2) => (fv_tm_tm_co g1) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g2)
  | (g_Sub g) => (fv_tm_tm_co g)

Definition min (r1 : role) (r2 : role) : role :=
  match r1 , r2 with
  | Nom, _   => Nom
  | _  , Nom => Nom
  | Rep, Rep => Rep
  end.

Definition param (r1 : role) (r2 : role) := min r1 r2.

Definition app_role (rr : appflag) (r1 : role) : role :=
  match rr with
  | Rho _ => Nom
  | Role r => param r r1
  end.

Fixpoint apply_pattern_args (a : tm) (args : pattern_args) : tm :=
  match args with
  | nil => a
  | (p_Tm nu b :: rest) =>
    apply_pattern_args (a_App a nu b) rest
  | (p_Co g :: rest) =>
    apply_pattern_args (a_CApp a g) rest
  end.

Fixpoint A_snoc (xs : Apps) (x : App)  : Apps :=
  match xs with
  | A_nil => A_cons x A_nil
  | A_cons y ys => (A_cons y (A_snoc ys x))
  end.

Definition Star : atom := proj1_sig (atom_fresh empty).
Definition Fix : atom := proj1_sig (atom_fresh (singleton Star)).
Definition FixVar1 : atom := proj1_sig (atom_fresh (singleton Star \u singleton Fix)).
Definition FixVar2 : atom := proj1_sig (atom_fresh (singleton Star \u singleton Fix \u singleton FixVar1)).

Definition FixPat : tm := a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Role Nom) (a_Var_f FixVar2).

Definition FixDef : tm := a_App (a_Var_f FixVar2) (Rho Rel)
                              (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) (a_Var_f FixVar2)).

Definition FixTy : tm  := a_Pi Irrel a_Star
                             (a_Pi Rel (a_Pi Rel (a_Var_b 0) (a_Var_b 1)) (a_Var_b 1)).

Definition toplevel : sig := Fix ~ Ax FixPat FixDef FixTy Nom [Nom].

Lemma AppsPath_empty : forall R (a:tm) F (Apps5:Apps), AppsPath R a F Apps5 -> False.
Proof.
  intros R a F Apps5 H. induction H.
  - apply binds_toplevel_inv in H. destruct H as [HF Hs].
    inversion Hs; discriminate.
  - apply binds_toplevel_inv in H. destruct H as [HF Hs]. inversion Hs; subst.
    apply H0. apply NomBot.
  - apply IHAppsPath.
  - apply IHAppsPath.
  - apply IHAppsPath.

# 190 — System DR: role-indexed type safety

## Task

Prove confluence of role-indexed parallel reduction, show that a reduction step preserves typing and establishes definitional equality at its reduction role, and prove progress under the stated irrelevance condition.

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `confluence`
- `reduction_preservation`
- `progress`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: Metalib.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.

    (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) a).


Ltac kill_axiom :=
  exfalso;
  match goal with Hb : binds ?F (Ax ?p ?bt ?A ?R1 ?Rs) toplevel |- _ =>
    pose proof Hb as Hb0;
    apply binds_toplevel_inv in Hb; destruct Hb as [HF Hs]; subst F; inversion Hs; subst end;
  match goal with Hren : Rename FixPat FixDef ?pp ?bbt ?DD ?DDg |- _ =>
    assert (HinD : AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 DD)
      by (unfold FixPat in *; simpl in *; fsetdec);
    destruct (Rename_FixPat_def pp bbt DD DDg HinD Hren)
      as [y0 [Hpp [Hbb [Hyne0 HyD0]]]]; subst pp end;
  match goal with Hm : MatchSubst _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
    inversion Hm; subst; try discriminate end.


Lemma MatchSubst_FixPat_analysis : forall (D D':available_props) p' bb
  (nu:appflag) (a a1 a2:tm),
  AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 D ->
  Rename FixPat FixDef p' bb D D' ->
  MatchSubst (a_App a nu a1) p' bb a2 ->

    p' = a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Role Nom) (a_Var_f y) /\
    bb = tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef /\
    nu = Role Nom /\
    a = a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) z /\
    lc_tm z /\ lc_tm bb /\
    a2 = tm_subst_tm_tm a1 y bb.
Proof.
  intros D D' p' bb nu a a1 a2 HD Hren Hm.
  destruct (Rename_FixPat_def p' bb D D' HD Hren)
    as [y [Hp [Hb [Hyne HyD]]]].
  subst p'.
  inversion Hm; subst; try discriminate.
  inversion H8; subst; try discriminate.
  inversion H2; subst; try discriminate.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic syntactic helpers                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma lc_tm_App_r : forall (a b:tm) (nu:appflag), lc_tm (a_App a nu b) -> lc_tm b.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_App_l : forall (a b:tm) (nu:appflag), lc_tm (a_App a nu b) -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_CApp_l : forall (a:tm) (g:co), lc_tm (a_CApp a g) -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

(* The inner pattern of FixPat. *)
Definition Fn : tm := a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet.

(* ValuePath terms are never abstractions. *)
Lemma ValuePath_UAbs_absurd : forall (a:tm) F (rho:relflag) (b:tm),
  ValuePath a F -> a <> a_UAbs rho b.
Proof. intros a F rho b H. induction H; intros E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma ValuePath_UCAbs_absurd : forall (a:tm) F (b:tm),
  ValuePath a F -> a <> a_UCAbs b.
Proof. intros a F b H. induction H; intros E; discriminate E. Qed.

(* Pattern agreement at the base constants. *)
Lemma tm_pattern_agree_FamFix_eq : forall (x:tm),
  tm_pattern_agree x (a_Fam Fix) -> x = a_Fam Fix.
Proof. intros x H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma not_tm_pattern_agree_FamFix_FixPat :
  ~ tm_pattern_agree (a_Fam Fix) FixPat.
Proof. intro H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate. Qed.

Lemma not_tm_pattern_agree_FamFix_Fn :
  ~ tm_pattern_agree (a_Fam Fix) Fn.
Proof. intro H. unfold Fn in H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate. Qed.

Lemma not_subtm_FamFix_FixPat : ~ subtm_pattern_agree (a_Fam Fix) FixPat.
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  exact (not_tm_pattern_agree_FamFix_FixPat H1).
Qed.

(* FixPat's sub-patterns: the only proper sub-patterns of FixPat that are not
   themselves pattern-agreeing with FixPat.  (This is the standard case
   analysis; cf. the helper in the unavailable Confl development.) *)
Lemma fixpat_subpattern_cases : forall a,
  tm_subpattern_agree a FixPat ->
  ~ tm_pattern_agree a FixPat ->
  (a = a_Fam Fix \/
   exists z, a = a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) z /\ lc_tm z).
Proof.
  intros a Hsub Hnot.
  inversion Hsub; subst; try discriminate.
  - exfalso; exact (Hnot H).
  - inversion H1; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* Base inner *)
      inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
      inversion H4; subst; try discriminate.
      right. eexists. split; [reflexivity | exact H2].
    + (* AppIrrel inner *)
      inversion H2; subst; try discriminate.
      inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
      left. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Shape of the result of MatchSubst against the renamed Fix    *)
(* pattern.  For the Fix axiom, a successful MatchSubst always  *)
(* yields a term whose head application is Rho Rel.             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma subst_fixdef_apply : forall (y:tmvar) (a:tm), y <> FixVar2 ->
  tm_subst_tm_tm a y (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef)
  = a_App a (Rho Rel)
      (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) a).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite (subst_fixdef_open y H).
  cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. destruct (eq_var y y) as [e|ne];
    [reflexivity|exfalso; apply ne; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma MatchSubst_FixPat_result :
  forall (D D':available_props) p' bb (a' a1':tm) (nu:appflag) a2,

with lc_co_at (k j:nat) (g:co) : Prop :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => True
  | g_Var_b n => n < j
  | g_Var_f c => True
  | g_Beta a b => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b

  | g_AbsCong rho R g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at (S k) j g2
  | g_AppCong g1 rho R g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_PiFst g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_CPiFst g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_IsoSnd g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k (S j) g3

  | g_CPiSnd g g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g /\ lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_Cast g1 R g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_tm_at k j A /\ lc_co_at k j g2

  | g_Right g g' => lc_co_at k j g /\ lc_co_at k j g'
  end
with lc_brs_at (k j:nat) (b:brs) : Prop :=
  match b with

  | br_One K a brs5 => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_brs_at k j brs5

  | a_Pi rho A B => lc_tm_at k j A /\ lc_tm_at (S k) j B
  | a_CAbs phi b => lc_cs_at k j phi /\ lc_tm_at k (S j) b

  | a_Fam F => True
  | a_Bullet => True
  | a_Pattern R a F Apps5 b1 b2 => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b1 /\ lc_tm_at k j b2
  | a_DataCon K => True
  | a_Case a brs5 => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_brs_at k j brs5
  | a_Sub R a => lc_tm_at k j a
  | a_Coerce => True
  | a_SrcApp a b => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b
  end.

Definition Ltm1 (a:tm) := forall k j y, lc_tm_at k j a -> open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) a = a.
Definition Lco1 (g:co) := forall k j y, lc_co_at k j g -> open_co_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) g = g.
Definition Lbrs1 (b:brs) := forall k j y, lc_brs_at k j b -> open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) b = b.
Definition Lcs1 (phi:constraint) := forall k j y, lc_cs_at k j phi -> open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) phi = phi.
Ltac solve_lcopen1 :=
  unfold Ltm1, Lco1, Lbrs1, Lcs1 in *; intros; simpl in *;
  repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end; simpl in *;
  try match goal with H : ?n < ?m |- _ =>
        destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n m) as [[hz1|hz2]|hz3]; try (exfalso; lia); reflexivity end;
  try solve [repeat f_equal; eauto].
Lemma lc_open_tm_at : forall a, Ltm1 a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 Lcs1 Ltm1 Lbrs1 Lco1). all: solve [solve_lcopen1]. Qed.
Lemma lc_open_co_at : forall g, Lco1 g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 Lcs1 Ltm1 Lbrs1 Lco1). all: solve [solve_lcopen1]. Qed.
Lemma lc_open_brs_at : forall b, Lbrs1 b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 Lcs1 Ltm1 Lbrs1 Lco1). all: solve [solve_lcopen1]. Qed.
Lemma lc_open_cs_at : forall phi, Lcs1 phi.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 Lcs1 Ltm1 Lbrs1 Lco1). all: solve [solve_lcopen1]. Qed.

Definition Mtm2 (a:tm) := forall k j h, lc_tm_at k j a -> open_tm_wrt_co_rec j h a = a.

Theorem confluence : forall W a a1 R,
  Par W a a1 R ->
  forall a2, Par W a a2 R -> exists b, Par W a1 b R /\ Par W a2 b R.
Proof.
  intros W a a1 R H1 a2 H2.

Theorem reduction_preservation : forall a a' R, reduction_in_one a a' R -> forall G A D,
      Typing G a A -> Typing G a' A /\ DefEq G D a a' A R.

End ConflProof.
Fixpoint ctx_nom (G : context) := match G with
  | nil => nil
  | (x, Tm _) :: G' => (x, Nom) :: ctx_nom G'
  | (x, Co _) :: G' => ctx_nom G'
  end.

Definition Good (G : context) (D : available_props):=
  forall c1 A B1 T1 R,
    binds c1 (Co (Eq A B1 T1 R)) G
    -> c1 `in` D
    -> exists C, Par (ctx_nom G) A C R /\ Par (ctx_nom G) B1 C R.

Definition irrelevant G D (a : tm) :=
  (forall x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a) /\ Good G D.


Module VP.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic syntactic helpers                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma lc_tm_App_r : forall (a b:tm) (nu:appflag), lc_tm (a_App a nu b) -> lc_tm b.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_App_l : forall (a b:tm) (nu:appflag), lc_tm (a_App a nu b) -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_CApp_l : forall (a:tm) (g:co), lc_tm (a_CApp a g) -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

(* The inner pattern of FixPat. *)
Definition Fn : tm := a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet.

(* ValuePath terms are never abstractions. *)
Lemma ValuePath_UAbs_absurd : forall (a:tm) F (rho:relflag) (b:tm),
  ValuePath a F -> a <> a_UAbs rho b.
Proof. intros a F rho b H. induction H; intros E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma ValuePath_UCAbs_absurd : forall (a:tm) F (b:tm),
  ValuePath a F -> a <> a_UCAbs b.
Proof. intros a F b H. induction H; intros E; discriminate E. Qed.

(* Pattern agreement at the base constants. *)
Lemma tm_pattern_agree_FamFix_eq : forall (x:tm),
  tm_pattern_agree x (a_Fam Fix) -> x = a_Fam Fix.
Proof. intros x H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma not_tm_pattern_agree_FamFix_FixPat :
  ~ tm_pattern_agree (a_Fam Fix) FixPat.
Proof. intro H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate. Qed.

Lemma not_tm_pattern_agree_FamFix_Fn :
  ~ tm_pattern_agree (a_Fam Fix) Fn.
Proof. intro H. unfold Fn in H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate. Qed.

Lemma not_subtm_FamFix_FixPat : ~ subtm_pattern_agree (a_Fam Fix) FixPat.
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  match goal with Hp : tm_pattern_agree (a_Fam Fix) FixPat |- _ =>
    exact (not_tm_pattern_agree_FamFix_FixPat Hp) end.
Qed.

(* FixPat's sub-patterns: the only proper sub-patterns of FixPat that are not
   themselves pattern-agreeing with FixPat.  (This is the standard case
   analysis; cf. the helper in the unavailable Confl development.) *)
Lemma fixpat_subpattern_cases : forall a,
  tm_subpattern_agree a FixPat ->
  ~ tm_pattern_agree a FixPat ->
  (a = a_Fam Fix \/
   exists z, a = a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) z /\ lc_tm z).
Proof.
  intros a Hsub Hnot.
  inversion Hsub; subst; try discriminate.
  - exfalso; exact (Hnot H).
  - inversion H1; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* Base inner *)
      inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
      inversion H4; subst; try discriminate.
      right. eexists. split; [reflexivity | exact H2].
    + (* AppIrrel inner *)
      inversion H2; subst; try discriminate.
      inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
      left. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Shape of the result of MatchSubst against the renamed Fix    *)
(* pattern.  For the Fix axiom, a successful MatchSubst always  *)
(* yields a term whose head application is Rho Rel.             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma subst_fixdef_apply : forall (y:tmvar) (a:tm), y <> FixVar2 ->
  tm_subst_tm_tm a y (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef)
  = a_App a (Rho Rel)
      (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) a).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite (subst_fixdef_open y H).
  cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. destruct (eq_var y y) as [e|ne];
    [reflexivity|exfalso; apply ne; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma MatchSubst_FixPat_result :
  forall (D D':available_props) p' bb (a' a1':tm) (nu:appflag) a2,
  AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 D ->
  Rename FixPat FixDef p' bb D D' ->
  MatchSubst (a_App a' nu a1') p' bb a2 ->
  nu = Role Nom /\ exists u v, a2 = a_App u (Rho Rel) v.
Proof.
  intros D D' p' bb a' a1' nu a2 Hin Hren Hms.
  destruct (Rename_FixPat_def p' bb D D' Hin Hren)
    as [y [Hp [Hbb [Hyne HyD]]]].
  subst p'. subst bb.
  inversion Hms; subst; try discriminate.
  (* only AppRelR survived: nu = Role Nom, inner MatchSubst a' Fn ... *)
  split; [reflexivity|].
  match goal with
  | Hmi : MatchSubst a' (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet)
             (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef) ?b2 |- _ =>
      inversion Hmi; subst; try discriminate;
      (match goal with
       | Hmi2 : MatchSubst ?a1 (a_Fam Fix)
                  (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef) ?bb2 |- _ =>
           inversion Hmi2; subst; try discriminate
       end)
  end.
  (* inner MatchSubst_AppIrrel then Const; b2 is the renamed FixDef *)
  rewrite (subst_fixdef_apply y a1' Hyne).
  eexists a1', _; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma MatchSubst_FixPat_CApp_dead :
  forall (D D':available_props) p' bb (a':tm) a2,
  AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 D ->
  Rename FixPat FixDef p' bb D D' ->
  MatchSubst (a_CApp a' g_Triv) p' bb a2 -> False.
Proof.
  intros D D' p' bb a' a2 Hin Hren Hms.
  destruct (Rename_FixPat_def p' bb D D' Hin Hren)
    as [y [Hp [Hbb [Hyne HyD]]]].
  subst p'. inversion Hms; subst; try discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma MatchSubst_FamFix_app_dead :
  forall (D D':available_props) p' bb (nu:appflag) (a1' a2:tm),
  AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 D ->
  Rename FixPat FixDef p' bb D D' ->
  MatchSubst (a_App (a_Fam Fix) nu a1') p' bb a2 -> False.

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia Permutation.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev LC RU V VS SO PA VarF RM PSub CS CS2 PC CV CoSub Dia.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic syntactic helpers                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma lc_tm_App_r : forall (a b:tm) (nu:appflag), lc_tm (a_App a nu b) -> lc_tm b.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_App_l : forall (a b:tm) (nu:appflag), lc_tm (a_App a nu b) -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_CApp_l : forall (a:tm) (g:co), lc_tm (a_CApp a g) -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

(* The inner pattern of FixPat. *)
Definition Fn : tm := a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet.

(* ValuePath terms are never abstractions. *)
Lemma ValuePath_UAbs_absurd : forall (a:tm) F (rho:relflag) (b:tm),
  ValuePath a F -> a <> a_UAbs rho b.
Proof. intros a F rho b H. induction H; intros E; discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma ValuePath_UCAbs_absurd : forall (a:tm) F (b:tm),
  ValuePath a F -> a <> a_UCAbs b.
Proof. intros a F b H. induction H; intros E; discriminate E. Qed.

(* A value path never reduces (via Par) to an abstraction.       *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Par_ValuePath_abs_absurd : forall (a:tm) (F:const),
  ValuePath a F -> F = Fix ->
  forall W (b:tm) R, Par W a b R ->
  (forall (rho:relflag) (body:tm), b <> a_UAbs rho body) /\
  (forall (body:tm), b <> a_UCAbs body).
Proof.
  intros a F Hvp. induction Hvp; intros Heq W b R Hpar.
  - (* AbsConst *)
    exfalso. subst F.
    apply binds_toplevel_inv in H. destruct H as [HF Hs]. discriminate Hs.
  - (* Const *)
    subst F.
    inversion Hpar; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* Refl *) split; intros; discriminate.
    + (* AxiomBase dead *) exfalso. eapply Par_AxiomBase_dead; eauto.
  - (* App *)
    subst F. pose proof (IHHvp eq_refl) as IH'.
    inversion Hpar; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* Refl *) split; intros; discriminate.
    + (* Beta: function part reduces to an abstraction, impossible *)
      exfalso.
      match goal with Hprem : Par W a (a_UAbs ?rho ?aa) R |- _ =>
        exact (proj1 (IH' W (a_UAbs rho aa) R Hprem) rho aa eq_refl) end.
    + (* App *) split; intros; discriminate.
    + (* AxiomApp: target has shape App (Rho Rel) *)
      pose proof H3 as Hb0. apply binds_toplevel_inv in Hb0.
      destruct Hb0 as [HF Hs]. subst F. inversion Hs; subst.
      assert (HinD : AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2
                (union (dom W) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat)))
        by (unfold FixPat; simpl; fsetdec).
      destruct (MatchSubst_FixPat_result
                  (union (dom W) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat)) D' p' b'0 a' a1' nu b
                  HinD H8 H11) as [Hnu [u [v E]]].
      subst b. split; intros; discriminate.
  - (* CApp *)
    subst F. pose proof (IHHvp eq_refl) as IH'.
    inversion Hpar; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* Refl *) split; intros; discriminate.
    + (* CBeta *)
      exfalso.
      match goal with Hprem : Par W a (a_UCAbs ?aa) R |- _ =>
        exact (proj2 (IH' W (a_UCAbs aa) R Hprem) aa eq_refl) end.
    + (* CApp *) split; intros; discriminate.
    + (* AxiomCApp dead *)
      pose proof H0 as Hb0. apply binds_toplevel_inv in Hb0.
      destruct Hb0 as [HF Hs]. subst F. inversion Hs; subst.
      assert (HinD : AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2
                (union (dom W) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat)))
        by (unfold FixPat; simpl; fsetdec).
      exfalso.
      exact (MatchSubst_FixPat_CApp_dead
               (union (dom W) (fv_tm_tm_tm FixPat)) D' p' b' a' b HinD H3 H4).
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Reflection of pattern agreement (at FixPat and at Fn) along  *)
(* Par, for value-path sources.                                  *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Par_pattern_back : forall (a:tm) (F:const), ValuePath a F -> F = Fix ->
  (forall W (b:tm) R, Par W a b R -> tm_pattern_agree b FixPat -> tm_pattern_agree a FixPat)
  /\ (forall W (b:tm) R, Par W a b R -> tm_pattern_agree b Fn -> tm_pattern_agree a Fn)
  /\ (forall W (b:tm) R, Par W a b R -> b = a_Fam Fix -> a = a_Fam Fix).

Qed.


(* ============================================================ *)
(* PathValue_par                                                 *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma PathValue_par_gen : forall (a:tm) (F:const), ValuePath a F -> F = Fix ->
  forall W (b:tm) R, Par W a b R -> ~ subtm_pattern_agree a FixPat ->
  ValuePath b Fix /\ ~ subtm_pattern_agree b FixPat.
Proof.
  intros a F Hvp. induction Hvp; intros Heq W b R Hpar Hnot.
  - (* ValuePath_AbsConst *)
    exfalso. subst F.
    apply binds_toplevel_inv in H. destruct H as [HF Hs]. discriminate Hs.
  - (* ValuePath_Const *)
    subst F.
    pose proof (Par_FamFix_inv W b R Hpar) as E. subst b.
    split.
    + eapply ValuePath_Const; eauto.
    + apply not_subtm_FamFix_FixPat.
  - (* ValuePath_App *)
    subst F. pose proof (IHHvp eq_refl) as IH'.
    assert (Hnot0 : ~ subtm_pattern_agree a FixPat).
    { intro Hs. apply Hnot. eapply subtm_pattern_agree_App; eauto. }
    inversion Hpar; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* Refl *)
      split; [ eapply ValuePath_App; eauto | exact Hnot ].
    + (* Beta *) exfalso.
      match goal with Hprem : Par W a (a_UAbs ?rr ?bd) R |- _ =>
        exact (proj1 (Par_ValuePath_abs_absurd a Fix Hvp eq_refl
                        W (a_UAbs rr bd) R Hprem) rr bd eq_refl) end.
    + (* App *)
      match goal with
      | Hfunc : Par W a ?z ?r, Harg : Par W b' ?w ?s |- _ =>
          pose proof (proj1 (IH' W z r Hfunc Hnot0)) as Hvpa0';
          pose proof (proj2 (IH' W z r Hfunc Hnot0)) as Hnota0';
          assert (Hlcbg : lc_tm w)
            by (destruct (Par_roleing _ _ _ _ Harg) as [_ Hr];
                apply roleing_lc_tm; exact Hr);
          split;
          [ eapply ValuePath_App; eauto
          | intro Hs; inversion Hs; subst; try discriminate;
            [ (* Base *)
              exfalso;
              match goal with
              | Hpa : tm_pattern_agree (a_App z ?nu0 w) FixPat |- _ =>
                  inversion Hpa; subst; try discriminate;
                  match goal with
                  | Hpa2 : tm_pattern_agree ?xx (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) |- _ =>
                      change (tm_pattern_agree xx Fn) in Hpa2;
                      match goal with
                      | Hp0 : Par W a xx ?rr |- _ =>
                          pose proof (proj1 (Par_pattern_back a Fix Hvp eq_refl
                                              W xx rr Hp0 Hpa2)) as Hpat0;
                          apply Hnot; apply subtm_pattern_agree_Base;
                          apply tm_pattern_agree_AppRelR with (R := Nom) (p1 := Fn) (x := FixVar2);
                          [ exact H | exact Hpat0 ]
                      end
                  end
              end
            | (* App body *)
              match goal with Hsub : subtm_pattern_agree z FixPat |- _ =>
                exact (Hnota0' Hsub) end ] ]
      end.
    + (* AxiomApp *) Show.
      admit.
  - (* ValuePath_CApp *)
    subst F. pose proof (IHHvp eq_refl) as IH'.
    assert (Hnot0 : ~ subtm_pattern_agree a FixPat).
    { intro Hs. apply Hnot. eapply subtm_pattern_agree_CAppp; eauto. }
    inversion Hpar; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* Refl *) split; [ eapply ValuePath_CApp; eauto | exact Hnot ].
    + (* CBeta *) exfalso.
      match goal with Hprem : Par W a (a_UCAbs ?bd) R |- _ =>
        exact (proj2 (Par_ValuePath_abs_absurd a Fix Hvp eq_refl
                        W (a_UCAbs bd) R Hprem) bd eq_refl) end.
    + (* CApp *)
      match goal with Hfunc : Par W a ?a0' ?R0 |- _ =>
          pose proof (proj1 (IH' W a0' R0 Hfunc Hnot0)) as Hvpa0';
          pose proof (proj2 (IH' W a0' R0 Hfunc Hnot0)) as Hnota0';
          split;
          [ eapply ValuePath_CApp; eauto
          | intro Hs; inversion Hs; subst; try discriminate;
            [ (* Base *) inversion Hpa; subst; try discriminate
            | (* CAppp *)
              match goal with Hsub : subtm_pattern_agree a0' FixPat |- _ =>
                exact (Hnota0' Hsub) end ] ]
      end.
    + (* AxiomCApp *) Show.
      admit.
Qed.
