binds_perm
     : forall (A : Type) (x : atom) (a : A) (W W' : list (atom * A)),
       binds x a W -> Permutation W W' -> binds x a W'
dom_perm
     : forall (A : Type) (W W' : list (atom * A)),
       Permutation W W' -> forall x : atom, x `in` dom W <-> x `in` dom W'
uniq_perm
     : forall (A : Type) (W W' : list (atom * A)),
       Permutation W W' -> uniq W -> uniq W'
binds_drop
     : forall (A : Type) (E F : list (atom * A)) (x y : atom) (b a : A),
       y <> x -> binds y a (E ++ (x, b) :: F) -> binds y a (E ++ F)
binds_self_app
     : forall (A : Type) (E F : list (atom * A)) (x : atom) (r : A),
       binds x r (E ++ (x, r) :: F)
dom_binds
     : forall (A : Type) (W : list (atom * A)) (x : atom),
       x `in` dom W <-> (exists a : A, binds x a W)

     : forall (A : Type) (E : list (atom * A)) (x : atom),
       x `in` dom E <-> In x (map (fun p : atom * A => fst p) E)

     : forall (A : Type) (W : list (atom * A)),

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia Permutation.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev LC RU V VS SO PA VarF RM PSub CS CS2 PC CV CoSub Dia.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic context facts                                          *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Definition CtxSub (G G':context) : Prop :=
  forall x s, binds x s G -> binds x s G'.

Lemma CtxSub_refl : forall G, CtxSub G G.
Proof. intros G x s H; exact H. Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_trans : forall G1 G2 G3,
  CtxSub G1 G2 -> CtxSub G2 G3 -> CtxSub G1 G3.
Proof. intros G1 G2 G3 H12 H23 x s H; auto. Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_cons : forall G G' x s,
  CtxSub G G' -> CtxSub G ((x,s) :: G').
Proof.
  intros G G' x s H y t Hy. unfold binds in *. simpl. right. auto.
Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_dom : forall G G' c,
  CtxSub G G' -> c `in` dom G -> c `in` dom G'.
Proof.
  intros G G' c Hsub Hin.
  apply dom_binds in Hin. destruct Hin as [s Hs].
  apply dom_binds. exists s. apply Hsub. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_old : forall (x:atom) (s:sort) G (y:atom) (t:sort),
  binds y t G -> binds y t ((x,s) :: G).
Proof. intros. unfold binds in *. simpl. auto. Qed.

Lemma Ctx_uniq : forall G, Ctx G -> uniq G.
Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - apply uniq_nil.
  - apply uniq_push; auto.
  - apply uniq_push; auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Free-variable facts for opening / substitution               *)
(* ============================================================ *)

(* [fv] of an opening wrt a term variable is a subset of the old fv plus the
   opened variable. *)
Definition FvOpenT (a:tm) : Prop :=
  forall y x, y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) a) ->
              y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm a \/ y = x.
Definition FvOpenC (g:co) : Prop :=
  forall y x, y `in` fv_tm_tm_co (open_co_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) g) ->
              y `in` fv_tm_tm_co g \/ y = x.
Definition FvOpenB (b:brs) : Prop :=
  forall y x, y `in` fv_tm_tm_brs (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) b) ->
              y `in` fv_tm_tm_brs b \/ y = x.
Definition FvOpenK (p:constraint) : Prop :=
  forall y x, y `in` fv_tm_tm_constraint (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) p) ->
              y `in` fv_tm_tm_constraint p \/ y = x.

Ltac solve_fvopen :=
  unfold FvOpenT, FvOpenC, FvOpenB, FvOpenK in *;
  intros; simpl in *;
  repeat match goal with H : _ \/ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
  auto; fsetdec.

Lemma fv_open_tm : forall a, FvOpenT a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 FvOpenK FvOpenT FvOpenB FvOpenC). all: solve [solve_fvopen]. Qed.
Lemma fv_open_co : forall g, FvOpenC g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 FvOpenK FvOpenT FvOpenB FvOpenC). all: solve [solve_fvopen]. Qed.
Lemma fv_open_brs : forall b, FvOpenB b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 FvOpenK FvOpenT FvOpenB FvOpenC). all: solve [solve_fvopen]. Qed.
Lemma fv_open_cs : forall p, FvOpenK p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 FvOpenK FvOpenT FvOpenB FvOpenC). all: solve [solve_fvopen]. Qed.

(* opening wrt a term variable never loses free variables (except that the
   opened name is included) *)
Definition FvOpenT' (a:tm) : Prop :=
  forall y x, y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm a ->
              y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) a) \/ y = x.
Definition FvOpenC' (g:co) : Prop :=
  forall y x, y `in` fv_tm_tm_co g ->
              y `in` fv_tm_tm_co (open_co_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) g) \/ y = x.
Definition FvOpenB' (b:brs) : Prop :=
  forall y x, y `in` fv_tm_tm_brs b ->
              y `in` fv_tm_tm_brs (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) b) \/ y = x.
Definition FvOpenK' (p:constraint) : Prop :=
  forall y x, y `in` fv_tm_tm_constraint p ->
              y `in` fv_tm_tm_constraint (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) p) \/ y = x.

Ltac solve_fvopen' :=
  unfold FvOpenT', FvOpenC', FvOpenB', FvOpenK' in *;
  intros; simpl in *;
  repeat match goal with H : _ \/ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
  auto; fsetdec.

Lemma fv_open_tm' : forall a, FvOpenT' a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 FvOpenK' FvOpenT' FvOpenB' FvOpenC'). all: solve [solve_fvopen']. Qed.
Lemma fv_open_co' : forall g, FvOpenC' g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 FvOpenK' FvOpenT' FvOpenB' FvOpenC'). all: solve [solve_fvopen']. Qed.
Lemma fv_open_brs' : forall b, FvOpenB' b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 FvOpenK' FvOpenT' FvOpenB' FvOpenC'). all: solve [solve_fvopen']. Qed.
Lemma fv_open_cs' : forall p, FvOpenK' p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 FvOpenK' FvOpenT' FvOpenB' FvOpenC'). all: solve [solve_fvopen']. Qed.

(* opening wrt a covariable does not change term free variables *)
Definition FvCoT (a:tm) : Prop :=
  forall y h, y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_co_rec 0 h a) <-> y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm a.
Definition FvCoC (g:co) : Prop :=
  forall y h, y `in` fv_tm_tm_co (open_co_wrt_co_rec 0 h g) <-> y `in` fv_tm_tm_co g.
Definition FvCoB (b:brs) : Prop :=
  forall y h, y `in` fv_tm_tm_brs (open_brs_wrt_co_rec 0 h b) <-> y `in` fv_tm_tm_brs b.
Definition FvCoK (p:constraint) : Prop :=
  forall y h, y `in` fv_tm_tm_constraint (open_constraint_wrt_co_rec 0 h p) <-> y `in` fv_tm_tm_constraint p.

Ltac solve_fvco :=
  unfold FvCoT, FvCoC, FvCoB, FvCoK in *;
  intros; simpl in *;
  repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
  try solve [fsetdec].
Lemma fv_openco_tm : forall a, FvCoT a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 FvCoK FvCoT FvCoB FvCoC). all: solve [solve_fvco]. Qed.
Lemma fv_openco_co : forall g, FvCoC g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 FvCoK FvCoT FvCoB FvCoC). all: solve [solve_fvco]. Qed.
Lemma fv_openco_brs : forall b, FvCoB b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 FvCoK FvCoT FvCoB FvCoC). all: solve [solve_fvco]. Qed.
Lemma fv_openco_cs : forall p, FvCoK p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 FvCoK FvCoT FvCoB FvCoC). all: solve [solve_fvco]. Qed.

Lemma fv_open_tm_in : forall a y x,
  y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) -> y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm a \/ y = x.
Proof. intros. apply (fv_open_tm a y x). exact H. Qed.

Lemma fv_open_co_in : forall a y h,
  y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_co a h) <-> y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm a.
Proof. intros. apply (fv_openco_tm a y h). Qed.

(* opening does not lose old free variables *)
Lemma fv_open_tm_old : forall a y x,
  y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm a -> y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) \/ y = x.
Proof. intros. apply (fv_open_tm' a y x). exact H. Qed.

(* substitution: fv of substituted term is contained in old fv and fv of u *)
Definition FvSubT (a:tm) : Prop :=
  forall y u x, y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm u x a) ->
                y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm a \/ y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm u.
Definition FvSubC (g:co) : Prop :=
  forall y u x, y `in` fv_tm_tm_co (tm_subst_tm_co u x g) ->
                y `in` fv_tm_tm_co g \/ y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm u.
Definition FvSubB (b:brs) : Prop :=
  forall y u x, y `in` fv_tm_tm_brs (tm_subst_tm_brs u x b) ->
                y `in` fv_tm_tm_brs b \/ y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm u.
Definition FvSubK (p:constraint) : Prop :=
  forall y u x, y `in` fv_tm_tm_constraint (tm_subst_tm_constraint u x p) ->
                y `in` fv_tm_tm_constraint p \/ y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm u.

Ltac solve_fvsub :=
  unfold FvSubT, FvSubC, FvSubB, FvSubK in *;
  intros; simpl in *;
  repeat match goal with H : _ \/ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
  try match goal with H : (if eq_var ?x ?y then _ else _) |- _ => destruct (eq_var x y); simpl in * end;
  auto; fsetdec.

Lemma fv_subst_tm : forall a, FvSubT a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 FvSubK FvSubT FvSubB FvSubC). all: solve [solve_fvsub]. Qed.
Lemma fv_subst_co : forall g, FvSubC g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 FvSubK FvSubT FvSubB FvSubC). all: solve [solve_fvsub]. Qed.
Lemma fv_subst_brs : forall b, FvSubB b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 FvSubK FvSubT FvSubB FvSubC). all: solve [solve_fvsub]. Qed.
Lemma fv_subst_cs : forall p, FvSubK p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 FvSubK FvSubT FvSubB FvSubC). all: solve [solve_fvsub]. Qed.

Lemma fv_subst_tm_in : forall a y u x,
  y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm u x a) ->
  y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm a \/ y `in` fv_tm_tm_tm u.
Proof. intros. apply (fv_subst_tm a y u x). exact H. Qed.

with lc_tm_at (k j:nat) (a:tm) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | a_Star => True
  | a_Var_b n => n < k
  | a_Var_f x => True
  | a_Abs rho A b => lc_tm_at k j A /\ lc_tm_at (S k) j b
  | a_UAbs rho b => lc_tm_at (S k) j b
  | a_App a nu b => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b
  | a_Pi rho A B => lc_tm_at k j A /\ lc_tm_at (S k) j B
  | a_CAbs phi b => lc_cs_at k j phi /\ lc_tm_at k (S j) b
  | a_UCAbs b => lc_tm_at k (S j) b
  | a_CApp a g => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_co_at k j g
  | a_CPi phi B => lc_cs_at k j phi /\ lc_tm_at k (S j) B
  | a_Conv a R g => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_co_at k j g
  | a_Fam F => True
  | a_Bullet => True
  | a_Pattern R a F Apps5 b1 b2 => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b1 /\ lc_tm_at k j b2
  | a_DataCon K => True
  | a_Case a brs5 => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_brs_at k j brs5
  | a_Sub R a => lc_tm_at k j a
  | a_Coerce => True
  | a_SrcApp a b => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b
  end.

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia Permutation.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev LC RU V VS SO PA VarF RM PSub CS CS2 PC CV CoSub Dia.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic context facts                                          *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Definition CtxSub (G G':context) : Prop :=
  forall x s, binds x s G -> binds x s G'.

Lemma CtxSub_refl : forall G, CtxSub G G.
Proof. intros G x s H; exact H. Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_trans : forall G1 G2 G3,
  CtxSub G1 G2 -> CtxSub G2 G3 -> CtxSub G1 G3.
Proof. intros G1 G2 G3 H12 H23 x s H; auto. Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_cons : forall G G' x s,
  CtxSub G G' -> CtxSub G ((x,s) :: G').
Proof.
  intros G G' x s H y t Hy. unfold binds in *. simpl. right. apply H. exact Hy.
Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_dom : forall G G' c,
  CtxSub G G' -> c `in` dom G -> c `in` dom G'.
Proof.
  intros G G' c Hsub Hin.
  apply dom_binds in Hin. destruct Hin as [s Hs].
  apply dom_binds. exists s. apply Hsub. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_old : forall (x:atom) (s:sort) G (y:atom) (t:sort),
  binds y t G -> binds y t ((x,s) :: G).
Proof. intros. unfold binds in *. simpl. auto. Qed.

Lemma Ctx_uniq : forall G, Ctx G -> uniq G.
Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - apply uniq_nil.
  - apply uniq_push; auto.
  - apply uniq_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_dom_in : forall G (x:atom) s, binds x s G -> x `in` dom G.
Proof. intros. apply dom_binds. exists s. exact H. Qed.

(* handy notin-union facts *)
Lemma notin_union_l : forall (y:atom) (A B:atoms),
  y `notin` (A `union` B) -> y `notin` A.
Proof. intros y A B H Hy. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact Hy. Qed.
Lemma notin_union_r : forall (y:atom) (A B:atoms),
  y `notin` (A `union` B) -> y `notin` B.
Proof. intros y A B H Hy. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact Hy. Qed.
#[local] Hint Resolve notin_union_l notin_union_r : core.

Ltac notin_dec :=
  repeat match goal with
  | H : _ `in` AtomSetImpl.union _ _ |- _ =>
      apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in H; destruct H
  | H : _ `in` AtomSetImpl.singleton _ |- _ =>
      apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in H; subst
  end.

Ltac decomp_one H :=
  match type of H with
  | context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?n ?k] =>
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?]; try discriminate; simpl in *
  | context [match ?n with 0 => _ | S _ => _ end] =>
      destruct n; simpl in *
  | _ => fail
  end.

Ltac decomp_dec :=
  repeat match goal with
  | H : _ `in` _ |- _ => decomp_one H
  end.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* fv: opening adds no new free names beyond the opened thing   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Definition NOtm (a:tm) : Prop :=
  forall k (v:tm) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm v -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k v a).
Definition NOco (g:co) : Prop :=
  forall k (v:tm) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm v -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co g ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k v g).
Definition NObrs (b:brs) : Prop :=
  forall k (v:tm) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm v -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs b ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k v b).
Definition NOcs (p:constraint) : Prop :=
  forall k (v:tm) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm v -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint p ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k v p).

Ltac solve_nopen :=
  unfold NOtm, NOco, NObrs, NOcs in *;
  intros; simpl in *;
  intro Hc; simpl in *;
  decomp_dec; notin_dec;
  eauto 10; fsetdec.

Lemma nopen_tm : forall a, NOtm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 NOcs NOtm NObrs NOco). all: solve [solve_nopen]. Qed.
Lemma nopen_co : forall g, NOco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 NOcs NOtm NObrs NOco). all: solve [solve_nopen]. Qed.
Lemma nopen_brs : forall b, NObrs b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 NOcs NOtm NObrs NOco). all: solve [solve_nopen]. Qed.
Lemma nopen_cs : forall p, NOcs p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 NOcs NOtm NObrs NOco). all: solve [solve_nopen]. Qed.

(* co-opening adds no new free term names beyond the co *)
Definition NCOtm (a:tm) : Prop :=
  forall k (h:co) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co h -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k h a).
Definition NCOco (g:co) : Prop :=
  forall k (h:co) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co h -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co g ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co (open_co_wrt_co_rec k h g).
Definition NCObrs (b:brs) : Prop :=
  forall k (h:co) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co h -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs b ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs (open_brs_wrt_co_rec k h b).
Definition NCOcs (p:constraint) : Prop :=
  forall k (h:co) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co h -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint p ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint (open_constraint_wrt_co_rec k h p).

Ltac solve_ncoopen :=
  unfold NCOtm, NCOco, NCObrs, NCOcs in *;
  intros; simpl in *;
  intro Hc; simpl in *;
  decomp_dec; notin_dec;
  eauto 10; fsetdec.

Lemma ncoopen_tm : forall a, NCOtm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 NCOcs NCOtm NCObrs NCOco). all: solve [solve_ncoopen]. Qed.
Lemma ncoopen_co : forall g, NCOco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 NCOcs NCOtm NCObrs NCOco). all: solve [solve_ncoopen]. Qed.
Lemma ncoopen_brs : forall b, NCObrs b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 NCOcs NCOtm NCObrs NCOco). all: solve [solve_ncoopen]. Qed.
Lemma ncoopen_cs : forall p, NCOcs p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 NCOcs NCOtm NCObrs NCOco). all: solve [solve_ncoopen]. Qed.

(* keeping old free names: opening with a fresh variable is injective on names *)
Definition NKtm (a:tm) : Prop :=
  forall k x y, y <> x -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a) ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a.
Definition NKco (g:co) : Prop :=
  forall k x y, y <> x -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) g) ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co g.
Definition NKbrs (b:brs) : Prop :=
  forall k x y, y <> x -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b) ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs b.
Definition NKcs (p:constraint) : Prop :=
  forall k x y, y <> x -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) p) ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint p.

Ltac solve_nkeep :=
  unfold NKtm, NKco, NKbrs, NKcs in *;
  intros; simpl in *;
  intro Hc; simpl in *;
  decomp_dec; notin_dec;
  eauto 10; fsetdec.

Lemma nkeep_tm : forall a, NKtm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 NKcs NKtm NKbrs NKco). all: solve [solve_nkeep]. Qed.
Lemma nkeep_co : forall g, NKco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 NKcs NKtm NKbrs NKco). all: solve [solve_nkeep]. Qed.
Lemma nkeep_brs : forall b, NKbrs b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 NKcs NKtm NKbrs NKco). all: solve [solve_nkeep]. Qed.
Lemma nkeep_cs : forall p, NKcs p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 NKcs NKtm NKbrs NKco). all: solve [solve_nkeep]. Qed.

(* co-opening removes no free term names *)
Definition NKCtm (a:tm) : Prop :=
  forall k (h:co) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k h a) ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a.
Definition NKCco (g:co) : Prop :=
  forall k (h:co) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co (open_co_wrt_co_rec k h g) ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co g.
Definition NKCbrs (b:brs) : Prop :=
  forall k (h:co) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs (open_brs_wrt_co_rec k h b) ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs b.
Definition NKCcs (p:constraint) : Prop :=
  forall k (h:co) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint (open_constraint_wrt_co_rec k h p) ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint p.

Ltac solve_nckeep :=
  unfold NKCtm, NKCco, NKCbrs, NKCcs in *;
  intros; simpl in *;
  intro Hc; simpl in *;
  decomp_dec; notin_dec;
  eauto 10; fsetdec.

Lemma nckeep_tm : forall a, NKCtm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 NKCcs NKCtm NKCbrs NKCco). all: solve [solve_nckeep]. Qed.
Lemma nckeep_co : forall g, NKCco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 NKCcs NKCtm NKCbrs NKCco). all: solve [solve_nckeep]. Qed.
Lemma nckeep_brs : forall b, NKCbrs b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 NKCcs NKCtm NKCbrs NKCco). all: solve [solve_nckeep]. Qed.
Lemma nckeep_cs : forall p, NKCcs p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 NKCcs NKCtm NKCbrs NKCco). all: solve [solve_nckeep]. Qed.

(* substitution adds no new free names beyond the body and the substituend *)
Definition NStm (a:tm) : Prop :=
  forall (v:tm) (x:tmvar) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm v -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm v x a).
Definition NSco (g:co) : Prop :=
  forall (v:tm) (x:tmvar) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm v -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co g ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co (tm_subst_tm_co v x g).
Definition NSbrs (b:brs) : Prop :=
  forall (v:tm) (x:tmvar) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm v -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs b ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs (tm_subst_tm_brs v x b).
Definition NSconstraint (p:constraint) : Prop :=
  forall (v:tm) (x:tmvar) y, y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm v -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint p ->
    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint (tm_subst_tm_constraint v x p).

Ltac solve_nsubst :=
  unfold NStm, NSco, NSbrs, NSconstraint in *;
  intros; simpl in *;
  intro Hc; simpl in *;
  repeat match goal with H : (if eq_var ?x ?y then _ else _) |- _ =>
    destruct (eq_var x y); simpl in * end;
  notin_dec;
  eauto 10; fsetdec.

Lemma nsubst_tm : forall a, NStm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 NSconstraint NStm NSbrs NSco). all: solve [solve_nsubst]. Qed.
Lemma nsubst_co : forall g, NSco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 NSconstraint NStm NSbrs NSco). all: solve [solve_nsubst]. Qed.
Lemma nsubst_brs : forall b, NSbrs b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 NSconstraint NStm NSbrs NSco). all: solve [solve_nsubst]. Qed.
Lemma nsubst_cs : forall p, NSconstraint p.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 NSconstraint NStm NSbrs NSco). all: solve [solve_nsubst]. Qed.

(* concrete corollaries used later *)
Lemma nopen_tm_apply : forall a (v:tm) y,
  y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm v -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a ->
  y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm a v).
Proof. intros. apply (nopen_tm a 0 v y); auto. Qed.

Lemma nopen_var : forall a x y,
  y <> x -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a ->
  y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  intros. apply (nopen_tm a 0 (a_Var_f x) y); auto. simpl. intros H; apply H. auto.
Qed.

Lemma ncoopen_tm_apply : forall a h y,
  y `notin` fv_tm_tm_co h -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a ->
  y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_co a h).
Proof. intros. apply (ncoopen_tm a 0 h y); auto. Qed.

Lemma nckeep_var : forall a x y,
  y <> x -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) ->
  y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a.
Proof. intros. eapply (nkeep_tm a 0 x y); eauto. Qed.

Lemma nckeep_co_apply : forall a h y,
  y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_co a h) -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a.
Proof. intros. eapply (nckeep_tm a 0 h y); eauto. Qed.

Lemma nsubst_tm_apply : forall a v x y,
  y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm v -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a ->
  y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm v x a).
Proof. intros. apply (nsubst_tm a v x y); auto. Qed.

Lemma nsubst_cs_apply : forall p v x y,
  y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm v -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint p ->
  y `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint (tm_subst_tm_constraint v x p).
Proof. intros. apply (nsubst_cs p v x y); auto. Qed.

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia Permutation.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev LC RU V VS SO PA VarF RM PSub CS CS2 PC CV CoSub Dia.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic context facts                                          *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Definition CtxSub (G G':context) : Prop :=
  forall x s, binds x s G -> binds x s G'.

Lemma CtxSub_refl : forall G, CtxSub G G.
Proof. intros G x s H; exact H. Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_trans : forall G1 G2 G3,
  CtxSub G1 G2 -> CtxSub G2 G3 -> CtxSub G1 G3.
Proof. intros G1 G2 G3 H12 H23 x s H; auto. Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_cons : forall G G' x s,
  CtxSub G G' -> CtxSub G ((x,s) :: G').
Proof.
  intros G G' x s H y t Hy. unfold binds in *. simpl. right. apply H. exact Hy.
Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_dom : forall G G' c,
  CtxSub G G' -> c `in` dom G -> c `in` dom G'.
Proof.
  intros G G' c Hsub Hin.
  apply dom_binds in Hin. destruct Hin as [s Hs].
  apply dom_binds. exists s. apply Hsub. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_old : forall (x:atom) (s:sort) G (y:atom) (t:sort),
  binds y t G -> binds y t ((x,s) :: G).
Proof. intros. unfold binds in *. simpl. auto. Qed.

Lemma Ctx_uniq : forall G, Ctx G -> uniq G.
Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - apply uniq_nil.
  - apply uniq_push; auto.
  - apply uniq_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_dom_in : forall G (x:atom) s, binds x s G -> x `in` dom G.
Proof. intros. apply dom_binds. exists s. exact H. Qed.

(* handy notin-union facts *)
Lemma notin_union_l : forall (y:atom) (A B:atoms),
  y `notin` (A `union` B) -> y `notin` A.
Proof. intros y A B H Hy. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact Hy. Qed.
Lemma notin_union_r : forall (y:atom) (A B:atoms),
  y `notin` (A `union` B) -> y `notin` B.
Proof. intros y A B H Hy. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact Hy. Qed.
#[local] Hint Resolve notin_union_l notin_union_r : core.

Ltac notin_dec :=
  repeat match goal with
  | H : _ `in` AtomSetImpl.union _ _ |- _ =>
      apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in H; destruct H
  | H : _ `in` AtomSetImpl.singleton _ |- _ =>
      apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in H; subst
  end.

Ltac decomp_one H :=
  match type of H with
  | context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?n ?k] =>

with size_brs (brs:brs) : nat :=

with size_co (g:co) : nat :=

Lemma binds_ctx_nom : forall G x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> binds x Nom (ctx_nom G).

    + apply IH; exact Hb.

Lemma binds_ctx_nom_inv : forall G x, binds x Nom (ctx_nom G) -> exists A, binds x (Tm A) G.
Proof.
  induction G as [| [y s] G IH]; intros x Hb.
  - unfold binds in *. simpl in *. inversion Hb.
  - destruct s; unfold binds in *; simpl in *.
    + destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
      * inversion Heq; subst. exists s; left; reflexivity.
      * destruct (IH x Hb) as [A HA]. exists A; right; exact HA.
    + exact (IH x Hb).
Qed.

  apply dom_binds in Hin. destruct Hin as [s Hs].

Still many, including App. But we tested the pattern with manual unfold (goal only) and it worked when the tactic was applied via use_ih_NO2 to a goal with Ha:NOtm a. In solve_nopen, `unfold NOtm,...` now goal-only, so Ha should remain NOtm a. But the tactic is applied to the induction goal `forall a, NOtm a -> ...`; `unfold NOtm...` unfolds the *goal's* occurrences including in the binder hypothesis type? The goal is a product `forall a, NOtm a -> ...`; `unfold NOtm` unfolds occurrences in the goal type, which includes the hypothesis type `NOtm a` because it's written in the product! So after unfold, the goal becomes `forall a, (forall k v y, ...) -> ...`, and intros introduces Ha with the unfolded forall type—not NOtm a. Damn.

Solution: don't unfold the predicate in the goal before intros; instead intros first, then unfold only the *conclusion* occurrence? The conclusion after intros is `NOtm (a_App ...)`. We can `intro` the hypotheses (which have predicate type), then `unfold NOtm...` to unfold the conclusion only (it won't affect hypothesis types now). But `intros` would also intro the internal foralls of the hypotheses if the goal is a product; `intros` stops when the goal is not a product. After intros a Ha nu b Hb, the goal is `NOtm (a_App a nu b)` (not a product until unfolded). Coq's `intros` introduces until goal is not a product; Ha's type is a product but it's a hypothesis, not the goal. So intros gives Ha:NOtm a, then goal NOtm (a_App...). Then `unfold NOtm` unfolds the goal only. 

So change solve tactics to: `intros; unfold P...; intros; ...`? After `intros`, the remaining goal `NOtm (a_App ...)` unfolds to forall k v y, ...; need intros k v y Hv Hna. So:
```
intros; unfold NOtm, NOco, NObrs, NOcs; intros; simpl in *; intro Hc; ...
```
But `intros` at the start will also intro the binder hypotheses; fine. However, for cases where the goal after intros is e.g. NOco goal, unfolding all four predicates is fine.

Patch all solve tactics: replace `unfold ...; intros; simpl in *;` with `intros; unfold ...; intros; simpl in *;`. Let's do.

(* ================= parallel reduction: confluence infrastructure ================= *)

Lemma Par_confluence : forall W a a1 R,
  Par W a a1 R -> forall a2, Par W a a2 R -> exists b, Par W a1 b R /\ Par W a2 b R.
Proof. exact (Confl.confluence_tmp VP.Value_par). Qed.

Lemma Par_lc_tm1 : forall W a b R, Par W a b R -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros W a b R H. apply lc_at_lc_tm. apply (Par_lc1 _ _ _ _ H). Qed.
Lemma Par_lc_tm2 : forall W a b R, Par W a b R -> lc_tm b.
Proof. intros W a b R H. apply lc_at_lc_tm. apply (Par_lc2 _ _ _ _ H). Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_lc1 : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H.
  - assumption.
  - apply Par_lc_tm1 in H. exact H.
Qed.
Lemma MultiPar_lc2 : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R -> lc_tm b.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_MultiPar : forall W a b R, Par W a b R -> MultiPar W a b R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. apply MP_Step with (b := b).
  - exact H.
  - apply MP_Refl. apply Par_lc_tm2 in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_trans : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R ->
  forall c, MultiPar W b c R -> MultiPar W a c R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H; intros c Hbc.
  - exact Hbc.
  - apply MP_Step with (b := b); [exact H | apply IHMultiPar; exact Hbc].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_mono : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R ->
  forall R', SubRole R R' -> MultiPar W a b R'.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H; intros R' HS.
  - apply MP_Refl; exact H.
  - apply MP_Step with (b := b).
    + apply (Par_mono _ _ _ _ H _ HS).
    + apply IHMultiPar; exact HS.
Qed.

Lemma Par_MultiPar_diamond : forall W a b R, Par W a b R ->
  forall c, MultiPar W a c R -> exists d, MultiPar W b d R /\ MultiPar W c d R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R Hp. induction 1 as [| a0 c0 c R0 Hpar Hmp IH].
  - exists b; split.
    + apply MP_Refl. apply Par_lc_tm2 in Hp. exact Hp.
    + apply Par_MultiPar; exact Hp.
  - destruct (Par_confluence _ _ _ _ Hp _ _ Hpar) as [e [Hbe Hce]].
    destruct (IH e Hce) as [f [Hbf Hcf]].
    exists f; split.
    + apply MultiPar_trans with (b := e); [apply Par_MultiPar; exact Hbe | exact Hbf].
    + exact Hcf.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_confluence : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R ->
  forall c, MultiPar W a c R -> exists d, MultiPar W b d R /\ MultiPar W c d R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H as [| a0 b0 b R0 Hpar Hmp IH]; intros c Hac.
  - exists c; split.
    + apply MP_Refl. apply MultiPar_lc2 in Hac. exact Hac.
    + exact Hac.
  - destruct (Par_MultiPar_diamond _ _ _ _ Hpar _ Hac) as [e [Hbe Hce]].
    destruct (IH e Hce) as [d [Hbd Hed]].
    exists d; split.
    + exact Hbd.
    + apply MultiPar_trans with (b := e); assumption.
Qed.
EOF

Lemma MatchSubst_FixPat_analysis : forall (D D':available_props) p' bb
  (nu:appflag) (a a1 a2:tm),
  AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 D ->
  Rename FixPat FixDef p' bb D D' ->
  MatchSubst (a_App a nu a1) p' bb a2 ->
  exists y z, y <> FixVar2 /\ y `notin` D /\

    bb = tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef /\
    nu = Role Nom /\
    a = a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) z /\
    lc_tm z /\ lc_tm bb /\
    a2 = tm_subst_tm_tm a1 y bb.
Proof.
  intros D D' p' bb nu a a1 a2 HD Hren Hm.
  destruct (Rename_FixPat_def p' bb D D' HD Hren)
    as [y [Hp [Hb [Hyne HyD]]]].
  subst p'.
  inversion Hm; subst; try discriminate.
  inversion H8; subst; try discriminate.
  inversion H2; subst; try discriminate.
  exists y, a2. repeat split; auto.
Qed.


Lemma fixpat_subpattern_cases : forall a,
  tm_subpattern_agree a FixPat ->

Proof.
  intros a Hsub Hnot.
  inversion Hsub; subst; try discriminate.
  - exfalso; exact (Hnot H).
  - inversion H1; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* Base inner *)

      inversion H4; subst; try discriminate.
      right. eexists. split; [reflexivity | exact H2].
    + (* AppIrrel inner *)
      inversion H2; subst; try discriminate.
      inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
      left. reflexivity.
Qed.

Require Import Language.

Fixpoint ctx_nom (G : context) := match G with
  | nil => nil
  | (x, Tm _) :: G' => (x, Nom) :: ctx_nom G'
  | (x, Co _) :: G' => ctx_nom G'
  end.

Definition Good (G : context) (D : available_props):=
  forall c1 A B1 T1 R,
    binds c1 (Co (Eq A B1 T1 R)) G
    -> c1 `in` D
    -> exists C, Par (ctx_nom G) A C R /\ Par (ctx_nom G) B1 C R.

Definition irrelevant G D (a : tm) :=
  (forall x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a) /\ Good G D.

Theorem confluence : forall W a a1 R,
  Par W a a1 R ->
  forall a2, Par W a a2 R -> exists b, Par W a1 b R /\ Par W a2 b R.

Theorem reduction_preservation : forall a a' R, reduction_in_one a a' R -> forall G A D,
      Typing G a A -> Typing G a' A /\ DefEq G D a a' A R.

 | a_CPi (phi:constraint) (B:tm)
 | a_Conv (a:tm) (R:role) (g:co)
 | a_Fam (F:const)
 | a_Bullet : tm

with co : Set :=  (*r explicit coercions *)
 | g_Triv : co
 | g_Var_b (_:nat)

 | g_Refl (a:tm)
 | g_Refl2 (a:tm) (b:tm) (g:co)

  match phi5 with
  | (Eq a b A R) => Eq (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g5 a) (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g5 b) (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g5 A) R
end
with open_co_wrt_co_rec (k:nat) (g_5:co) (g__6:co) {struct g__6}: co :=
  match g__6 with
  | g_Triv => g_Triv
  | (g_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => g_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => g_5
        | inright _ => g_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (g_Var_f c) => g_Var_f c
  | (g_Beta a b) => g_Beta (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g_5 a) (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g_5 b)
  | (g_Refl a) => g_Refl (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g_5 a)

(* ================= term sizes ================= *)

Fixpoint size_constraint (phi:constraint) : nat :=
  match phi with
  | Eq a b A R => S (size_tm a + size_tm b + size_tm A)
  end
with size_tm (a:tm) : nat :=
  match a with
  | a_Star => 1
  | a_Var_b _ => 1
  | a_Var_f _ => 1
  | a_Abs _ A b => S (size_tm A + size_tm b)
  | a_UAbs _ b => S (size_tm b)
  | a_App a _ b => S (size_tm a + size_tm b)
  | a_Pi _ A B => S (size_tm A + size_tm B)
  | a_CAbs phi b => S (size_constraint phi + size_tm b)
  | a_UCAbs b => S (size_tm b)
  | a_CApp a g => S (size_tm a + size_co g)
  | a_CPi phi B => S (size_constraint phi + size_tm B)
  | a_Conv a _ g => S (size_tm a + size_co g)
  | a_Fam _ => 1
  | a_Bullet => 1
  | a_Pattern _ a _ _ b1 b2 => S (size_tm a + size_tm b1 + size_tm b2)
  | a_DataCon _ => 1
  | a_Case a brs => S (size_tm a + size_brs brs)
  | a_Sub _ a => S (size_tm a)
  | a_Coerce => 1
  | a_SrcApp a b => S (size_tm a + size_tm b)
  end
with size_brs (brs:brs) : nat :=
  match brs with
  | br_None => 1
  | br_One _ a brs => S (size_tm a + size_brs brs)
  end
with size_co (g:co) : nat :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => 1

Lemma typing_lc_le : forall n a, size_tm a <= n -> forall G A, Typing G a A -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros a Ha G A Ht.
  - pose proof (size_tm_pos a). lia.
  - assert (Hsmall : forall b, size_tm b < S n -> forall G0 A0, Typing G0 b A0 -> lc_tm b).
    { intros b Hb G0 A0 Ht0. assert (Hb' : size_tm b <= n) by lia.
      exact (IH b Hb' G0 A0 Ht0). }
    assert (Ha' : size_tm a <= S n) by lia.
    exact (typing_lc_fuel (S n) Hsmall G a A Ht Ha').
Qed.

Lemma typing_lc : forall G a A, Typing G a A -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros G a A H. exact (typing_lc_le (size_tm a) a (le_n _) G A H). Qed.

(* Drop one bound-variable level when the opened variable is not free. *)
Definition Dr_tm (a:tm) := forall k j x, lc_tm_at (S k) j a ->
  x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a) -> lc_tm_at k j a.
Definition Dr_co (g:co) := forall k j x, lc_co_at (S k) j g ->
  x `notin` fv_tm_tm_co (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) g) -> lc_co_at k j g.
Definition Dr_brs (b:brs) := forall k j x, lc_brs_at (S k) j b ->
  x `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b) -> lc_brs_at k j b.
Definition Dr_cs (phi:constraint) := forall k j x, lc_cs_at (S k) j phi ->
  x `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) phi) -> lc_cs_at k j phi.

Ltac solve_drop :=
  unfold Dr_tm, Dr_co, Dr_brs, Dr_cs in *; intros; simpl in *;
  repeat match goal with H : _ /\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
  repeat (match goal with H : ?x `notin` (?A \u ?B) |- _ =>
    let HA := fresh "HA" in let HB := fresh "HB" in
    assert (HA : x `notin` A) by fsetdec;
    assert (HB : x `notin` B) by fsetdec; clear H end);
  try (match goal with |- context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?n ?k] =>
    destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?] end);
  try (match goal with H : context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?n ?k] |- _ =>
    destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?] end);
  simpl in *;
  try lia;
  try assumption;
  try reflexivity;
  try exact I;
  try solve [exfalso; fsetdec];
  try solve [repeat split; eauto];
  auto.

Lemma Dr_cs_l : forall phi, Dr_cs phi.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 Dr_cs Dr_tm Dr_brs Dr_co). all: solve [solve_drop]. Qed.
Lemma Dr_tm_l : forall a, Dr_tm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 Dr_cs Dr_tm Dr_brs Dr_co). all: solve [solve_drop]. Qed.
Lemma Dr_brs_l : forall b, Dr_brs b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 Dr_cs Dr_tm Dr_brs Dr_co). all: solve [solve_drop]. Qed.
Lemma Dr_co_l : forall g, Dr_co g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 Dr_cs Dr_tm Dr_brs Dr_co). all: solve [solve_drop]. Qed.

Lemma lc_at_drop1 : forall b x, lc_tm_at 1 0 b ->
  x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)) -> lc_tm_at 0 0 b.
Proof.
  intros b x H Hn.
  apply (Dr_tm_l b 0 0 x).
  - change (lc_tm_at (S 0) 0 b); exact H.
  - change (x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) b)); exact Hn.
Qed.

(* ================= contexts and roleing ================= *)

Lemma binds_ctx_nom : forall G x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> binds x Nom (ctx_nom G).
Proof.
  induction G as [| [y s] G IH]; intros x A Hb.
  - unfold binds in *. simpl in *. inversion Hb.
  - destruct s; unfold binds in *; simpl in *.
    + destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
      * inversion Heq; subst. left; reflexivity.
      * right; apply (IH x A); exact Hb.
    + destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
      * discriminate Heq.
      * apply (IH x A); exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_ctx_nom_inv : forall G x, binds x Nom (ctx_nom G) -> exists A, binds x (Tm A) G.
Proof.
  induction G as [| [y s] G IH]; intros x Hb.
  - unfold binds in *. simpl in *. inversion Hb.
  - destruct s as [t|phi]; unfold binds in *; simpl in *.
    + destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
      * inversion Heq; subst. exists t; left; reflexivity.
      * destruct (IH x Hb) as [A HA]. exists A; right; exact HA.
    + destruct (IH x Hb) as [A HA]. exists A; right; exact HA.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_nom_binds_nom : forall G x s, binds x s (ctx_nom G) -> s = Nom.
Proof.
  induction G as [| [y t] G IH]; intros x s Hb.
  - unfold binds in *. simpl in *. inversion Hb.
  - destruct t; unfold binds in *; simpl in *.
    + destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
      * inversion Heq; subst; reflexivity.
      * apply (IH x s); exact Hb.
    + apply (IH x s); exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_nom_notin_dom : forall G x, x `notin` dom G -> x `notin` dom (ctx_nom G).
Proof.
  intros G x Hn Hin.
  apply (dom_binds role (ctx_nom G) x) in Hin. destruct Hin as [s Hs].
  destruct s.
  - apply binds_ctx_nom_inv in Hs. destruct Hs as [A HA].
    apply Hn. apply (dom_binds sort G x). exists (Tm A); exact HA.
  - exfalso. pose proof (ctx_nom_binds_nom G x Rep Hs). discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma Ctx_uniq' : forall G, Ctx G -> uniq G.
Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - apply uniq_nil.
  - apply uniq_cons; auto.
  - apply uniq_cons; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_nom_uniq : forall G, uniq G -> uniq (ctx_nom G).
Proof.
  intros G H. induction G as [| [y s] G IH].
  - simpl. apply uniq_nil.
  - inversion H; subst.
    destruct s; simpl.
    + apply uniq_cons.
      * apply IH; assumption.
      * apply ctx_nom_notin_dom; assumption.
    + apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typing_roleing_fuel : forall fuel,
  (forall a, size_tm a < fuel -> forall G A, Typing G a A -> forall R, roleing (ctx_nom G) a R) ->
  forall G a A, Typing G a A -> size_tm a <= fuel -> forall R, roleing (ctx_nom G) a R.
Proof.
  intros fuel Hsmall G a A H.
  induction H as
    [ G0 Hctx
    | G0 x A0 Hctx Hb
    | L G0 rho A0 B0 HT HIT HTA HITA
    | L G0 rho a0 A0 B0 HT HIT HTA HITA HRC
    | G0 b a0 B0 A0 HTb HITb HTa HITa
    | G0 b R1 a0 B0 A0 Rs HTb HITb HTa HITa HRP
    | G0 b B0 a0 A0 HTb HITb HTa HITa
    | G0 a0 B0 A0 HT HIT HDEF HTB HITB
    | L G0 phi B0 HT HIT HPW
    | L G0 a0 phi B0 HT HIT HPW
    | G0 a1 B1 a0 b0 A0 Rc HT HIT HDEF
    | G0 F A0 Rs Hctx Hbinds HTA HITA
    | G0 F A0 p a0 R1 Rs Hctx Hbinds HTA HITA
    | G0 a0 F Apps b1 b2 C A0 B0 A1 HTa HITa HTb1 HITb1 HTb2 HITb2 HBT HTF HITF HSAT ];
  intros Hsz R.
  - apply role_a_Star. apply ctx_nom_uniq, Ctx_uniq'. exact Hctx.
  - apply (role_a_Var (ctx_nom G0) x R Nom).
    + apply ctx_nom_uniq, Ctx_uniq'. exact Hctx.
    + apply (binds_ctx_nom G0 x A0). exact Hb.
    + apply NomBot.
  - assert (HrA : roleing (ctx_nom G0) A0 R) by (exact (HITA ltac:(cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia) R)).
    apply (role_a_Pi L (ctx_nom G0) rho A0 B0 R).
    + exact HrA.
    + intros x Hx. apply (HIT x Hx); rewrite size_open_tm; cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia.
  - apply (role_a_Abs L (ctx_nom G0) rho a0 R).
    intros x Hx. apply (HIT x Hx); rewrite size_open_tm; cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia.
  - assert (Hrb : roleing (ctx_nom G0) b R) by (exact (HITb ltac:(cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia) R)).
    assert (Hra : roleing (ctx_nom G0) a0 Nom) by (exact (HITa ltac:(cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia) Nom)).
    apply (role_a_App (ctx_nom G0) b Rel a0 R); assumption.
  - assert (Hrb : roleing (ctx_nom G0) b R) by (exact (HITb ltac:(cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia) R)).
    assert (Hra : roleing (ctx_nom G0) a0 (param R1 R)) by (exact (HITa ltac:(cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia) (param R1 R))).
    apply (role_a_TApp (ctx_nom G0) b R1 a0 R); assumption.
  - assert (Hrb : roleing (ctx_nom G0) b R) by (exact (HITb ltac:(cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia) R)).

    + exact Hrb.
    + apply role_a_Bullet. exact (roleing_uniq _ _ _ Hrb).
  - exact (HIT Hsz R).

Lemma typing_roleing_le : forall n a, size_tm a <= n -> forall G A, Typing G a A -> forall R, roleing (ctx_nom G) a R.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros a Ha G A Ht.
  - pose proof (size_tm_pos a). lia.
  - assert (Hsmall : forall b, size_tm b < S n -> forall G0 A0, Typing G0 b A0 -> forall R, roleing (ctx_nom G0) b R).
    { intros b Hb G0 A0 Ht0 R. assert (Hb' : size_tm b <= n) by lia.
      exact (IH b Hb' G0 A0 Ht0 R). }
    assert (Ha' : size_tm a <= S n) by lia.
    exact (typing_roleing_fuel (S n) Hsmall G a A Ht Ha').
Qed.

Lemma typing_roleing : forall G a A R, Typing G a A -> roleing (ctx_nom G) a R.
Proof. intros G a A R H. exact (typing_roleing_le (size_tm a) a (le_n _) G A H R). Qed.

(* ================= parallel reduction: confluence infrastructure ================= *)

Lemma Par_confluence : forall W a a1 R,
  Par W a a1 R -> forall a2, Par W a a2 R -> exists b, Par W a1 b R /\ Par W a2 b R.
Proof. exact (Confl.confluence_tmp VP.Value_par). Qed.

Lemma Par_lc_tm1 : forall W a b R, Par W a b R -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros W a b R H. apply lc_at_lc_tm. apply (Par_lc1 _ _ _ _ H). Qed.
Lemma Par_lc_tm2 : forall W a b R, Par W a b R -> lc_tm b.
Proof. intros W a b R H. apply lc_at_lc_tm. apply (Par_lc2 _ _ _ _ H). Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_lc1 : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H.
  - assumption.
  - apply Par_lc_tm1 in H. exact H.
Qed.
Lemma MultiPar_lc2 : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R -> lc_tm b.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Par_MultiPar : forall W a b R, Par W a b R -> MultiPar W a b R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. apply MP_Step with (b := b).
  - exact H.
  - apply MP_Refl. apply Par_lc_tm2 in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_trans : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R ->
  forall c, MultiPar W b c R -> MultiPar W a c R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H; intros c Hbc.
  - exact Hbc.
  - apply MP_Step with (b := b); [exact H | apply IHMultiPar; exact Hbc].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_mono : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R ->
  forall R', SubRole R R' -> MultiPar W a b R'.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H; intros R' HS.
  - apply MP_Refl; exact H.
  - apply MP_Step with (b := b).
    + apply (Par_mono _ _ _ _ H _ HS).
    + apply IHMultiPar; exact HS.
Qed.

Lemma Par_MultiPar_diamond : forall W a c R, MultiPar W a c R ->
  forall b, Par W a b R -> exists d, MultiPar W b d R /\ MultiPar W c d R.
Proof.
  intros W a c R Hmp. induction Hmp as [W0 a0 R0 Hlc | W0 a0 a' R0 bmid Hpar Hmp];
    intros b Hp.
  - exists b; split.
    + apply MP_Refl. apply Par_lc_tm2 in Hp. exact Hp.
    + apply Par_MultiPar; exact Hp.
  - destruct (Par_confluence W0 a0 bmid R0 Hpar b Hp) as [e [Hbmide Hbe]].
    destruct (IHHmp e Hbmide) as [d [Hbd Hcd]].
    exists d; split.
    + apply MultiPar_trans with (b := e); [apply Par_MultiPar; exact Hbe | exact Hbd].
    + exact Hcd.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_confluence : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R ->
  forall c, MultiPar W a c R -> exists d, MultiPar W b d R /\ MultiPar W c d R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H1. induction H1 as [W0 a0 R0 Hlc | W0 a0 a' R0 bmid Hpar Hmp];
    intros c H2.
  - exists c; split.
    + exact H2.
    + apply MP_Refl. apply MultiPar_lc2 in H2. exact H2.
  - destruct (Par_MultiPar_diamond W0 a0 c R0 H2 bmid Hpar) as [e [Hbme Hce]].
    destruct (IHHmp e Hbme) as [d [Hbd Hed]].
    exists d; split.
    + exact Hbd.
    + apply MultiPar_trans with (b := e); assumption.
Qed.

Scheme Typing_mut := Induction for Typing Sort Prop
  with PropWff_mut := Induction for PropWff Sort Prop
  with Iso_mut := Induction for Iso Sort Prop
  with DefEq_mut := Induction for DefEq Sort Prop
  with Ctx_mut := Induction for Ctx Sort Prop.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic context facts                                          *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Definition CtxSub (G G':context) : Prop :=
  forall x s, binds x s G -> binds x s G'.

Lemma CtxSub_refl : forall G, CtxSub G G.
Proof. intros G x s H; exact H. Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_trans : forall G1 G2 G3,
  CtxSub G1 G2 -> CtxSub G2 G3 -> CtxSub G1 G3.
Proof. intros G1 G2 G3 H12 H23 x s H; auto. Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_cons : forall G G' x s,
  CtxSub G G' -> CtxSub G ((x,s) :: G').
Proof.
  intros G G' x s H y t Hy. unfold binds in *. simpl. right. apply H. exact Hy.
Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_dom : forall G G' c,
  CtxSub G G' -> c `in` dom G -> c `in` dom G'.
Proof.
  intros G G' c Hsub Hin.
  apply dom_binds in Hin. destruct Hin as [s Hs].
  apply dom_binds. exists s. apply Hsub. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_old : forall (x:atom) (s:sort) G (y:atom) (t:sort),
  binds y t G -> binds y t ((x,s) :: G).
Proof. intros. unfold binds in *. simpl. auto. Qed.

Lemma Ctx_uniq : forall G, Ctx G -> uniq G.
Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - apply uniq_nil.
  - apply uniq_push; auto.
  - apply uniq_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_dom_in : forall (G:context) (x:atom) s, binds x s G -> x `in` dom G.
Proof. intros. apply dom_binds. exists s. exact H. Qed.

Proof. intros y A B H Hy. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact Hy. Qed.

  y `notin` (A `union` B) -> y `notin` B.
Proof. intros y A B H Hy. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact Hy. Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Local closure of typed terms                                 *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Ltac solve_typing_lc :=
  intros;
  cbn [lc_tm_at lc_cs_at lc_co_at];
  try (repeat split);
  try (eauto 15);
  try match goal with
  | IH : forall x, x `notin` ?L -> lc_tm_at 0 0 (open_tm_wrt_tm ?b (a_Var_f x)) |- lc_tm_at 1 0 ?b =>
      destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` fv_tm_tm_tm b)) as [x Hx];
      apply (lc_open_inv_tm b 0 0 x); [fsetdec | apply (IH x); fsetdec]
  | IH : forall c, c `notin` ?L -> lc_tm_at 0 0 (open_tm_wrt_co ?b (g_Var_f c)) |- lc_tm_at 0 1 ?b =>
      destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` fcv_tm_tm_tm b)) as [c Hc];
      apply (lc_co_open_inv_tm b 0 0 c); [fsetdec | apply (IH c); fsetdec]
  end.

Lemma typing_lc : forall G t A, Typing G t A -> lc_tm_at 0 0 t.
Proof.
  apply (Typing_mut
           (fun G t A _ => lc_tm_at 0 0 t)
           (fun G phi _ => lc_cs_at 0 0 phi)
           (fun _ _ _ _ _ => True)
           (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => True)
           (fun _ _ => True)).
  all: try (exact I).
  all: solve_typing_lc.
Qed.

Lemma propwff_lc : forall G phi, PropWff G phi -> lc_cs_at 0 0 phi.
Proof.
  apply (PropWff_mut
           (fun G t A _ => lc_tm_at 0 0 t)
           (fun G phi _ => lc_cs_at 0 0 phi)
           (fun _ _ _ _ _ => True)
           (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => True)
           (fun _ _ => True)).
  all: try (exact I).
  all: solve_typing_lc.
Qed.

Definition min (r1 : role) (r2 : role) : role :=
  match r1 , r2 with
  | Nom, _   => Nom
  | _  , Nom => Nom
  | Rep, Rep => Rep
  end.

Definition param (r1 : role) (r2 : role) := min r1 r2.

Definition app_role (rr : appflag) (r1 : role) : role :=
  match rr with
  | Rho _ => Nom
  | Role r => param r r1
  end.

Fixpoint apply_pattern_args (a : tm) (args : pattern_args) : tm :=
  match args with
  | nil => a
  | (p_Tm nu b :: rest) =>
    apply_pattern_args (a_App a nu b) rest
  | (p_Co g :: rest) =>
    apply_pattern_args (a_CApp a g) rest
  end.

Fixpoint A_snoc (xs : Apps) (x : App)  : Apps :=
  match xs with
  | A_nil => A_cons x A_nil
  | A_cons y ys => (A_cons y (A_snoc ys x))
  end.

Definition Star : atom := proj1_sig (atom_fresh empty).

Inductive subtm_pattern_agree : tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn subtm_pattern_agree *)
 | subtm_pattern_agree_Base : forall (a p:tm),
     tm_pattern_agree a p ->

     subtm_pattern_agree a p ->
     subtm_pattern_agree (a_CApp a g_Triv) p.

(* defns JValuePath *)
Inductive ValuePath : tm -> const -> Prop :=    (* defn ValuePath *)
 | ValuePath_AbsConst : forall (F:const) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     ValuePath (a_Fam F) F

     lc_tm b' ->
     ValuePath a F ->
     ValuePath  ( (a_App a nu b') )  F

     ValuePath a F ->
     ValuePath  ( (a_CApp a g_Triv) )  F.

(* defns JCasePath *)

 | CasePath_AbsConst : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (A:tm) (Rs:roles),
     ValuePath a F ->
      binds  F  ( (Cs A Rs) )   toplevel   ->
     CasePath R a F
 | CasePath_Const : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (p b A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
     ValuePath a F ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p b A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      not (  ( SubRole R1 R )  )  ->
     CasePath R a F
 | CasePath_UnMatch : forall (R:role) (a:tm) (F:const) (p b A:tm) (R1:role) (Rs:roles),
     ValuePath a F ->
      binds  F  ( (Ax p b A R1 Rs) )   toplevel   ->
      not (  ( subtm_pattern_agree a p )  )  ->
     CasePath R a F.

(* defns JApplyArgs *)
Inductive ApplyArgs : tm -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn ApplyArgs *)
 | ApplyArgs_Const : forall (F:const) (b:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     ApplyArgs (a_Fam F) b b

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev.

(* Instantiate free de Bruijn variables of terms and covariables with
   lists of free atoms, at given binder depths.  This is the standard
   "opening with k fresh names" operation, respecting local binders. *)

Fixpoint it_cs (tns:list tmvar) (cns:list covar) (td cd:nat) (phi:constraint) : constraint :=
  match phi with
  | Eq a b A R => Eq (it tns cns td cd a) (it tns cns td cd b) (it tns cns td cd A) R
  end
with it_co (tns:list tmvar) (cns:list covar) (td cd:nat) (g:co) : co :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => g_Triv
  | g_Var_b n => if lt_dec n cd then g_Var_b n
                 else match nth_error cns (n - cd) with Some c => g_Var_f c | None => g_Var_b n end
  | g_Var_f c => g_Var_f c
  | g_Beta a b => g_Beta (it tns cns td cd a) (it tns cns td cd b)
  | g_Refl a => g_Refl (it tns cns td cd a)
  | g_Refl2 a b g' => g_Refl2 (it tns cns td cd a) (it tns cns td cd b) (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_Sym g' => g_Sym (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => g_Trans (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_Sub g' => g_Sub (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_PiCong rho R g1 g2 => g_PiCong rho R (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns (S td) cd g2)
  | g_AbsCong rho R g1 g2 => g_AbsCong rho R (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns (S td) cd g2)
  | g_AppCong g1 rho R g2 => g_AppCong (it_co tns cns td cd g1) rho R (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_PiFst g' => g_PiFst (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_CPiFst g' => g_CPiFst (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_IsoSnd g' => g_IsoSnd (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => g_PiSnd (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => g_CPiCong (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns td (S cd) g3)
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => g_CAbsCong (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns td (S cd) g3) (it_co tns cns td cd g4)
  | g_CAppCong g g1 g2 => g_CAppCong (it_co tns cns td cd g) (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_CPiSnd g g1 g2 => g_CPiSnd (it_co tns cns td cd g) (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_Cast g1 R g2 => g_Cast (it_co tns cns td cd g1) R (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => g_EqCong (it_co tns cns td cd g1) (it tns cns td cd A) (it_co tns cns td cd g2)
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 g' => g_IsoConv (it_cs tns cns td cd phi1) (it_cs tns cns td cd phi2) (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_Eta a => g_Eta (it tns cns td cd a)
  | g_Left g g' => g_Left (it_co tns cns td cd g) (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  | g_Right g g' => g_Right (it_co tns cns td cd g) (it_co tns cns td cd g')
  end
with it_brs (tns:list tmvar) (cns:list covar) (td cd:nat) (b:brs) : brs :=
  match b with
  | br_None => br_None
  | br_One K a brs5 => br_One K (it tns cns td cd a) (it_brs tns cns td cd brs5)
  end
with it (tns:list tmvar) (cns:list covar) (td cd:nat) (a:tm) : tm :=
  match a with
  | a_Star => a_Star
  | a_Var_b n => if lt_dec n td then a_Var_b n
                 else match nth_error tns (n - td) with Some x => a_Var_f x | None => a_Var_b n end
  | a_Var_f x => a_Var_f x
  | a_Abs rho A b => a_Abs rho (it tns cns td cd A) (it tns cns (S td) cd b)
  | a_UAbs rho b => a_UAbs rho (it tns cns (S td) cd b)
  | a_App a nu b => a_App (it tns cns td cd a) nu (it tns cns td cd b)
  | a_Pi rho A B => a_Pi rho (it tns cns td cd A) (it tns cns (S td) cd B)
  | a_CAbs phi b => a_CAbs (it_cs tns cns td cd phi) (it tns cns td (S cd) b)
  | a_UCAbs b => a_UCAbs (it tns cns td (S cd) b)
  | a_CApp a g => a_CApp (it tns cns td cd a) (it_co tns cns td cd g)
  | a_CPi phi B => a_CPi (it_cs tns cns td cd phi) (it tns cns td (S cd) B)
  | a_Conv a R g => a_Conv (it tns cns td cd a) R (it_co tns cns td cd g)
  | a_Fam F => a_Fam F
  | a_Bullet => a_Bullet
  | a_Pattern R a F Apps5 b1 b2 => a_Pattern R (it tns cns td cd a) F Apps5 (it tns cns td cd b1) (it tns cns td cd b2)
  | a_DataCon K => a_DataCon K
  | a_Case a brs5 => a_Case (it tns cns td cd a) (it_brs tns cns td cd brs5)
  | a_Sub R a => a_Sub R (it tns cns td cd a)
  | a_Coerce => a_Coerce
  | a_SrcApp a b => a_SrcApp (it tns cns td cd a) (it tns cns td cd b)
  end.


(* ---------- basic identities ---------- *)
Definition Itn_tm (a:tm) := forall td cd, it nil nil td cd a = a.
Definition Itn_co (g:co) := forall td cd, it_co nil nil td cd g = g.
Definition Itn_brs (b:brs) := forall td cd, it_brs nil nil td cd b = b.
Definition Itn_cs (phi:constraint) := forall td cd, it_cs nil nil td cd phi = phi.
Ltac solve_itn :=
  unfold Itn_tm, Itn_co, Itn_brs, Itn_cs in *; intros; simpl;
  try match goal with
      | |- context [lt_dec ?n ?d] =>
          destruct (lt_dec n d); simpl; try reflexivity
      end;
  try reflexivity;
  repeat match goal with |- context [nth_error nil ?k] => destruct k; simpl end;
  try reflexivity;
  repeat f_equal; eauto.
Lemma it_nil_cs : forall phi, Itn_cs phi.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 Itn_cs Itn_tm Itn_brs Itn_co). all: solve [solve_itn]. Qed.
Lemma it_nil_tm : forall a, Itn_tm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 Itn_cs Itn_tm Itn_brs Itn_co). all: solve [solve_itn]. Qed.
Lemma it_nil_brs : forall b, Itn_brs b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 Itn_cs Itn_tm Itn_brs Itn_co). all: solve [solve_itn]. Qed.
Lemma it_nil_co : forall g, Itn_co g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 Itn_cs Itn_tm Itn_brs Itn_co). all: solve [solve_itn]. Qed.

(* arithmetic identity for the variable case of the opening lemma *)
Lemma it_open_var_tm : forall (n td cd k j:nat) (tns:list tmvar) (cns:list covar) (x:tmvar),

(* ================= lc: typing implies local closure ================= *)

Lemma lc_at_lc_tm : forall a, lc_tm_at 0 0 a -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  intros a H.
  assert (H1 : lc_tm (it nil nil 0 0 a)) by
    (apply (G_tm a 0 0 nil nil); simpl; auto).
  rewrite (it_nil_tm a 0 0) in H1. exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma typing_lc_fuel : forall fuel,
  (forall a, size_tm a < fuel -> forall G A, Typing G a A -> lc_tm a) ->
  forall G a A, Typing G a A -> size_tm a <= fuel -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  intros fuel Hsmall G a A H.
  induction H as
    [ G0 Hctx
    | G0 x A0 Hctx Hb
    | L G0 rho A0 B0 HT HIT HTA HITA
    | L G0 rho a0 A0 B0 HT HIT HTA HITA HRC
    | G0 b a0 B0 A0 HTb HITb HTa HITa
    | G0 b R a0 B0 A0 Rs HTb HITb HTa HITa HRP
    | G0 b B0 a0 A0 HTb HITb HTa HITa
    | G0 a0 B0 A0 HT HIT HDEF HTB HITB
    | L G0 phi B0 HT HIT HPW
    | L G0 a0 phi B0 HT HIT HPW
    | G0 a1 B1 a0 b0 A0 Rc HT HIT HDEF
    | G0 F A0 Rs Hctx Hbinds HTA HITA
    | G0 F A0 p a0 R1 Rs Hctx Hbinds HTA HITA
    | G0 a0 F Apps b1 b2 C A0 B0 A1 HTa HITa HTb1 HITb1 HTb2 HITb2 HBT HTF HITF HSAT ];
  intros Hsz.
  - apply lc_a_Star.
  - apply lc_a_Var_f.
  - (* Pi *) apply lc_at_lc_tm. cbn [lc_tm_at]. split.
    + apply LA_tm. apply HITA. cbn [size_tm] in Hsz. lia.
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tm_tm_tm B0)) as [x Hx].
      assert (HxL : x `notin` L) by fsetdec.
      assert (Hxf : x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm B0) by fsetdec.
      pose proof (lc_open_inv_tm B0) as Hinv. unfold Itm in Hinv.
      apply (Hinv 0 0 x Hxf). apply LA_tm.
      apply (HIT x HxL). rewrite size_open_tm. cbn [size_tm] in Hsz. lia.
  - (* Abs *) apply lc_at_lc_tm. cbn [lc_tm_at].
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tm_tm_tm a0)) as [x Hx].
    assert (HxL : x `notin` L) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hxf : x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a0) by fsetdec.
    pose proof (lc_open_inv_tm a0) as Hinv. unfold Itm in Hinv.
    apply (Hinv 0 0 x Hxf). apply LA_tm.
    apply (HIT x HxL). rewrite size_open_tm. cbn [size_tm] in Hsz. lia.
  - apply lc_a_App.
    + apply HITb. cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia.
    + apply HITa. cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia.
  - apply lc_a_App.
    + apply HITb. cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia.
    + apply HITa. cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia.
  - apply lc_a_App.
    + apply HITb. cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia.
    + apply lc_a_Bullet.
  - apply HIT. exact Hsz.
  - (* CPi *) destruct phi as [pa pb pA pR].
    apply lc_at_lc_tm. cbn [lc_tm_at]. split.
    + apply LA_cs. inversion HPW; subst. apply lc_Eq.
      * eapply Hsmall; [ cbn [size_tm size_constraint] in Hsz; lia | eassumption ].
      * eapply Hsmall; [ cbn [size_tm size_constraint] in Hsz; lia | eassumption ].
      * eapply Hsmall; [ cbn [size_tm size_constraint] in Hsz; lia | eassumption ].
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fcv_tm_tm_tm B0)) as [c Hc].
      assert (HcL : c `notin` L) by fsetdec.
      assert (Hcf : c `notin` fcv_tm_tm_tm B0) by fsetdec.
      pose proof (lc_co_open_inv_tm B0) as Hinv. unfold Jtm in Hinv.
      apply (Hinv 0 0 c Hcf). apply LA_tm.
      apply (HIT c HcL). rewrite size_open_tm_co. cbn [size_tm size_constraint] in Hsz. lia.
  - (* CAbs *) destruct phi as [pa pb pA pR].
    apply lc_at_lc_tm. cbn [lc_tm_at].
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fcv_tm_tm_tm a0)) as [c Hc].
    assert (HcL : c `notin` L) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hcf : c `notin` fcv_tm_tm_tm a0) by fsetdec.
    pose proof (lc_co_open_inv_tm a0) as Hinv. unfold Jtm in Hinv.
    apply (Hinv 0 0 c Hcf). apply LA_tm.
    apply (HIT c HcL). rewrite size_open_tm_co. cbn [size_tm] in Hsz. lia.
  - apply lc_a_CApp.
    + apply HIT. cbn [size_tm] in Hsz; lia.
    + apply lc_g_Triv.
  - apply lc_a_Fam.

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Permutation.
Scheme constraint_mut2 := Induction for constraint Sort Prop
  with tm_mut2 := Induction for tm Sort Prop
  with brs_mut2 := Induction for brs Sort Prop
  with co_mut2 := Induction for co Sort Prop.

(* ============ closing functions (inverses of open) ============ *)
Definition shift_tm_b (k:nat) (n:nat) : tm :=
  match le_lt_dec k n with left _ => a_Var_b (S n) | right _ => a_Var_b n end.
Definition shift_co_b (k:nat) (n:nat) : co :=
  match le_lt_dec k n with left _ => g_Var_b (S n) | right _ => g_Var_b n end.

Fixpoint close_constraint_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (x:tmvar) (phi:constraint) : constraint :=
  match phi with
  | Eq a b A R => Eq (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x b)
                     (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x A) R
  end
with close_co_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (x:tmvar) (g:co) : co :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => g_Triv
  | g_Var_b n => g_Var_b n
  | g_Var_f c => g_Var_f c
  | g_Beta a b => g_Beta (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x b)
  | g_Refl a => g_Refl (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a)
  | g_Refl2 a b g' => g_Refl2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x b) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g')
  | g_Sym g' => g_Sym (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g')
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => g_Trans (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g1) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g2)
  | g_Sub g' => g_Sub (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g')
  | g_PiCong rho R g1 g2 => g_PiCong rho R (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g1) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec (S k) x g2)
  | g_AbsCong rho R g1 g2 => g_AbsCong rho R (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g1) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec (S k) x g2)
  | g_AppCong g1 rho R g2 => g_AppCong (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g1) rho R (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g2)
  | g_PiFst g' => g_PiFst (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g')
  | g_CPiFst g' => g_CPiFst (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g')
  | g_IsoSnd g' => g_IsoSnd (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g')
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => g_PiSnd (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g1) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g2)
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => g_CPiCong (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g1) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g3)
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => g_CAbsCong (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g1) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g3) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g4)
  | g_CAppCong g g1 g2 => g_CAppCong (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g1) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g2)
  | g_CPiSnd g g1 g2 => g_CPiSnd (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g1) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g2)
  | g_Cast g1 R g2 => g_Cast (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g1) R (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g2)
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => g_EqCong (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x A) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g2)
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 g' => g_IsoConv (close_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k x phi1) (close_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k x phi2) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g')
  | g_Eta a => g_Eta (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a)
  | g_Left g g' => g_Left (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g')
  | g_Right g g' => g_Right (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g')
  end
with close_brs_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (x:tmvar) (b:brs) : brs :=
  match b with
  | br_None => br_None
  | br_One K a brs5 => br_One K (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a) (close_brs_wrt_tm_rec k x brs5)
  end
with close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (x:tmvar) (a:tm) : tm :=
  match a with
  | a_Star => a_Star
  | a_Var_b n => shift_tm_b k n
  | a_Var_f y => if eq_var x y then a_Var_b k else a_Var_f y
  | a_Abs rho A b => a_Abs rho (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) x b)
  | a_UAbs rho b => a_UAbs rho (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) x b)
  | a_App a nu b => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a) nu (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x b)
  | a_Pi rho A B => a_Pi rho (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) x B)
  | a_CAbs phi b => a_CAbs (close_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k x phi) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x b)
  | a_UCAbs b => a_UCAbs (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x b)
  | a_CApp a g => a_CApp (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a) (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g)
  | a_CPi phi B => a_CPi (close_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k x phi) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x B)
  | a_Conv a R g => a_Conv (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a) R (close_co_wrt_tm_rec k x g)
  | a_Fam F => a_Fam F
  | a_Bullet => a_Bullet
  | a_Pattern R a F Apps5 b1 b2 => a_Pattern R (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a) F Apps5 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x b2)
  | a_DataCon K => a_DataCon K
  | a_Case a brs5 => a_Case (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a) (close_brs_wrt_tm_rec k x brs5)
  | a_Sub R a => a_Sub R (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a)
  | a_Coerce => a_Coerce
  | a_SrcApp a b => a_SrcApp (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x b)
  end.

Fixpoint close_constraint_wrt_co_rec (k:nat) (c:covar) (phi:constraint) : constraint :=
  match phi with
  | Eq a b A R => Eq (close_tm_wrt_co_rec k c a) (close_tm_wrt_co_rec k c b)
                     (close_tm_wrt_co_rec k c A) R
  end
with close_co_wrt_co_rec (k:nat) (c:covar) (g:co) : co :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => g_Triv
  | g_Var_b n => shift_co_b k n
  | g_Var_f d => if eq_var c d then g_Var_b k else g_Var_f d
  | g_Beta a b => g_Beta (close_tm_wrt_co_rec k c a) (close_tm_wrt_co_rec k c b)
  | g_Refl a => g_Refl (close_tm_wrt_co_rec k c a)
  | g_Refl2 a b g' => g_Refl2 (close_tm_wrt_co_rec k c a) (close_tm_wrt_co_rec k c b) (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g')
  | g_Sym g' => g_Sym (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g')
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => g_Trans (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g1) (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g2)
  | g_Sub g' => g_Sub (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g')
  | g_PiCong rho R g1 g2 => g_PiCong rho R (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g1) (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g2)
  | g_AbsCong rho R g1 g2 => g_AbsCong rho R (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g1) (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g2)
  | g_AppCong g1 rho R g2 => g_AppCong (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g1) rho R (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g2)
  | g_PiFst g' => g_PiFst (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g')
  | g_CPiFst g' => g_CPiFst (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g')
  | g_IsoSnd g' => g_IsoSnd (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g')
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => g_PiSnd (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g1) (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g2)
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => g_CPiCong (close_co_wrt_co_rec k c g1) (close_co_wrt_co_rec (S k) c g3)

Fixpoint lc_cs_at (k j:nat) (phi:constraint) : Prop :=

with lc_co_at (k j:nat) (g:co) : Prop :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => True
  | g_Var_b n => n < j
  | g_Var_f c => True
  | g_Beta a b => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b
  | g_Refl a => lc_tm_at k j a
  | g_Refl2 a b g' => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b /\ lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_Sym g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_Sub g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_PiCong rho R g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at (S k) j g2
  | g_AbsCong rho R g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at (S k) j g2
  | g_AppCong g1 rho R g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_PiFst g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_CPiFst g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_IsoSnd g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k (S j) g3
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k (S j) g3 /\ lc_co_at k j g4
  | g_CAppCong g g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g /\ lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_CPiSnd g g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g /\ lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_Cast g1 R g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_tm_at k j A /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 g' => lc_cs_at k j phi1 /\ lc_cs_at k j phi2 /\ lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_Eta a => lc_tm_at k j a
  | g_Left g g' => lc_co_at k j g /\ lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_Right g g' => lc_co_at k j g /\ lc_co_at k j g'
  end
with lc_brs_at (k j:nat) (b:brs) : Prop :=
  match b with
  | br_None => True
  | br_One K a brs5 => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_brs_at k j brs5
  end
with lc_tm_at (k j:nat) (a:tm) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | a_Star => True
  | a_Var_b n => n < k
  | a_Var_f x => True
  | a_Abs rho A b => lc_tm_at k j A /\ lc_tm_at (S k) j b
  | a_UAbs rho b => lc_tm_at (S k) j b
  | a_App a nu b => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b
  | a_Pi rho A B => lc_tm_at k j A /\ lc_tm_at (S k) j B
  | a_CAbs phi b => lc_cs_at k j phi /\ lc_tm_at k (S j) b
  | a_UCAbs b => lc_tm_at k (S j) b
  | a_CApp a g => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_co_at k j g
  | a_CPi phi B => lc_cs_at k j phi /\ lc_tm_at k (S j) B
  | a_Conv a R g => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_co_at k j g
  | a_Fam F => True
  | a_Bullet => True
  | a_Pattern R a F Apps5 b1 b2 => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b1 /\ lc_tm_at k j b2
  | a_DataCon K => True
  | a_Case a brs5 => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_brs_at k j brs5
  | a_Sub R a => lc_tm_at k j a
  | a_Coerce => True
  | a_SrcApp a b => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b
  end.

Inductive vshape : Type :=
| v_star : vshape
| v_pi (rho:relflag) : vshape
| v_cpi : vshape
| v_uabs (rho:relflag) : vshape
| v_ucabs : vshape
| v_abs (rho:relflag) : vshape
| v_cabs : vshape.

Inductive tshape : Type :=
| t_star : tshape
| t_pi (rho:relflag) : tshape
| t_cpi (R1:role) : tshape.

Inductive VShape : tm -> vshape -> Prop :=
| VShape_star : VShape a_Star v_star
| VShape_pi : forall rho A B, VShape (a_Pi rho A B) (v_pi rho)
| VShape_cpi : forall phi B, VShape (a_CPi phi B) v_cpi
| VShape_uabs : forall rho v, VShape (a_UAbs rho v) (v_uabs rho)
| VShape_ucabs : forall v, VShape (a_UCAbs v) v_ucabs
| VShape_abs : forall rho A b, VShape (a_Abs rho A b) (v_abs rho)
| VShape_cabs : forall phi b, VShape (a_CAbs phi b) v_cabs.

Inductive TShape : tm -> tshape -> Prop :=
| TShape_star : TShape a_Star t_star
| TShape_pi : forall rho A B, TShape (a_Pi rho A B) (t_pi rho)
| TShape_cpi : forall a b A R1 B, TShape (a_CPi (Eq a b A R1) B) (t_cpi R1).

Definition Compat (hV:vshape) (hT:tshape) : Prop :=
  match hT with
  | t_pi rho => hV = v_uabs rho
  | t_cpi _ => hV = v_ucabs
  | t_star => True
  end.

Definition VCompat (R:role) (a:tm) (hT:tshape) : Prop :=
  (exists F, CasePath R a F) \/
  (forall hV, VShape a hV -> Compat hV hT).

Definition TReach (G:context) (A:tm) (h:tshape) : Prop :=
  TShape A h \/ (exists c, MultiPar (ctx_nom G) A c Rep /\ TShape c h).

Lemma Par_TShape : forall W a b R, Par W a b R -> forall h, TShape a h -> TShape b h.
Proof.
  intros W a b R Hpar h Hsh. destruct h.
  - inversion Hsh; subst. inversion Hpar; subst; try discriminate; constructor.
  - inversion Hsh; subst. inversion Hpar; subst; try discriminate; constructor.
  - inversion Hsh; subst. inversion Hpar; subst; try discriminate; constructor.

(* ================= DefEq soundness interface (supplied by DefEqSound.v) ================= *)

Definition JoinLemma : Prop :=
  forall G D a b A R, Good G D -> DefEq G D a b A R ->
    exists c, MultiPar (ctx_nom G) a c R /\ MultiPar (ctx_nom G) b c R.

Lemma Good_weaken_tm_full : forall G x A,
  x `notin` dom G -> Good G (dom G) -> Good ((x ~ Tm A) ++ G) (dom ((x ~ Tm A) ++ G)).
Proof.
  intros G x A Hx HG c1 A1 B1 T1 R Hb Hin.
  unfold binds in Hb. simpl in Hb.
  destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
  - inversion Heq.
  - assert (Hc1 : c1 `in` dom G).
    { apply (dom_binds sort G c1). exists (Co (Eq A1 B1 T1 R)); exact Hb. }
    destruct (HG c1 A1 B1 T1 R Hb Hc1) as [C [P1 P2]].
    exists C; split.
    + change (Par ((x ~ Nom) ++ ctx_nom G) A1 C R).
      apply (Par_weaken (ctx_nom G) A1 C R P1 x Nom).
      apply ctx_nom_notin_dom; exact Hx.
    + change (Par ((x ~ Nom) ++ ctx_nom G) B1 C R).
      apply (Par_weaken (ctx_nom G) B1 C R P2 x Nom).
      apply ctx_nom_notin_dom; exact Hx.
Qed.

Lemma DefEq_TReach : JoinLemma -> forall G D A T h,
  Good G D -> DefEq G D A T a_Star Rep -> TReach G T h -> TReach G A h.
Proof.
  intros J G D A T h HG HD HT. destruct HT as [Hsh | [c [Hmp Hsh]]].
  - destruct (J G D A T a_Star Rep HG HD) as [d [HAd HTd]].
    right. exists d; split; [ exact HAd | ].
    apply (MultiPar_TShape _ _ _ _ HTd h Hsh).
  - destruct (J G D A T a_Star Rep HG HD) as [d [HAd HTd]].
    destruct (MultiPar_confluence (ctx_nom G) T c Rep Hmp d HTd) as [e [Hce Hde]].
    right. exists e; split.
    + apply MultiPar_trans with (b := d); [ exact HAd | exact Hde ].
    + apply (MultiPar_TShape _ _ _ _ Hce h Hsh).
Qed.

  (b <> a_Fam Fix /\ (forall z, b <> a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) z)).

Require Import Language.

Lemma roleing_UAbs_open : forall W (rho:relflag) (a:tm) R,
  roleing W (a_UAbs rho a) R ->
  exists L, forall x, x `notin` L -> roleing ((x ~ Nom) ++ W) (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) R.
Proof. intros W rho a R H. inversion H; subst. eexists; eauto. Qed.

Lemma Par_UAbs_body : forall W (rho:relflag) (a b:tm) R,
  Par W (a_UAbs rho a) b R ->
  exists (a':tm) L, b = a_UAbs rho a' /\
    (forall x, x `notin` L -> Par ((x ~ Nom) ++ W) (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x)) R).
Proof.
  intros W rho a b R H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - match goal with Hr : roleing W (a_UAbs rho a) R |- _ =>
      destruct (roleing_UAbs_open W rho a R Hr) as [L HL];
      eexists a, L; split; [reflexivity|]; intros x Hx; apply Par_Refl; apply (HL x Hx)
    end.
  - eauto.
Qed.

Lemma roleing_UCAbs_open : forall W (a:tm) R,
  roleing W (a_UCAbs a) R ->
  exists L, forall c, c `notin` L -> roleing W (open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f c)) R.

Lemma Par_UCAbs_body : forall W (a b:tm) R,

      destruct (roleing_UCAbs_open W a R Hr) as [L HL];

Lemma subpattern_agree_UAbs_absurd : forall (rho:relflag) (a p:tm),

    intros a rho Eu.
  - subst u. exact (pattern_agree_not_UAbs (a_UAbs rho a) p0 Hpa rho a eq_refl).

Lemma roleing_fam_fix : forall W (R:role), uniq W -> roleing W (a_Fam Fix) R.

Lemma Par_fixdef_inst : forall W (a a':tm), Par W a a' Nom ->
  Par W
    (a_App a (Rho Rel) (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) a))
    (a_App a' (Rho Rel) (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) a')) Nom.
Proof.
  intros W a a' Hp.
  pose proof (Par_roleing _ _ _ _ Hp) as [Hra _].
  pose proof (roleing_uniq _ _ _ Hra) as Hu.
  assert (Hfam : roleing W (a_Fam Fix) Nom) by (apply roleing_fam_fix; auto).
  assert (Hbul : roleing W a_Bullet Nom) by (apply role_a_Bullet; auto).
  assert (Hinner : roleing W (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) Nom)
    by (apply role_a_App; auto).
  eapply Par_App with (nu := Rho Rel) (R := Nom).
  - exact Hp.
  - change (Par W (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) a)
                 (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) a') Nom).
    eapply Par_App with (nu := Rho Rel) (R := Nom).
    + apply Par_Refl; auto.
    + exact Hp.
Qed.

Lemma roleing_fixdef_inst : forall (W:role_context) (y:tmvar),
  uniq W -> y `notin` dom W -> y <> FixVar2 ->
  roleing ((y ~ Nom) ++ W) (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef) Nom.
Proof.
  intros W y Hu Hy Hyne.
  rewrite (subst_fixdef_open y Hyne).
  assert (Huf : uniq ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)) by (apply uniq_cons; auto).
  assert (Hvar : forall R1, roleing ((y ~ Nom) ++ W) (a_Var_f y) R1).
  { intro R1. eapply role_a_Var with (R:=Nom); [exact Huf| |apply NomBot].
    unfold binds. simpl. left. reflexivity. }
  assert (Hfam : roleing ((y ~ Nom) ++ W) (a_Fam Fix) Nom)
    by (apply roleing_fam_fix; auto).
  assert (Hbul : roleing ((y ~ Nom) ++ W) a_Bullet Nom)
    by (apply role_a_Bullet; auto).
  assert (Hin1 : roleing ((y ~ Nom) ++ W)
                   (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) Nom)
    by (apply role_a_App; auto).

       (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Rho Rel) (a_Var_f y)) Nom).
    eapply role_a_App with (R:=Nom).
    + exact Hin1.
    + apply Hvar.

Lemma Par_fixdef_subst : forall (W:role_context) (y:tmvar),
  uniq W -> y `notin` dom W -> y <> FixVar2 ->

      (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef) Nom)

Lemma Par_inner_irrel_axes : forall W (aI b:tm) R,
  Par W (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) aI) b R ->
  exists aI', b = a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) aI'.
Proof.
  intros W aI b R H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - eexists; reflexivity.
  - match goal with Hf : Par W (a_Fam Fix) ?x _ |- _ =>
      exfalso; pose proof (Par_FamFix_inv W x _ Hf) as E; discriminate E end.
  - match goal with Hf : Par W (a_Fam Fix) ?af _ |- exists _,
        a_App ?af (Rho Irrel) ?bf = _ =>
      assert (af = a_Fam Fix) by (eapply Par_FamFix_inv; eauto);
      subst af; eexists; reflexivity end.
  - exfalso.
    match goal with Hb : binds ?F (Ax ?p ?bt ?A ?R1 ?Rs) toplevel |- _ =>
      pose proof Hb as Hbinds;
      apply binds_toplevel_inv in Hb; destruct Hb as [HF Hs]; subst F; inversion Hs; subst end.
    match goal with Hren : Rename FixPat FixDef ?pp ?bbt ?DD ?DDg |- _ =>
      assert (HinD : AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 DD)
        by (unfold FixPat in *; simpl in *; fsetdec);
      destruct (Rename_FixPat_def pp bbt DD DDg HinD Hren)
        as [y0 [Hpp [Hbb [Hyne0 HyD0]]]]; subst pp
    end.
    match goal with Hm : MatchSubst (a_App _ (Rho Irrel) _) _ _ _ |- _ =>
      inversion Hm; subst; try discriminate end.
Qed.

Lemma Par_fixhead_axes : forall W (b:tm) R,
  Par W (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) b R ->
  b = a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet.
Proof.
  intros W b R H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
  - match goal with Hf : Par W (a_Fam Fix) (a_UAbs _ _) _ |- _ =>
      exfalso; pose proof (Par_FamFix_inv W _ _ Hf); discriminate end.
  - match goal with
      Hf : Par W (a_Fam Fix) ?af _,
      Ha : Par W a_Bullet ?bf _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (Par_FamFix_inv W af _ Hf) as E1;
      pose proof (Par_Bullet_inv W bf _ Ha) as E2;
      subst af; subst bf; reflexivity end.
  - exfalso.
    match goal with Hb : binds ?F (Ax ?p ?bt ?A ?R1 ?Rs) toplevel |- _ =>
      pose proof Hb as Hbinds;
      apply binds_toplevel_inv in Hb; destruct Hb as [HF Hs]; subst F; inversion Hs; subst end.
    match goal with Hren : Rename FixPat FixDef ?pp ?bbt ?DD ?DDg |- _ =>
      assert (HinD : AtomSetImpl.In FixVar2 DD)
        by (unfold FixPat in *; simpl in *; fsetdec);
      destruct (Rename_FixPat_def pp bbt DD DDg HinD Hren)
        as [y0 [Hpp [Hbb [Hyne0 HyD0]]]]; subst pp
    end.
    match goal with Hm : MatchSubst (a_App _ (Rho Irrel) _) _ _ _ |- _ =>
      inversion Hm; subst; try discriminate end.
Qed.

Lemma Par_UAbs_inst : forall W (rho:relflag) (a a' b b':tm) R,
  Par W (a_UAbs rho a) (a_UAbs rho a') R ->
  Par W b b' Nom ->
  Par W (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b') R.
Proof.
  intros W rho a a' b b' R Hbody Hb.
  destruct (Par_UAbs_body W rho a (a_UAbs rho a') R Hbody)
    as [aa [L [E HL]]]. inversion E; subst aa.
  assert (Hx : exists x, x `notin` L /\ x `notin` dom W /\
              x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm b /\ x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm b' /\
              x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a /\ x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a').
  { destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom W `union` fv_tm_tm_tm b `union`
       fv_tm_tm_tm b' `union` fv_tm_tm_tm a `union` fv_tm_tm_tm a'))
      as [x Hx].
    exists x. repeat split; fsetdec. }
  destruct Hx as [x [HxL [HxW [Hxb [Hxb' [Hxa Hxa']]]]]].
  pose proof (HL x HxL) as Hpar.
  pose proof (Par_subst ((x ~ Nom) ++ W) (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x))
      (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x)) R Hpar nil W x Nom b b' eq_refl Hb) as Hsub.
  change (Par W (tm_subst_tm_tm b x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) a))
                (tm_subst_tm_tm b' x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) a')) R) in Hsub.
  rewrite (open_subst_tm_id a x b Hxa) in Hsub.
  rewrite (open_subst_tm_id a' x b' Hxa') in Hsub.
  exact Hsub.
Qed.

Lemma Par_UCAbs_inst : forall W (a a':tm) R (h:co),
  Par W (a_UCAbs a) (a_UCAbs a') R -> lc_co h ->
  Par W (open_tm_wrt_co a h) (open_tm_wrt_co a' h) R.
Proof.
  intros W a a' R h Hbody Hh.
  destruct (Par_UCAbs_body W a (a_UCAbs a') R Hbody)
    as [aa [L [E HL]]]. inversion E; subst aa.
  assert (Hx : exists c, c `notin` L /\ c `notin` fcv_tm_tm_tm a /\
              c `notin` fcv_tm_tm_tm a').
  { destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` fcv_tm_tm_tm a `union` fcv_tm_tm_tm a'))
      as [c Hc]. exists c. repeat split; fsetdec. }
  destruct Hx as [c [HcL [Hca Hca']]].
  pose proof (HL c HcL) as Hpar.
  change (Par W (open_tm_wrt_co_rec 0 h a) (open_tm_wrt_co_rec 0 h a') R).
  pose proof (Par_cosubst W (open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f c))
     (open_tm_wrt_co a' (g_Var_f c)) R Hpar c h Hh) as Hsub.
  change (Par W (csubst_tm h c (open_tm_wrt_co_rec 0 (g_Var_f c) a))
                (csubst_tm h c (open_tm_wrt_co_rec 0 (g_Var_f c) a')) R) in Hsub.
  rewrite (open_csubst_tm_id a c h Hca) in Hsub.
  rewrite (open_csubst_tm_id a' c h Hca') in Hsub.
  exact Hsub.
Qed.

Lemma Par_inner_shape : forall W (z b:tm) R,

  intros W z b R H.
