cat >> /workspace/Prog.v <<'EOF'

(* ================= irrelevance on free variables ================= *)

Definition irrel_fv (G:context) (a:tm) : Prop :=
  forall x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a.

Lemma irrel_fv_app_l : forall G b nu arg, irrel_fv G (a_App b nu arg) -> irrel_fv G b.
Proof. intros G b nu arg H x A Hb. apply H in Hb. simpl in Hb. fsetdec. Qed.
Lemma irrel_fv_app_r : forall G b nu arg, irrel_fv G (a_App b nu arg) -> irrel_fv G arg.
Proof. intros G b nu arg H x A Hb. apply H in Hb. simpl in Hb. fsetdec. Qed.
Lemma irrel_fv_capp_l : forall G b g, irrel_fv G (a_CApp b g) -> irrel_fv G b.
Proof. intros G b g H x A Hb. apply H in Hb. simpl in Hb. fsetdec. Qed.
Lemma irrel_fv_uabs : forall G rho b, irrel_fv G (a_UAbs rho b) -> irrel_fv G b.
Proof. intros G rho b H x A Hb. apply H in Hb. simpl in Hb. exact Hb. Qed.

Lemma RolePath_UAbs_absurd : forall (rho:relflag) v Rs, ~ RolePath (a_UAbs rho v) Rs.
Proof. intros rho v Rs H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma CasePath_CApp : forall R a F, CasePath R a F -> CasePath R (a_CApp a g_Triv) F.
Proof.
  intros R a F H. inversion H; subst.
  - eapply CasePath_AbsConst.
    + apply ValuePath_CApp. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
  - eapply CasePath_Const.
    + apply ValuePath_CApp. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
    + eassumption.
  - eapply CasePath_UnMatch.
    + apply ValuePath_CApp. eassumption.
    + eassumption.
    + intro Hs. apply H2. inversion Hs; subst; try discriminate; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma CasePath_App : forall R a F nu arg, CasePath R a F -> lc_tm arg ->
  ~ subtm_pattern_agree (a_App a nu arg) FixPat -> CasePath R (a_App a nu arg) F.
Proof.
  intros R a F nu arg H Hlc Hns. inversion H; subst.
  - eapply CasePath_AbsConst.
    + eapply ValuePath_App; eassumption.
    + eassumption.
  - eapply CasePath_Const.
    + eapply ValuePath_App; eassumption.
    + eassumption.
    + eassumption.
  - eapply CasePath_UnMatch.
    + eapply ValuePath_App; eassumption.
    + eassumption.
    + exact Hns.
Qed.

Lemma VShape_uabs_inv : forall a rho, VShape a (v_uabs rho) ->
  exists v, a = a_UAbs rho v.
Proof. intros a rho H. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.
Lemma VShape_ucabs_inv : forall a, VShape a v_ucabs ->
  exists v, a = a_UCAbs v.
Proof. intros a H. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.
EOF

2	From Stdlib Require Import Lia Permutation.
3	Require Import List.
4	Require Import Dev LC RU V VS SO PA VarF RM PSub CS CS2 PC CV CoSub Dia.
5	
6	Scheme Typing_mut := Induction for Typing Sort Prop
7	  with PropWff_mut := Induction for PropWff Sort Prop
8	  with Iso_mut := Induction for Iso Sort Prop
9	  with DefEq_mut := Induction for DefEq Sort Prop
10	  with Ctx_mut := Induction for Ctx Sort Prop.
11	
12	(* ============================================================ *)
13	(* Basic context facts                                          *)
14	(* ============================================================ *)
15	
16	Definition CtxSub (G G':context) : Prop :=
17	  forall x s, binds x s G -> binds x s G'.
18	
19	Lemma CtxSub_refl : forall G, CtxSub G G.
20	Proof. intros G x s H; exact H. Qed.
21	
22	Lemma CtxSub_trans : forall G1 G2 G3,
23	  CtxSub G1 G2 -> CtxSub G2 G3 -> CtxSub G1 G3.
24	Proof. intros G1 G2 G3 H12 H23 x s H; auto. Qed.
25	
26	Lemma CtxSub_cons : forall G G' x s,
27	  CtxSub G G' -> CtxSub G ((x,s) :: G').
28	Proof.
29	  intros G G' x s H y t Hy. unfold binds in *. simpl. right. apply H. exact Hy.
30	Qed.
31	
32	Lemma CtxSub_dom : forall G G' c,
33	  CtxSub G G' -> c `in` dom G -> c `in` dom G'.
34	Proof.
35	  intros G G' c Hsub Hin.
36	  apply dom_binds in Hin. destruct Hin as [s Hs].
37	  apply dom_binds. exists s. apply Hsub. exact Hs.
38	Qed.
39	
40	Lemma binds_cons_old : forall (x:atom) (s:sort) G (y:atom) (t:sort),
41	  binds y t G -> binds y t ((x,s) :: G).
42	Proof. intros. unfold binds in *. simpl. auto. Qed.
43	
44	Lemma Ctx_uniq : forall G, Ctx G -> uniq G.
45	Proof.
46	  intros G H. induction H.
47	  - apply uniq_nil.
48	  - apply uniq_push; auto.
49	  - apply uniq_push; auto.
50	Qed.
51	
52	Lemma binds_dom_in : forall (G:context) (x:atom) s, binds x s G -> x `in` dom G.
53	Proof. intros. apply dom_binds. exists s. exact H. Qed.
54	
55	Lemma notin_union_l : forall (y:atom) (A B:atoms),
56	  y `notin` (A `union` B) -> y `notin` A.
57	Proof. intros y A B H Hy. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact Hy. Qed.
58	Lemma notin_union_r : forall (y:atom) (A B:atoms),
59	  y `notin` (A `union` B) -> y `notin` B.
60	Proof. intros y A B H Hy. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact Hy. Qed.
61	#[local] Hint Resolve notin_union_l notin_union_r : core.
62	
63	Ltac notin_dec :=
64	  repeat match goal with
65	  | H : _ `in` AtomSetImpl.union _ _ |- _ =>
66	      apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in H; destruct H
67	  | H : _ `in` AtomSetImpl.singleton _ |- _ =>
68	      apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in H; subst
69	  end.
70	
71	Ltac decomp_one H :=
72	  match type of H with
73	  | context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?n ?k] =>
74	      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?]; try discriminate; simpl in *
75	  | context [match ?n with 0 => _ | S _ => _ end] =>
76	      destruct n; simpl in *
77	  | _ => fail
78	  end.
79	
80	Ltac decomp_dec :=
81	  repeat match goal with
82	  | H : _ `in` _ |- _ => decomp_one H
83	  end.
84	
85	Ltac split_notins :=
86	  repeat match goal with
87	  | H : ?y `notin` AtomSetImpl.union ?A ?B |- _ =>
88	      assert (y `notin` A) by (refine (notin_union_l y A B H));
89	      assert (y `notin` B) by (refine (notin_union_r y A B H));
90	      clear H
91	  end.
92

94	  match goal with
95	  | |- ?y `notin` ?S =>
96	      first [ assumption
97	            | (intro Hm; notin_dec; eauto 20; fsetdec)
98	            | fsetdec ]
99	  end.

107	    y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k v a).

Require Import Language.

Scheme constraint_mut2 := Induction for constraint Sort Prop
  with tm_mut2 := Induction for tm Sort Prop
  with brs_mut2 := Induction for brs Sort Prop
  with co_mut2 := Induction for co Sort Prop.

(* ============ closing functions (inverses of open) ============ *)
Definition shift_tm_b (k:nat) (n:nat) : tm :=
  match le_lt_dec k n with left _ => a_Var_b (S n) | right _ => a_Var_b n end.
Definition shift_co_b (k:nat) (n:nat) : co :=
  match le_lt_dec k n with left _ => g_Var_b (S n) | right _ => g_Var_b n end.

Proof. intros G x s H; exact H. Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_trans : forall G1 G2 G3,
  CtxSub G1 G2 -> CtxSub G2 G3 -> CtxSub G1 G3.
Proof. intros G1 G2 G3 H12 H23 x s H; auto. Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_cons : forall G G' x s,
  CtxSub G G' -> CtxSub G ((x,s) :: G').
Proof.
  intros G G' x s H y t Hy. unfold binds in *. simpl. right. apply H. exact Hy.
Qed.

Lemma CtxSub_dom : forall G G' c,
  CtxSub G G' -> c `in` dom G -> c `in` dom G'.
Proof.
  intros G G' c Hsub Hin.
  apply dom_binds in Hin. destruct Hin as [s Hs].
  apply dom_binds. exists s. apply Hsub. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_old : forall (x:atom) (s:sort) G (y:atom) (t:sort),
  binds y t G -> binds y t ((x,s) :: G).
Proof. intros. unfold binds in *. simpl. auto. Qed.

Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - apply uniq_nil.
  - apply uniq_push; auto.
  - apply uniq_push; auto.
Qed.

Proof. intros. apply dom_binds. exists s. exact H. Qed.

Lemma notin_union_l : forall (y:atom) (A B:atoms),
  y `notin` (A `union` B) -> y `notin` A.
Proof. intros y A B H Hy. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact Hy. Qed.
Lemma notin_union_r : forall (y:atom) (A B:atoms),
  y `notin` (A `union` B) -> y `notin` B.
Proof. intros y A B H Hy. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact Hy. Qed.
#[local] Hint Resolve notin_union_l notin_union_r : core.

Ltac notin_dec :=
  repeat match goal with
  | H : _ `in` AtomSetImpl.union _ _ |- _ =>
      apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in H; destruct H
  | H : _ `in` AtomSetImpl.singleton _ |- _ =>
      apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in H; subst
  end.

Ltac decomp_one H :=
  match type of H with
  | context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?n ?k] =>
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?]; try discriminate; simpl in *
  | context [match ?n with 0 => _ | S _ => _ end] =>
      destruct n; simpl in *
  | _ => fail
  end.

Ltac decomp_dec :=
  repeat match goal with
  | H : _ `in` _ |- _ => decomp_one H
  end.

Ltac split_notins :=
  repeat match goal with
  | H : ?y `notin` AtomSetImpl.union ?A ?B |- _ =>
      assert (y `notin` A) by (refine (notin_union_l y A B H));
      assert (y `notin` B) by (refine (notin_union_r y A B H));
      clear H
  end.

Ltac prove_notin_goal :=
  match goal with
  | |- ?y `notin` ?S =>
      first [ assumption
            | (intro Hm; notin_dec; eauto 20; fsetdec)
            | fsetdec ]
  end.

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia Permutation.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev LC RU V VS SO PA VarF RM PSub CS CS2 PC CV CoSub Dia.
Require Import Confl VP.
Require Import Pres.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Definitions copied verbatim from Task.v (no import of Task.v).         *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint ctx_nom (G : context) := match G with
  | nil => nil
  | (x, Tm _) :: G' => (x, Nom) :: ctx_nom G'
  | (x, Co _) :: G' => ctx_nom G'
  end.

Definition Good (G : context) (D : available_props):=
  forall c1 A B1 T1 R,
    binds c1 (Co (Eq A B1 T1 R)) G
    -> c1 `in` D
    -> exists C, Par (ctx_nom G) A C R /\ Par (ctx_nom G) B1 C R.

Definition irrelevant G D (a : tm) :=
  (forall x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a) /\ Good G D.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Basic facts about ctx_nom                                            *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Lemma binds_ctx_nom : forall G x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> binds x Nom (ctx_nom G).
Proof.
  induction G as [| [y s] G IH]; intros x A Hb.
  - unfold binds in *. simpl in *. inversion Hb.
  - destruct s; unfold binds in *; simpl in *.
    + destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
      * inversion Heq; subst. left; reflexivity.
      * right; apply (IH x A); exact Hb.
    + destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
      * discriminate Heq.
      * apply (IH x A); exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_ctx_nom_inv : forall G x, binds x Nom (ctx_nom G) -> exists A, binds x (Tm A) G.
Proof.
  induction G as [| [y s] G IH]; intros x Hb.
  - unfold binds in *. simpl in *. inversion Hb.
  - destruct s as [t|phi]; unfold binds in *; simpl in *.
    + destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
      * inversion Heq; subst. exists t; left; reflexivity.
      * destruct (IH x Hb) as [A HA]. exists A; right; exact HA.
    + destruct (IH x Hb) as [A HA]. exists A; right; exact HA.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_nom_binds_nom : forall G x s, binds x s (ctx_nom G) -> s = Nom.
Proof.
  induction G as [| [y t] G IH]; intros x s Hb.
  - unfold binds in *. simpl in *. inversion Hb.
  - destruct t; unfold binds in *; simpl in *.
    + destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
      * inversion Heq; subst; reflexivity.
      * apply (IH x s); exact Hb.
    + apply (IH x s); exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_nom_notin_dom : forall G x, x `notin` dom G -> x `notin` dom (ctx_nom G).
Proof.
  intros G x Hn Hin.
  apply (dom_binds role (ctx_nom G) x) in Hin. destruct Hin as [s Hs].
  destruct s.
  - apply binds_ctx_nom_inv in Hs. destruct Hs as [A HA].
    apply Hn. apply (dom_binds sort G x). exists (Tm A); exact HA.
  - exfalso. pose proof (ctx_nom_binds_nom G x Rep Hs). discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_nom_uniq : forall G, uniq G -> uniq (ctx_nom G).
Proof.
  intros G H. induction G as [| [y s] G IH].
  - simpl. apply uniq_nil.
  - inversion H; subst.
    destruct s; simpl.
    + apply uniq_cons.
      * apply IH; assumption.
      * apply ctx_nom_notin_dom; assumption.
    + apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_nom_cons_tm : forall x A G,
  ctx_nom ((x ~ Tm A) ++ G) = (x ~ Nom) ++ ctx_nom G.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_nom_cons_co : forall c phi G,
  ctx_nom ((c ~ Co phi) ++ G) = ctx_nom G.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Good is stable under fresh context extension                         *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Lemma Good_cons_tm : forall G D (x:tmvar) A,
  Good G D -> x `notin` dom G -> Good ((x ~ Tm A) ++ G) D.
Proof.
  intros G D x A HG Hx c1 B1 B2 T1 R Hb Hin.
  destruct (HG c1 B1 B2 T1 R) as [C [HC1 HC2]].
  - unfold binds in *. simpl in *.
    destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
    + inversion Heq. subst. unfold binds in Hb. simpl in *. destruct Hb.
    + exact Hb.
  - exact Hin.
  - exists C. split.
    + apply (Par_weaken (ctx_nom G) _ _ R HC1 x Nom).
      apply ctx_nom_notin_dom; exact Hx.
    + apply (Par_weaken (ctx_nom G) _ _ R HC2 x Nom).
      apply ctx_nom_notin_dom; exact Hx.
Qed.

Lemma Good_cons_co : forall G D (c:covar) phi,
  c `notin` D -> Good G D -> Good ((c ~ Co phi) ++ G) D.
Proof.
  intros G D c phi HcD HG c1 B1 B2 T1 R Hb Hin.
  apply (HG c1 B1 B2 T1 R).
  - unfold binds in *. simpl in *.
    destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
    + inversion Heq. subst. exfalso; apply HcD; exact Hin.
    + exact Hb.
  - exact Hin.
Qed.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Joinability (parallel-reduction equivalence)                          *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Definition J (G:context) (a b:tm) (R:role) : Prop :=
  exists c, MultiPar (ctx_nom G) a c R /\
            MultiPar (ctx_nom G) b c R /\
            roleing (ctx_nom G) c R.

Lemma Par_MultiPar : forall W a b R, Par W a b R -> MultiPar W a b R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. apply MP_Step with (b := b).
  - exact H.
  - apply MP_Refl. apply Par_roleing in H. destruct H as [_ Ht].
    apply roleing_lc_tm in Ht. exact Ht.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_roleing_target : forall W a b R,
  roleing W a R -> MultiPar W a b R -> roleing W b R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R Hr H. induction H.
  - exact Hr.
  - apply IHMultiPar. apply Par_roleing in H. exact (proj2 H).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_trans : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R ->
  forall c, MultiPar W b c R -> MultiPar W a c R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H; intros c Hbc.
  - exact Hbc.
  - apply MP_Step with (b := b); [exact H | apply IHMultiPar; exact Hbc].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_mono : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R ->
  forall R', SubRole R R' -> MultiPar W a b R'.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H; intros R' HS.
  - apply MP_Refl; exact H.
  - apply MP_Step with (b := b).
    + apply (Par_mono _ _ _ _ H _ HS).
    + apply IHMultiPar; exact HS.
Qed.

Lemma Par_confluence : forall W a a1 R,
  Par W a a1 R -> forall a2, Par W a a2 R -> exists b, Par W a1 b R /\ Par W a2 b R.
Proof. exact (Confl.confluence_tmp VP.Value_par). Qed.

Lemma Par_MultiPar_diamond : forall W a c R, MultiPar W a c R ->
  forall b, Par W a b R -> exists d, MultiPar W b d R /\ MultiPar W c d R.
Proof.
  intros W a c R Hmp. induction Hmp as [W0 a0 R0 Hlc | W0 a0 a' R0 bmid Hpar Hmp];
    intros b Hp.
  - exists b; split.
    + apply MP_Refl. apply Par_roleing in Hp; destruct Hp as [_ Hr].
      apply roleing_lc_tm in Hr. exact Hr.
    + apply Par_MultiPar; exact Hp.
  - destruct (Par_confluence W0 a0 bmid R0 Hpar b Hp) as [e [Hbmide Hbe]].
    destruct (IHHmp e Hbmide) as [d [Hbd Hcd]].
    exists d; split.
    + apply MultiPar_trans with (b := e); [apply Par_MultiPar; exact Hbe | exact Hbd].
    + exact Hcd.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_confluence : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R ->
  forall c, MultiPar W a c R -> exists d, MultiPar W b d R /\ MultiPar W c d R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H1. induction H1 as [W0 a0 R0 Hlc | W0 a0 a' R0 bmid Hpar Hmp];
    intros c H2.
  - exists c; split.
    + exact H2.
    + apply MP_Refl. apply MultiPar_roleing_target in H2.
      * apply roleing_lc_tm in H2. exact H2.
      * apply roleing_lc_tm. apply lc_a_Var_f.
        (* placeholder: corrected below *)
Abort.

Lemma MultiPar_CApp : forall W a b R, MultiPar W a b R ->
  MultiPar W (a_CApp a g_Triv) (a_CApp b g_Triv) R.
Proof.
  intros W a b R H. induction H as [W0 a0 R0 Hlc | W0 a0 a1 R0 bmid Hpar Hmp].
  - apply MP_Refl. apply lc_a_CApp; [exact Hlc | apply lc_g_Triv].
  - apply MP_Step with (b := a_CApp bmid g_Triv).
    + apply Par_CApp; exact Hpar.
    + exact IH Hmp.
Qed.

  MultiPar W a a' R -> roleing W b (app_role nu R) ->
  MultiPar W (a_App a nu b) (a_App a' nu b) R.

  intros W a a' b nu R H. induction H as [W0 a0 R0 Hlc | W0 a0 a1 R0 bmid Hpar Hmp];

  - apply MP_Refl. apply lc_a_App; [exact Hlc | apply roleing_lc_tm; exact Hrb].

    + apply Par_App; [exact Hpar | apply Par_Refl; exact Hrb].

# 190 — System DR: role-indexed type safety

## Task

Prove confluence of role-indexed parallel reduction, show that a reduction step preserves typing and establishes definitional equality at its reduction role, and prove progress under the stated irrelevance condition.

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `confluence`
- `reduction_preservation`
- `progress`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: Metalib.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.
===
Require Import Language.

Fixpoint ctx_nom (G : context) := match G with
  | nil => nil
  | (x, Tm _) :: G' => (x, Nom) :: ctx_nom G'
  | (x, Co _) :: G' => ctx_nom G'
  end.

Definition Good (G : context) (D : available_props):=
  forall c1 A B1 T1 R,
    binds c1 (Co (Eq A B1 T1 R)) G
    -> c1 `in` D
    -> exists C, Par (ctx_nom G) A C R /\ Par (ctx_nom G) B1 C R.

Definition irrelevant G D (a : tm) :=
  (forall x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a) /\ Good G D.

Theorem confluence : forall W a a1 R,
  Par W a a1 R ->
  forall a2, Par W a a2 R -> exists b, Par W a1 b R /\ Par W a2 b R.

Theorem reduction_preservation : forall a a' R, reduction_in_one a a' R -> forall G A D,
      Typing G a A -> Typing G a' A /\ DefEq G D a a' A R.

Theorem progress : forall G a A R, Typing G a A ->
                          irrelevant G (dom G) a ->
                          Value R a \/ exists a', reduction_in_one a a' R.
===

Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.
(** syntax *)
Definition tmvar := var. (*r variables *)
Definition covar := var. (*r coercion variables *)
Definition datacon := atom.
Definition const := atom.
Inductive relflag : Set :=  (*r relevance flag *)
 | Rel : relflag
 | Irrel : relflag.

Inductive role : Set :=  (*r Role *)
 | Nom : role
 | Rep : role.

Inductive appflag : Set :=  (*r applicative flag *)
 | Role (R:role)
 | Rho (rho:relflag).

Inductive App : Set :=
 | A_Tm (nu:appflag)
 | A_Co : App.

Inductive Apps : Set :=
 | A_nil : Apps
 | A_cons (App5:App) (Apps5:Apps).

Inductive constraint : Set :=  (*r props *)
 | Eq (a:tm) (b:tm) (A:tm) (R:role)
with tm : Set :=  (*r types and kinds *)
 | a_Star : tm
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_Abs (rho:relflag) (A:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_UAbs (rho:relflag) (b:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (nu:appflag) (b:tm)
 | a_Pi (rho:relflag) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_CAbs (phi:constraint) (b:tm)
 | a_UCAbs (b:tm)
 | a_CApp (a:tm) (g:co)
 | a_CPi (phi:constraint) (B:tm)
 | a_Conv (a:tm) (R:role) (g:co)

(* ---- opening vs term substitution ---- *)
Lemma lc_id_open : forall u k y, lc_tm_at 0 0 u -> open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) u = u.
Proof. intros u k y H. apply (lc_open_tm_at u k 0 y). apply (lc_mono_tm u 0 0 k 0 H); lia. Qed.
Definition Ct1 (a:tm) := forall k x y u, lc_tm_at 0 0 u -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm u -> x <> y ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (tm_subst_tm_tm u x a)
  = tm_subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) a).
Definition Cc1 (g:co) := forall k x y u, lc_tm_at 0 0 u -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm u -> x <> y ->
  open_co_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (tm_subst_tm_co u x g)
  = tm_subst_tm_co u x (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) g).
Definition Cb1 (b:brs) := forall k x y u, lc_tm_at 0 0 u -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm u -> x <> y ->
  open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (tm_subst_tm_brs u x b)
  = tm_subst_tm_brs u x (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) b).
Definition Ck1 (phi:constraint) := forall k x y u, lc_tm_at 0 0 u -> y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm u -> x <> y ->
  open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (tm_subst_tm_constraint u x phi)
  = tm_subst_tm_constraint u x (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) phi).
Lemma open_subst_bvar : forall k x y u n, x <> y ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (tm_subst_tm_tm u x (a_Var_b n))
  = tm_subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (a_Var_b n)).
Proof.
  intros. cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec tm_subst_tm_tm].
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[hz1|hz2]|hz3].
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. reflexivity.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. destruct (eq_var y x) as [e|ne]; [exfalso; apply H; symmetry; auto|reflexivity].
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. reflexivity.
Qed.
Ltac solve_comm1 :=
  unfold Ct1, Cc1, Cb1, Ck1 in *; intros;
  match goal with
  | |- open_tm_wrt_tm_rec ?k (a_Var_f ?y) (tm_subst_tm_tm ?u ?x (a_Var_b ?n)) = _ =>
      apply open_subst_bvar; assumption
  | _ =>
      cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec open_co_wrt_tm_rec open_brs_wrt_tm_rec open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec
           tm_subst_tm_tm tm_subst_tm_co tm_subst_tm_brs tm_subst_tm_constraint];
      match goal with
      | |- open_tm_wrt_tm_rec ?k (a_Var_f ?y)
             (if eq_var ?z ?x then ?u else a_Var_f ?z) = _ =>
          destruct (eq_var z x) as [e|n];
          [ apply lc_id_open; assumption | reflexivity ]
      | _ => simpl in *; repeat f_equal; try solve [eauto]
      end
  end.
Lemma open_subst_tm : forall a, Ct1 a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 Ck1 Ct1 Cb1 Cc1). all: solve [solve_comm1]. Qed.
Lemma open_subst_co : forall g, Cc1 g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 Ck1 Ct1 Cb1 Cc1). all: solve [solve_comm1]. Qed.
Lemma open_subst_brs : forall b, Cb1 b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 Ck1 Ct1 Cb1 Cc1). all: solve [solve_comm1]. Qed.
Lemma open_subst_cs : forall phi, Ck1 phi.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 Ck1 Ct1 Cb1 Cc1). all: solve [solve_comm1]. Qed.

Proof. intros h k d H. apply (lc_open_co_co h k k (g_Var_f d)). apply (lc_mono_co h 0 0 k k H); lia. Qed.
Lemma open_csubst_bvar : forall k c d h n, c <> d ->
  open_co_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f d) (csubst_co h c (g_Var_b n))
=====
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 Ecs Etm Ebrs Eco). all: solve [solve_comm5]. Qed.
Lemma csubst_open_cs : forall phi, Ecs phi.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 Ecs Etm Ebrs Eco). all: solve [solve_comm5]. Qed.

(* ---- open/subst identity: substituting into an opened term ---- *)
Lemma open_subst_bvar_id : forall k (x:tmvar) (u:tm) n,
  tm_subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_b n)) = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u (a_Var_b n).
Proof.
  intros. cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec]. destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h1|h2]|h3]; cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (eq_var x x) as [e|ne]; [reflexivity | exfalso; apply ne; reflexivity].
  - reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma open_subst_varf_id : forall k (x y:tmvar) (u:tm), x <> y ->
  tm_subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f y)) = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u (a_Var_f y).
Proof. intros. cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec tm_subst_tm_tm]. destruct (eq_var y x) as [e|ne]; [exfalso; apply H; auto|reflexivity]. Qed.
Definition Utm (a:tm) := forall (k:nat) (x:tmvar) (u:tm), x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a ->
  tm_subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) a) = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u a.
Definition Uco (g:co) := forall (k:nat) (x:tmvar) (u:tm), x `notin` fv_tm_tm_co g ->
  tm_subst_tm_co u x (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) g) = open_co_wrt_tm_rec k u g.
Definition Ubrs (b:brs) := forall (k:nat) (x:tmvar) (u:tm), x `notin` fv_tm_tm_brs b ->
  tm_subst_tm_brs u x (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b) = open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k u b.
Definition Ucs (phi:constraint) := forall (k:nat) (x:tmvar) (u:tm), x `notin` fv_tm_tm_constraint phi ->
  tm_subst_tm_constraint u x (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) phi) = open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k u phi.
Ltac solve_openid :=
  unfold Utm, Uco, Ubrs, Ucs in *; intros;
  first [ apply open_subst_bvar_id
        | match goal with
          | |- tm_subst_tm_tm ?u ?x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec ?k (a_Var_f ?x) (a_Var_f ?y)) = _ =>
              apply open_subst_varf_id; simpl in *; fsetdec
          end
        | simpl in *; repeat f_equal; eauto ].
Lemma open_subst_id_tm : forall a, Utm a.
Proof. apply (tm_mut2 Ucs Utm Ubrs Uco). all: solve [solve_openid]. Qed.
Lemma open_subst_id_co : forall g, Uco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 Ucs Utm Ubrs Uco). all: solve [solve_openid]. Qed.
Lemma open_subst_id_brs : forall b, Ubrs b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 Ucs Utm Ubrs Uco). all: solve [solve_openid]. Qed.
Lemma open_subst_id_cs : forall phi, Ucs phi.
Proof. apply (constraint_mut2 Ucs Utm Ubrs Uco). all: solve [solve_openid]. Qed.
Lemma open_subst_tm_id : forall a (x:tmvar) (u:tm), x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a ->
  tm_subst_tm_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f x) a) = open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 u a.
Proof. intros a x u H. apply (open_subst_id_tm a 0 x u H). Qed.
Lemma open_csubst_bvar_id : forall k (c:covar) (h:co) n,
  csubst_co h c (open_co_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f c) (g_Var_b n)) = open_co_wrt_co_rec k h (g_Var_b n).
Proof.

  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (eq_var c c) as [e|ne]; [reflexivity | exfalso; apply ne; reflexivity].
  - reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma open_csubst_varf_id : forall k (c d:covar) (h:co), c <> d ->
  csubst_co h c (open_co_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f c) (g_Var_f d)) = open_co_wrt_co_rec k h (g_Var_f d).
Proof. intros. cbn [open_co_wrt_co_rec csubst_co]. destruct (eq_var c d) as [e|ne]; [exfalso; apply H; auto|reflexivity]. Qed.
Definition Vtm (a:tm) := forall (k:nat) (c:covar) (h:co), c `notin` fcv_tm_tm_tm a ->
  csubst_tm h c (open_tm_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f c) a) = open_tm_wrt_co_rec k h a.

  csubst_co h c (open_co_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f c) g) = open_co_wrt_co_rec k h g.
Definition Vbrs (b:brs) := forall (k:nat) (c:covar) (h:co), c `notin` fcv_tm_tm_brs b ->
  csubst_brs h c (open_brs_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f c) b) = open_brs_wrt_co_rec k h b.
Definition Vcs (phi:constraint) := forall (k:nat) (c:covar) (h:co), c `notin` fcv_tm_tm_constraint phi ->
  csubst_constraint h c (open_constraint_wrt_co_rec k (g_Var_f c) phi) = open_constraint_wrt_co_rec k h phi.

  unfold Vtm, Vco, Vbrs, Vcs in *; intros;
  first [ apply open_csubst_bvar_id

Proof. apply (tm_mut2 Vcs Vtm Vbrs Vco). all: solve [solve_covid]. Qed.
Lemma open_csubst_id_co : forall g, Vco g.
Proof. apply (co_mut2 Vcs Vtm Vbrs Vco). all: solve [solve_covid]. Qed.
Lemma open_csubst_id_brs : forall b, Vbrs b.
Proof. apply (brs_mut2 Vcs Vtm Vbrs Vco). all: solve [solve_covid]. Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_subst : forall (a u:tm) (x:tmvar),
  lc_tm a -> lc_tm u -> lc_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm u x a).
Proof.
  intros a u x Ha Hu.
  pose proof (G_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm u x a) 0 0 nil nil eq_refl eq_refl) as HG.
  assert (Hla : lc_tm_at 0 0 (tm_subst_tm_tm u x a)).
  { apply (SU_tm a 0 0 u x).
    - apply LA_tm; auto.
    - apply LA_tm; auto. }
  apply HG in Hla. rewrite (it_nil_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm u x a) 0 0) in Hla. exact Hla.
Qed.
Lemma lc_co_subst : forall (g:co) (u:tm) (x:tmvar),
  lc_co g -> lc_tm u -> lc_co (tm_subst_tm_co u x g).
Proof.
  intros g u x Hg Hu.
  pose proof (G_co (tm_subst_tm_co u x g) 0 0 nil nil eq_refl eq_refl) as HG.

Lemma lc_fixdef_renamed : forall (y:tmvar), y <> FixVar2 ->
  lc_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef).

Lemma fixdef_rename_indep : forall (y0 y1:tmvar) (a:tm), y0 <> FixVar2 -> y1 <> FixVar2 ->
  tm_subst_tm_tm a y0 (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y0) FixVar2 FixDef)
  = tm_subst_tm_tm a y1 (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y1) FixVar2 FixDef).
Proof.
  intros y0 y1 a H0 H1.
  rewrite (subst_fixdef_open y0 H0). rewrite (subst_fixdef_open y1 H1). simpl.
  repeat rewrite (eq_dec_refl y0). repeat rewrite (eq_dec_refl y1). simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Rename_FixPat_exists : forall (D:available_props),
  exists y p' b' D', y `notin` D /\ y <> FixVar2 /\
    p' = a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Role Nom) (a_Var_f y) /\
    b' = tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef /\
    Rename FixPat FixDef p' b' D D'.
Proof.
  intros D. destruct (atom_fresh (D `union` {{FixVar2}})) as [y Hy].
  assert (HyD : y `notin` D) by fsetdec.
  assert (Hyne : y <> FixVar2) by fsetdec.
  assert (Hlc : lc_tm FixDef) by (unfold FixDef; repeat constructor).
  exists y, (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) (Rho Irrel) a_Bullet) (Role Nom) (a_Var_f y)),
         (tm_subst_tm_tm (a_Var_f y) FixVar2 FixDef), (singleton y `union` empty).

  - intro Hc; apply HyD. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc. destruct Hc as [Hc|Hc]; auto; fsetdec.

(* ================= lc: typing implies local closure ================= *)

Lemma lc_at_lc_tm : forall a, lc_tm_at 0 0 a -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  intros a H.
  assert (H1 : lc_tm (it nil nil 0 0 a)) by
    (apply (G_tm a 0 0 nil nil); simpl; auto).
  rewrite (it_nil_tm a 0 0) in H1. exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma typing_lc_fuel : forall fuel,
  (forall a, size_tm a < fuel -> forall G A, Typing G a A -> lc_tm a) ->
    + eauto.
    + intro Hs. apply H1.
      apply (subtm_pattern_agree_subst_inv a F H p u x Hu Hs).
Unshelve. all: eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Value_subst : forall R (a:tm), Value R a ->
  forall (u:tm) (x:tmvar), lc_tm u -> Value R (tm_subst_tm_tm u x a).
Proof.
  intros R a H. induction H; intros u x Hu.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. apply Value_Star.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. apply Value_Pi.
    + apply lc_tm_subst; auto.
    + change (lc_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm u x (a_Pi rho A B))). apply lc_tm_subst; auto.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. apply Value_CPi.
    + apply lc_constraint_subst; auto.
    + change (lc_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm u x (a_CPi phi B))). apply lc_tm_subst; auto.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. apply Value_AbsRel.
    + apply lc_tm_subst; auto.
    + change (lc_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm u x (a_Abs Rel A a))). apply lc_tm_subst; auto.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. apply Value_UAbsRel.
    change (lc_tm (tm_subst_tm_tm u x (a_UAbs Rel a))). apply lc_tm_subst; auto.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. apply Value_UAbsIrrel with (L := L `union` fv_tm_tm_tm u `union` {{x}}).
    intros y Hy.
    assert (HyL : y `notin` L) by fsetdec.
    assert (Hyu : y `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm u) by fsetdec.
    + apply lc_tm_subst; auto.
    + apply IHAppsPath; auto.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. apply AppsPath_CApp. apply IHAppsPath; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ValuePath_subst : forall (a:tm) F,
  ValuePath a F -> forall (u:tm) (x:tmvar), lc_tm u -> ValuePath (tm_subst_tm_tm u x a) F.
Proof.
  intros a F H. induction H; intros u x0 Hu.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. eapply ValuePath_AbsConst; eauto.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. eapply ValuePath_Const; eauto.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. apply ValuePath_App.
    + apply lc_tm_subst; auto.
    + apply IHValuePath; auto.
  - cbn [tm_subst_tm_tm]. apply ValuePath_CApp. apply IHValuePath; auto.
Qed.

Fixpoint lc_cs_at (k j:nat) (phi:constraint) : Prop :=
  match phi with
  | Eq a b A R => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b /\ lc_tm_at k j A
  end
with lc_co_at (k j:nat) (g:co) : Prop :=
  match g with
  | g_Triv => True
  | g_Var_b n => n < j
  | g_Var_f c => True
  | g_Beta a b => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b
  | g_Refl a => lc_tm_at k j a
  | g_Refl2 a b g' => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b /\ lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_Sym g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_Trans g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_Sub g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_PiCong rho R g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at (S k) j g2
  | g_AbsCong rho R g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at (S k) j g2
  | g_AppCong g1 rho R g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_PiFst g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_CPiFst g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_IsoSnd g' => lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_PiSnd g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_CPiCong g1 g3 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k (S j) g3
  | g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k (S j) g3 /\ lc_co_at k j g4
  | g_CAppCong g g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g /\ lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_CPiSnd g g1 g2 => lc_co_at k j g /\ lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_Cast g1 R g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_EqCong g1 A g2 => lc_co_at k j g1 /\ lc_tm_at k j A /\ lc_co_at k j g2
  | g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 g' => lc_cs_at k j phi1 /\ lc_cs_at k j phi2 /\ lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_Eta a => lc_tm_at k j a
  | g_Left g g' => lc_co_at k j g /\ lc_co_at k j g'
  | g_Right g g' => lc_co_at k j g /\ lc_co_at k j g'
  end
with lc_brs_at (k j:nat) (b:brs) : Prop :=
  match b with
  | br_None => True
  | br_One K a brs5 => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_brs_at k j brs5
  end
with lc_tm_at (k j:nat) (a:tm) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | a_Star => True
  | a_Var_b n => n < k
  | a_Var_f x => True
  | a_Abs rho A b => lc_tm_at k j A /\ lc_tm_at (S k) j b
  | a_UAbs rho b => lc_tm_at (S k) j b
  | a_App a nu b => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b
  | a_Pi rho A B => lc_tm_at k j A /\ lc_tm_at (S k) j B
  | a_CAbs phi b => lc_cs_at k j phi /\ lc_tm_at k (S j) b
  | a_UCAbs b => lc_tm_at k (S j) b
  | a_CApp a g => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_co_at k j g
  | a_CPi phi B => lc_cs_at k j phi /\ lc_tm_at k (S j) B
  | a_Conv a R g => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_co_at k j g
  | a_Fam F => True
  | a_Bullet => True
  | a_Pattern R a F Apps5 b1 b2 => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b1 /\ lc_tm_at k j b2
  | a_DataCon K => True
  | a_Case a brs5 => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_brs_at k j brs5
  | a_Sub R a => lc_tm_at k j a
  | a_Coerce => True
  | a_SrcApp a b => lc_tm_at k j a /\ lc_tm_at k j b
  end.

Lemma J_app : forall G a1 b1 a2 b2 nu R,
  J G a1 b1 R -> J G a2 b2 (app_role nu R) ->
  roleing (ctx_nom G) a2 (app_role nu R) ->
  roleing (ctx_nom G) b2 (app_role nu R) ->
  J G (a_App a1 nu a2) (a_App b1 nu b2) R.
Proof.
  intros G a1 b1 a2 b2 nu R [c1 [M1a [M1b Hrc1]]] [c2 [M2a [M2b Hrc2]]] Hra2 Hrb2.
  exists (a_App c1 nu c2). split; [|split].
  - apply MultiPar_trans with (b := a_App c1 nu a2).
    + apply MultiPar_App_l; [exact M1a | exact Hra2].
    + apply MultiPar_App_r; [exact Hrc1 | exact M2a].
  - apply MultiPar_trans with (b := a_App c1 nu b2).
    + apply MultiPar_App_l; [exact M1b | exact Hrb2].
    + apply MultiPar_App_r; [exact Hrc1 | exact M2b].
  - destruct nu as [rho|R0]; simpl in *.
    + apply role_a_App; assumption.
    + apply role_a_TApp; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma J_capp : forall G a1 b1 R,
  J G a1 b1 R -> J G (a_CApp a1 g_Triv) (a_CApp b1 g_Triv) R.
Proof.
  intros G a1 b1 R [c [M1 [M2 Hr]]].
  exists (a_CApp c g_Triv). split; [|split].
  - apply MultiPar_CApp; exact M1.
  - apply MultiPar_CApp; exact M2.
  - apply role_a_CApp; exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma J_abs : forall G (A1:tm) rho (B1 B2:tm) R (L:atoms),
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> J ((x ~ Tm A1) ++ G) (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)) R) ->
  roleing (ctx_nom G) (a_UAbs rho B1) R ->
  roleing (ctx_nom G) (a_UAbs rho B2) R ->
  J G (a_UAbs rho B1) (a_UAbs rho B2) R.
Proof.
  intros G A1 rho B1 B2 R L Hfam Hr1 Hr2.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom (ctx_nom G) `union`
      fv_tm_tm_tm B1 `union` fv_tm_tm_tm B2)) as [x0 Hx0].
  assert (HxL : x0 `notin` L) by fsetdec.
  assert (HxW : x0 `notin` dom (ctx_nom G)) by fsetdec.
  assert (HxB1 : x0 `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm B1) by fsetdec.
  assert (HxB2 : x0 `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm B2) by fsetdec.
  destruct (Hfam x0 HxL) as [cb [Mc1 [Mc2 Hrc]]].
  exists (a_UAbs rho (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x0 cb)). split; [|split].
  - unfold open_tm_wrt_tm in Mc1.
    rewrite <- (close_open_tm_A B1 0 x0 HxB1).
    apply (MultiPar_Abs_close_body (ctx_nom G) rho x0 _ _ R HxW Mc1).
  - unfold open_tm_wrt_tm in Mc2.
    rewrite <- (close_open_tm_A B2 0 x0 HxB2).
    apply (MultiPar_Abs_close_body (ctx_nom G) rho x0 _ _ R HxW Mc2).
  - unfold open_tm_wrt_tm in Mc1.
    rewrite <- (close_open_tm_A B1 0 x0 HxB1) in Mc1.
    apply (MultiPar_roleing_target _ _ _ _ Hr1).
    exact (MultiPar_Abs_close_body (ctx_nom G) rho x0 _ _ R HxW Mc1).
Qed.

Lemma J_pi : forall G rho (A1 A2 B1 B2:tm) R (L:atoms),
  J G A1 A2 R ->
  (forall x, x `notin` L -> J ((x ~ Tm A1) ++ G) (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)) R) ->
  roleing (ctx_nom G) (a_Pi rho A1 B1) R ->

  - apply MultiPar_trans with (b := a_Pi rho CA B2).
    + apply (MultiPar_Pi_A_lift (ctx_nom G) rho A2 CA B2 R MA2 Hr2).
    + unfold open_tm_wrt_tm in Mc2.
      rewrite <- (close_open_tm_A B2 0 x0 HxB2).

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* The mutual soundness induction                                       *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Lemma roleing_weaken_nil : forall a R, roleing nil a R ->
  forall W, uniq W -> roleing W a R.
Proof.
  intros a R H W Hu. induction W as [|[x s] W IH].
  - exact H.
  - inversion Hu; subst.
    apply roleing_weaken. apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Definition P_ty (G:context) (a A:tm) (H:Typing G a A) :=
  (forall R, roleing (ctx_nom G) a R) /\ roleing (ctx_nom G) A Rep.

Definition P_pw (G:context) (phi:constraint) (H:PropWff G phi) :=
  match phi with
  | Eq a b A R => (forall R', roleing (ctx_nom G) a R') /\
                  (forall R', roleing (ctx_nom G) b R') /\
                  roleing (ctx_nom G) A Rep
  end.

Definition P_iso (G:context) (D:available_props) (phi1 phi2:constraint)
    (H:Iso G D phi1 phi2) :=
  Good G D ->
  match phi1, phi2 with
  | Eq a1 b1 A1 R1, Eq a2 b2 A2 R2 =>
      roleing (ctx_nom G) a1 R1 /\ roleing (ctx_nom G) b1 R1 /\
      roleing (ctx_nom G) A1 Rep /\
      roleing (ctx_nom G) a2 R2 /\ roleing (ctx_nom G) b2 R2 /\
      roleing (ctx_nom G) A2 Rep /\
      R1 = R2 /\
      J G a1 a2 R1 /\ J G b1 b2 R1 /\ J G A1 A2 Rep
  end.

Definition P_de (G:context) (D:available_props) (a b A:tm) (R:role)
    (H:DefEq G D a b A R) :=
  Good G D ->
  roleing (ctx_nom G) a R /\ roleing (ctx_nom G) b R /\
  roleing (ctx_nom G) A Rep /\ J G a b R.

Definition P_ctx (G:context) (H:Ctx G) :=
  (forall x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> roleing (ctx_nom G) A Rep) /\
  (forall c a b A R, binds c (Co (Eq a b A R)) G ->
     roleing (ctx_nom G) a R /\ roleing (ctx_nom G) b R /\ roleing (ctx_nom G) A Rep).
EOF

Require Import Language.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia Permutation.
Require Import List.
Require Import Dev LC RU V VS SO PA VarF RM PSub CS CS2 PC CV CoSub Dia.
Require Import Confl VP.
Require Import Pres.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Definitions copied verbatim from Task.v (no import of Task.v).         *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint ctx_nom (G : context) := match G with
  | nil => nil
  | (x, Tm _) :: G' => (x, Nom) :: ctx_nom G'
  | (x, Co _) :: G' => ctx_nom G'
  end.

Definition Good (G : context) (D : available_props):=
  forall c1 A B1 T1 R,
    binds c1 (Co (Eq A B1 T1 R)) G
    -> c1 `in` D
    -> exists C, Par (ctx_nom G) A C R /\ Par (ctx_nom G) B1 C R.

Definition irrelevant G D (a : tm) :=
  (forall x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm a) /\ Good G D.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Basic facts about ctx_nom                                            *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Lemma binds_ctx_nom : forall G x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> binds x Nom (ctx_nom G).
Proof.
  induction G as [| [y s] G IH]; intros x A Hb.
  - unfold binds in *. simpl in *. inversion Hb.
  - destruct s; unfold binds in *; simpl in *.
    destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
    + inversion Heq.
    + exact Hb. }
  destruct (HG c1 B1 B2 T1 R Hb' Hin) as [C [HC1 HC2]].
  exists C. split.
  - apply (Par_weaken (ctx_nom G) _ _ R HC1 x Nom).
    apply ctx_nom_notin_dom; exact Hx.
  - apply (Par_weaken (ctx_nom G) _ _ R HC2 x Nom).
    apply ctx_nom_notin_dom; exact Hx.
Qed.

Lemma Good_cons_co : forall G D (c:covar) phi,
  c `notin` D -> Good G D -> Good ((c ~ Co phi) ++ G) D.
Proof.
  intros G D c phi HcD HG c1 B1 B2 T1 R Hb Hin.
  assert (Hb' : binds c1 (Co (Eq B1 B2 T1 R)) G).
  { unfold binds in *. simpl in *.
    destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
    + inversion Heq. subst. exfalso; apply HcD; exact Hin.
    + exact Hb. }
  exact (HG c1 B1 B2 T1 R Hb' Hin).
Qed.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* Joinability (parallel-reduction equivalence)                          *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Definition J (G:context) (a b:tm) (R:role) : Prop :=
  exists c, MultiPar (ctx_nom G) a c R /\
            MultiPar (ctx_nom G) b c R /\

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* The mutual soundness induction                                       *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

Lemma roleing_weaken_nil : forall a R, roleing nil a R ->
  forall W, uniq W -> roleing W a R.
Proof.
  intros a R H W Hu. revert Hu. induction W as [|[x s] W IH]; intros Hu.
  - exact H.
  - inversion Hu; subst.
    match goal with Hx : _ `notin` dom W, Hu' : uniq W |- _ =>
      apply (roleing_weaken W a R (IH Hu') x s Hx) end.
Qed.

Definition P_ty (G:context) (a A:tm) (H:Typing G a A) :=
  (forall R, roleing (ctx_nom G) a R) /\ roleing (ctx_nom G) A Rep.

Definition P_pw (G:context) (phi:constraint) (H:PropWff G phi) :=
  match phi with
  | Eq a b A R => (forall R', roleing (ctx_nom G) a R') /\
                  (forall R', roleing (ctx_nom G) b R') /\
                  roleing (ctx_nom G) A Rep
  end.

Definition P_iso (G:context) (D:available_props) (phi1 phi2:constraint)
    (H:Iso G D phi1 phi2) :=
  Good G D ->
  match phi1, phi2 with
  | Eq a1 b1 A1 R1, Eq a2 b2 A2 R2 =>
      roleing (ctx_nom G) a1 R1 /\ roleing (ctx_nom G) b1 R1 /\
      roleing (ctx_nom G) A1 Rep /\
      roleing (ctx_nom G) a2 R2 /\ roleing (ctx_nom G) b2 R2 /\
      roleing (ctx_nom G) A2 Rep /\
      R1 = R2 /\
      J G a1 a2 R1 /\ J G b1 b2 R1 /\ J G A1 A2 Rep
  end.

Definition P_de (G:context) (D:available_props) (a b A:tm) (R:role)
    (H:DefEq G D a b A R) :=
  Good G D ->
  roleing (ctx_nom G) a R /\ roleing (ctx_nom G) b R /\
  roleing (ctx_nom G) A Rep /\ J G a b R.

Definition P_ctx (G:context) (H:Ctx G) :=
  (forall x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> roleing (ctx_nom G) A Rep) /\
  (forall c a b A R, binds c (Co (Eq a b A R)) G ->
     roleing (ctx_nom G) a R /\ roleing (ctx_nom G) b R /\ roleing (ctx_nom G) A Rep).

Lemma DefEq_sound_mut : forall G D a b A R (d:DefEq G D a b A R), P_de G D a b A R d.
Proof.
  intros G0 D0 a0 b0 A0 R0 d0.
  apply (DefEq_mut P_ty P_pw P_iso P_de P_ctx).
  (* ---- Typing: E_Star ---- *)
  - intros G c IHc. unfold P_ty. split.
    + intro R. apply role_a_Star. apply ctx_nom_uniq, Ctx_uniq; exact c.
    + apply role_a_Star. apply ctx_nom_uniq, Ctx_uniq; exact c.
  (* ---- Typing: E_Var ---- *)
  - intros G x A c IHc Hb. unfold P_ty. split.
    + intro R. apply (role_a_Var (ctx_nom G) x R Nom).
      * apply ctx_nom_uniq, Ctx_uniq; exact c.
      * exact (binds_ctx_nom G x A Hb).
      * apply NomBot.
    + unfold P_ctx in IHc. destruct IHc as [Htm Hco]. exact (Htm x A Hb).
  (* ---- Typing: E_Pi ---- *)
  - intros L G rho A B t IHt t0 IHt0. unfold P_ty in *.
    destruct IHt0 as [HtA HtAst].
    split.
